chapters.title: Chapter 101: One Hundred Fortresses... and One Promise
paragraphs: Morning.
Luke woke up after the previous intense night and stretched his body while yawning.

"Hmm, where is she?" He looked around and found out that Aurielle was not in the room. "It seems like she gone to Margaret’s room." With that, he stood up from the bed and reached the corner bathroom to relieve himself while also getting refreshed.

"I have to check the previous rewards as well." Luke remembers how he was almost got declared a cheating husband after getting excited yesterday. So he brings the system info back from the third technique.
[⚔️ C-Rank Black Steel Ascension Series]
Third Ascension Technique: Black Steel Fortress
Realm: Gold Knight Technique
Type: Defence / Aura Manifestation
Description:
After reaching the Gold Knight Realm, the user evolves their defensive power into a true personal ability.
The user learns to manifest their Black Steel Aether outside their body, creating a fortress-like armour that protects them from all directions.
In this realm the armour is no longer just reinforcement. It becomes an extension of the user’s existence.
Every layer of Black Steel Fortress is created from highly compressed Aether, making it extremely difficult to destroy.
Effects:
• Creates a full-body Black Steel armour manifestation
• Massive increase in defence
• Blocks powerful attacks
• Protects against multiple enemies
• Reduces damage from high-level techniques
• Allows the user to continue fighting through overwhelming attacks
{Mastery Requirement: By completely mastering Black Steel Fortress, the user gains the qualification to ascend into the Platinum Knight Realm.}

"No wonder golden knights are walking calamity." Luke exclaims after reading the description. Because it clearly indicates it, it allows the user to continue fighting through overwhelming attacks. Which is absurd.
After that he turns his gaze towards the third and final reward, which he has got from the Aurielle.
[One Enchanted Tier Moving War Fortress x 10,000]
The enchanted tier is the first rank on the weapons-ranking system, whose power is comparable to the body-tempering stage.
After thinking for a moment, Luke decided that it would be best to have a number, but not this low level.
So he upgraded once using 100x and made it to the refined tier, which is the second level in the artefacts ranking system.
Then used the 100x to multiply the numbers.
While doing this, he thought about his magic tower, which he got as a reward from the system.
If he brought it here, it would help him a lot. But he has placed the Magic Tower inside the time chamber for territory security.
After a moment the system screen popped up and showed the rewards after the multiplier.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting 100 Refined Tier Fortress: Warwalker Fortress.]
[🏰 Refined Tier Fortress: Warwalker Fortress]
Type: Mobile Fortress / Defensive War Machine
Size: 10 metres
Core System: Central Aether Core
Mobility System: 8 Mechanical Spider Legs
Current Mode: Stationary Defence Mode
Core Concept:
The Warwalker Fortress is a refined-tier moving fortress designed for battlefield support and defensive warfare.
Unlike normal fortresses that require a fixed location, the Warwalker Fortress can move across the battlefield using its eight mechanical spider-like legs.
After reaching a strategic position, it can enter stationary mode and transform itself into a powerful defensive structure.
At that point, the fortress becomes a temporary battlefield stronghold.

After reading the info, Luke nodded with a satisfied expression. "Because with this, we have another means to defend in the middle of the battlefield." Then he clicked on the appearance button, which was showing its small hovering model. and read the description as well.
Appearance:
The fortress has a massive armoured body standing 10 metres tall. Its structure resembles a combination of a fortress tower and an advanced war machine.
Thick metal plating covers the exterior. While multiple defensive structures are built into the fortress body.
At the centre of the fortress lies a massive glowing Aether Core. And the core acts as the heart of the entire machine. which empowers weapons, defence, and shields.

After reading the appearance info and also checking the hologram, Luke smiled. ’A 10m-large armoured body. GOOD!’ With that thought, he checked it’s shield and weapons structure as well. Which was looking too cool.
Defensive System: Spherical Aether Shield
A powerful spherical shield surrounds the entire fortress.
The shield protects against:
• ranged attacks
• magic attacks
• explosive impacts
Weapon System: Small Cannon Array
The fortress contains: 10 Small Aether Cannons
Position: Around the outer walls.
Purpose:
• Anti-personnel attacks
• Suppression fire
• Battlefield control
The cannons can fire continuously.
Ballista Towers
The fortress contains: 4 Integrated Aether Ballista Towers
Position: Placed around the fortress structure.
Each tower requires: 1 Dedicated Operator
The operator controls:
• aiming
• firing direction
• attack timing
• target selection
Purpose:
• Long-range heavy attacks
• Armour penetration
• Anti-monster combat
• Precision strikes
Main Weapon: Aether Devastation Beam Cannon
Type: High-Power Siege Weapon
Location: Top/Main Core Section
Description: The strongest weapon of the Warwalker Fortress.
The fortress gathers energy from its central Aether Core and concentrates it into a massive destructive beam. Unlike normal weapons, this cannon requires charging time.
After reaching full charge: The attack can,
• destroy large structures
• break defensive formations
• heavily damage higher-rank opponents
{Due to the extreme energy concentration, the beam has a possibility of harming enemies above the fortress’s rank.}
Weakness: Because the main cannon consumes enormous energy,
• requires charging time
• temporarily lowers shield strength
• places stress on the Aether Core
If the core is damaged, all fortress systems weaken.
"INSANE!" Luke exclaimed but fortunately controlled his voice this time. Still, his face becomes fully shocked.
Because this is a walking tank but with an futuristic setting. "It can defend, carry tropes, attack, and even have mass destruction weapons for its own level."
That’s why it’s insane. And what’s even more insane? HE HAS FING 100s of these.

"Just think! Seeing 100s of 10m-tall fortresses, each firing an aether devastation cannon. Will that not even break the mountains apart?" Luke, with an excited expression, said this and thought; ’sadly, Nyx and Myrkhal were sleeping,’ or he would have shared this happiness with them as well.
"Even though its power is equal to Iron Knight’s. But on the battlefield, this can help tremendously." After saying this, he took a deep breath to calm his overexcited emotions.
Which was clearly saying, "Use this weapon now! BIG GUNS! BIG GUNS!" "Yeah, who doesn’t love big guns?
Finally, a few minutes later he calmed down and then checked the rewards from Naivara as well. With hope of finding something even more ridiculous.
[Emotions calculated. Second Wife Naivara Tidewhisper.]
[Yesterday’s emotions: a little jealousy/felt slight love/slight fear/hope, etc.]
"This..." Luke got silent after seeing this.
Because he also knows. that she didn’t fall in love with him like Aurielle. But...finding that she opens herself to him is already enough.
"Hope..." But the last word made him silent and emotional. because he can already guess, what does this mean? "Save me!" He looked towards the ceiling while clenching his fist.
How could he...forget that his wife was still placed as a trophy to be claimed? And he is currently powerless to do anything about this.
"I hate this feeling..." With moist eyes and a low voice, he muttered while keep staring towards the ceiling.
"1 year, that’s all I have!" Luke said with eyes that were filled with determination. Because he would become so strong that no one can touch his wife or even think of placing her as a trophy.
"Huff..." A few moments later, he got a little calmer and clicked to the reward section with a little down mood.
[Congratulations, 10,000x Return Activated.]
[You have gotten the D-rank rewards bundle.]
[100 Marinthians, Coral Guard Realm x 10,000]
[One E rank MARINTHIAN SEA SOVEREIGNTY SERIES x 10,000]
[Arcane tier Whispering Tide Conch (100 km range) x 10,000]
"Huh? D-Rank?" Upon reading the description, Luke becomes surprised. because he didn’t expect to get a D-rank reward from Naivara. As her feelings towards him have not developed much.

So he asked the system, on which the system mentioned. That Niara’s emotions are new and new emotions have more chance to bring higher-ranking rewards. Following that, system also added that the system rewards are also somehow affected by the target person’s rank.
Luke nodded in enlightenment because Naira is a peak silver rank, while Aurielle is a mid-bronze rank.
Then he shifted his attention back to the rewards, but his gaze turned to the last one first.
"Whispering Tide couch?" Once he read that name and also saw the range option. Luke already guessed what this reward will be. So he read its short description and confirmed.

"It’s a communication artefact, like a phone, just with limited range." His eyes lit up upon this. Because in this world far-distance communication is a luxury, which is often owned by nobles or high-ranking warriors.
Sadly, even though he was also a noble, he didn’t have anything related to communication.
"At least I have now. And I can also upgrade this as well." So without wasting any more time, he used 100x to upgrade the arcane tier to the noble tier (4th rank).
"System, show me the info of Noble Whispering Tide Couch."
[Chapter End]
Thank you so much! SurvivingPandas! for your support to this novel.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: The Body Tempering Begins And The Noble Conch
paragraphs: [Congratulations Luke! to getting the 100 Noble Tier Artifact: Whispering Tide Conch.]
[🐚 Noble Tier Artifact: Whispering Tide Conch]
Type: Communication Artifact
Range: 1000 kilometers
Core Concept:
The Whispering Tide Conch is an advanced communication artifact created to transmit voices across extreme distances.
Unlike normal communication tools that rely on physical messengers or short-range signals, the Whispering Tide Conch uses Aether resonance to establish a connection between two linked conches.
No matter the location, the user’s voice can travel across the distance and reach another connected Whispering Tide Conch.
"Great!" A big smile appeared on Luke’s face. Because 1000 km communication with a little bit use of Aether is great.
After finishing reading, he took out one whispering tide couch and inspected its appearance.

The Whispering Tide Conch resembles a large pearl-white seashell with elegant blue patterns flowing across its surface. And the inside of the conch contains a faint blue glow water, resembling a calm flowing tide.
Finding its appearance pleasing to the eye. He turned his gaze toward the system screen, which was showing the read "ability description..." So he clicked on it.
Ability: Resonance Communication
The user pours a small amount of Aether into the conch. Then the artifact creates a resonance connection with another Whispering Tide Conch.
Effects:
• Voice transmission up to 1000 km
• Clear communication regardless of distance
• Works in any environment
• Resistant to normal interference
• Can connect with another linked Whispering Tide Conch
"No wonder it’s a noble tier artifact." Once he read the text, Luke exclaimed. Because on the noble tier, an artifact can hold many inscriptions on it. Which makes them very versatile.
"Now we can talk and connect to our territory even from a far distance." With a satisfied smile, he returned the couch to system space. Then checked other rewards as well.
[100 Marinthians, Coral Guard Realm x 10,000]
"Hmm...Coral Guard Realm," Luke rubbed his chin while remembering what Naira had told him.

"Currently only one race rules the ocean territory, or at least explored part of the ocean. That is Marinthians. We are!" At that time, her voice sounded a little proud. But he ignored that part and continued recalling that info.
"Like humans, every race has their own realm classification, and the same goes for their Ascension Series."
"So, rather than using Ocean itself, we moved toward the TIDAL ASCENSION SYSTEM."
"In which each realm grants us different powers, and with its help we do our ascension."
Luke came out of his thoughts and muttered. "Coral Guard Realm is equal to Iron Knight Stage."
But then his expression becomes confused. "Why did I get Marinthians?? rather than human soldiers like I used to."
While rubbing his chin, he thought maybe it was because most of the or almost every reward he got. It was from Aurielle, who is a human.
"But Naira is a Marinthian!" So that should be the reason. With that, he also confirmed from the system. [Affirmative.] That’s all system said.
Even though 10,000 coral guards seem fine. "I would prefer high-end combat." He finally made that decision. after checking his previous rewards, which were Enchanted Walker Fortress.
So he used 100x two times and made all of them into silver knight equal-strength units.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting 100 Marinthians, Tide Keeper Realm (Silver Knight Equivalent)]
After the notification, he got 100 magic scrolls, from which he can summon them anytime.
"Final Reward." Luke muttered without any excitement in his eyes.
[One E rank MARINTHIAN SEA SOVEREIGNTY SERIES x 10,000]
Yeah, the Ascension series for Marinthians, so he converted them directly into C-rank.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting C-Rank 🌊 Marinthian Sea Sovereignty Series: Aqua Spear Series]
After examining the text, he pulls out its info.
C-Rank Aqua Spear Series:
Type: Offensive / Piercing / Water Combat Path
Specialty: Water Spear Creation and High-Speed Piercing Attacks
Core Concept:
The Aqua Spear Series is a Marinthian combat path focused on transforming ocean energy into highly condensed spear-like attacks.
Unlike broad water manipulation paths that control waves or currents, the Aqua Spear Series focuses all power into a single point.
A simple principle: "The deeper the pressure, the stronger the spear."
The users of this series compress their tidal core energy into sharp water weapons capable of piercing through powerful defenses.
[First Aqua Spear Series Technique: Aqua Piercer...]
[Second Aqua Spear Series Technique: Aqua Drill Spear...]
[Third Aqua Spear Series Technique: Leviathan Fang...]
"Well...the name looks good." Luke muttered upon reading. But still, he checked only the first move.
First Aqua Spear Series Technique: 🌊 Aqua Piercer
Type: Water Spear Technique
Description:
The user condenses their Tidal Core energy into a form of sharp spear of compressed water.
The spear contains immense pressure inside its structure, allowing it to pierce targets with explosive force.
Effects:
• Creates a condensed water spear
• High penetration power
• Can be thrown or used as a melee weapon
• Effective against armored enemies
{Mastery Requirement: By completely mastering Aqua Drill Spear, the user gains the qualification to ascend into the Tide Keeper Realm.}
Sadly, the mastery requirement does not work here. Because they were already in the Tide Keeper realm.

"Still, they need to learn this technique from the start to ascend into a new realm." Luke muttered the info he got from the system. In which the person should have to practice every move in the series to build their foundation.

Or it would collapse when they do ascension. That’s also one of the reasons why people place heavy value on choosing their first Ascension series. because if they changed it later. They have to learn that series from the start.
Finally, after all the rewards were done. He chose to break through inside the inn room.
"I will be done before Aurielle returns." With that, he sat down on the mattress and summoned 10 Iron Knight stage tempering potions. while checking their description.
[⚔️ Iron Knight Stage Tempering Potion]

Purpose: The Iron Knight Stage Tempering Potion uses highly concentrated Aether Essence to continuously temper an Iron Knight’s body. Rather than increasing mana directly, it strengthens the body’s compatibility with the Aether Core.
It also continuously reforges the muscles, bones, organs, blood, and meridians, allowing the knight to safely release greater amounts of Aether.
Luke nodded after reading. Because Iron Knights progress with increased compatibility to their Aether code, and each stage brings their body closer to their Aether core.
So Luke uncorked the vial. And observed. Inside, the liquid shimmered like molten silver intertwined with faint black streaks, which kept releasing a dense wave of Aether.
Then without hesitation—
He tilted his head back and swallowed the whole potion in a single motion.
The next instant he felt the cool liquid sliding down his throat. And for a brief moment... Nothing happened.
Then—
THUMP!
His heart slammed violently against his chest. which startled him.
But before he could react to the change, a sudden scorching sensation erupted from his Dantian.
WHOOOOOOM...
The Aether Core suddenly began spinning on its own. Like a raging vortex, and large amount of aether burst from the core.
But instead of flowing outside, it surged violently into every part of his body.
His muscles.
His bones.
His organs.
His blood.
Even the smallest meridians were flooded with dense aether.
Luke’s entire body trembled. "Nngh..." he clenched tightly his fists to hold the pained voice.
From the outside, blue veins bulged beneath his skin as violent streams of Aether forced themselves through every inch of his body.
But even after a few minutes, this speed didn’t stop. Then—
CRACK...
Tiny fractures start forming inside his muscles.
CRACK... CRACK...
His bones released faint cracking sounds. while Luke’s old muscle fibers shattered.
Immediately afterward, fresher, denser fibers replaced them.
His bones became heavier. His organs rapidly adapted to withstand the stronger flow of Aether. His blood absorbed more Aether than before.
Even his meridians expanded, allowing greater quantities of Aether to circulate freely.
Every single cell in his body was being destroyed... Only to be rebuilt stronger and better.
"Hng...!" Luke gritted his teeth to hold back the pained voice, which threatens to come out.
Cold sweat streamed down his forehead. And he felt as though countless invisible hammers were striking every inch of his body.
Again.
Again.
Again.
Every strike crushed his weakness. Every strike reforged his body. The pain was enough to make an ordinary Iron Knight scream in agony.
But Luke endured it! endure...in the silence.
Only an occasional—"Nngh..."—sound escaped between his clenched teeth.
Soon, the next phase started, and inside his dantian, the Aether Core increased its spinning speed.
WHIRRRRRR...
Impurities hidden within his Aether were expelled. While the core grew brighter. Denser. And more stable.
Its circulation also became smoother than before. And its connection with Luke’s body deepened.
As his body strengthened... The Core released more Aether.
As the Core released more Aether... His body continued tempering.
The two evolved together in perfect harmony.
So minutes passed...
And the violent Aether gradually settled.
WHOOOOO...
The last traces of energy slowly returned to the core. While silence filled the room, only Luke’s rough breathing sound could be heard.
"huff...huff..." Luke slowly opened his eyes while taking deep breaths.
Finally after a moment later, when he calmed down, a faint metallic sheen briefly flashed across his skin before fading away.
Seeing this, he slowly clenched his fist.
CRACK.
But this action makes the surrounding air compressed beneath the sheer force.
He could feel the difference immediately.
His muscles had become denser. His bones were stronger. His body was tougher. His organs were more resilient. While his blood carried Aether more efficiently. And his meridians had widened.
Every movement felt lighter. Every breath carried greater power. Even the flow of Aether throughout his body had become smoother than ever before.
He had successfully completed another round of tempering.
"Second Stage Iron Knight Achieved!" A big smile appeared on Luke’s face.
[Chapter End]

While rubbing his chin, he thought maybe it was because most of the or almost every reward he got.
It was from Aurielle, who is a human.
"But Naira is a Marinthian!" So that should be the reason.
With that, he also confirmed from the system.
[Affirmative.] That’s all system said.
Even though 10,000 coral guards seem fine.
"I would prefer high-end combat." He finally made that decision. after checking his previous rewards, which were Enchanted Walker Fortress.
So he used 100x two times and made all of them into silver knight equal-strength units.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting 100 Marinthians, Tide Keeper Realm (Silver Knight Equivalent)]
After the notification, he got 100 magic scrolls, from which he can summon them anytime.
"Final Reward." Luke muttered without any excitement in his eyes.
[One E rank MARINTHIAN SEA SOVEREIGNTY SERIES x 10,000]
Yeah, the Ascension series for Marinthians, so he converted them directly into C-rank.
[Congratulations Luke! for getting C-Rank 🌊 Marinthian Sea Sovereignty Series: Aqua Spear Series]
After examining the text, he pulls out its info.
C-Rank Aqua Spear Series:
Type: Offensive / Piercing / Water Combat Path
Specialty: Water Spear Creation and High-Speed Piercing Attacks
Core Concept:
The Aqua Spear Series is a Marinthian combat path focused on transforming ocean energy into highly condensed spear-like attacks.
Unlike broad water manipulation paths that control waves or currents, the Aqua Spear Series focuses all power into a single point.
A simple principle: "The deeper the pressure, the stronger the spear."
The users of this series compress their tidal core energy into sharp water weapons capable of piercing through powerful defenses.
[First Aqua Spear Series Technique: Aqua Piercer...]
[Second Aqua Spear Series Technique: Aqua Drill Spear...]
[Third Aqua Spear Series Technique: Leviathan Fang...]
"Well...the name looks good." Luke muttered upon reading.
But still, he checked only the first move.
First Aqua Spear Series Technique: 🌊 Aqua Piercer
Type: Water Spear Technique
Description:
The user condenses their Tidal Core energy into a form of sharp spear of compressed water.
The spear contains immense pressure inside its structure, allowing it to pierce targets with explosive force.
Effects:
• Creates a condensed water spear
• High penetration power
• Can be thrown or used as a melee weapon
• Effective against armored enemies
{Mastery Requirement: By completely mastering Aqua Drill Spear, the user gains the qualification to ascend into the Tide Keeper Realm.}
Sadly, the mastery requirement does not work here.
Because they were already in the Tide Keeper realm.
"Still, they need to learn this technique from the start to ascend into a new realm." Luke muttered the info he got from the system.
In which the person should have to practice every move in the series to build their foundation.
Or it would collapse when they do ascension.
That’s also one of the reasons why people place heavy value on choosing their first Ascension series. because if they changed it later.
They have to learn that series from the start.
Finally, after all the rewards were done.
He chose to break through inside the inn room.
"I will be done before Aurielle returns." With that, he sat down on the mattress and summoned 10 Iron Knight stage tempering potions. while checking their description.
[⚔️ Iron Knight Stage Tempering Potion]
Purpose: The Iron Knight Stage Tempering Potion uses highly concentrated Aether Essence to continuously temper an Iron Knight’s body.
Rather than increasing mana directly, it strengthens the body’s compatibility with the Aether Core.
It also continuously reforges the muscles, bones, organs, blood, and meridians, allowing the knight to safely release greater amounts of Aether.
Luke nodded after reading.
Because Iron Knights progress with increased compatibility to their Aether code, and each stage brings their body closer to their Aether core.
So Luke uncorked the vial.
And observed.
Inside, the liquid shimmered like molten silver intertwined with faint black streaks, which kept releasing a dense wave of Aether.
Then without hesitation—
He tilted his head back and swallowed the whole potion in a single motion.
The next instant he felt the cool liquid sliding down his throat.
And for a brief moment...
Nothing happened.
Then—
THUMP!
His heart slammed violently against his chest. which startled him.
But before he could react to the change, a sudden scorching sensation erupted from his Dantian.
WHOOOOOOM...
The Aether Core suddenly began spinning on its own.
Like a raging vortex, and large amount of aether burst from the core.
But instead of flowing outside, it surged violently into every part of his body.
His muscles.
His bones.
His organs.
His blood.
Even the smallest meridians were flooded with dense aether.
Luke’s entire body trembled.
"Nngh..." he clenched tightly his fists to hold the pained voice.
From the outside, blue veins bulged beneath his skin as violent streams of Aether forced themselves through every inch of his body.
But even after a few minutes, this speed didn’t stop.
Then—
CRACK...
Tiny fractures start forming inside his muscles.
CRACK...
CRACK...
His bones released faint cracking sounds. while Luke’s old muscle fibers shattered.
Immediately afterward, fresher, denser fibers replaced them.
His bones became heavier.
His organs rapidly adapted to withstand the stronger flow of Aether.
His blood absorbed more Aether than before.
Even his meridians expanded, allowing greater quantities of Aether to circulate freely.
Every single cell in his body was being destroyed...
Only to be rebuilt stronger and better.
"Hng...!" Luke gritted his teeth to hold back the pained voice, which threatens to come out.
Cold sweat streamed down his forehead.
And he felt as though countless invisible hammers were striking every inch of his body.
Again.
Again.
Again.
Every strike crushed his weakness.
Every strike reforged his body.
The pain was enough to make an ordinary Iron Knight scream in agony.
But Luke endured it! endure...in the silence.
Only an occasional—"Nngh..."—sound escaped between his clenched teeth.
Soon, the next phase started, and inside his dantian, the Aether Core increased its spinning speed.
WHIRRRRRR...
Impurities hidden within his Aether were expelled.
While the core grew brighter.
Denser.
And more stable.
Its circulation also became smoother than before.
And its connection with Luke’s body deepened.
As his body strengthened...
The Core released more Aether.
As the Core released more Aether...
His body continued tempering.
The two evolved together in perfect harmony.
So minutes passed...
And the violent Aether gradually settled.
WHOOOOO...
The last traces of energy slowly returned to the core.
While silence filled the room, only Luke’s rough breathing sound could be heard.
"huff...huff..." Luke slowly opened his eyes while taking deep breaths.
Finally after a moment later, when he calmed down, a faint metallic sheen briefly flashed across his skin before fading away.
Seeing this, he slowly clenched his fist.
CRACK.
But this action makes the surrounding air compressed beneath the sheer force.
He could feel the difference immediately.
His muscles had become denser.
His bones were stronger.
His body was tougher.
His organs were more resilient.
While his blood carried Aether more efficiently.
And his meridians had widened.
Every movement felt lighter.
Every breath carried greater power.
Even the flow of Aether throughout his body had become smoother than ever before.
He had successfully completed another round of tempering.
"Second Stage Iron Knight Achieved!" A big smile appeared on Luke’s face.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 103: They Sent an Executioner After Luke
paragraphs: But he didn’t stop there and uncorked another potion, then gulped it down in a single motion.
Another round of tempering started, and he repeated this process until the last potion also got empty.
"HUFF..." Luke took a deep breath when he felt his strength increase by a great margin.
"Time for a rank up." So he brings out another vial, which contains an Iron Knight Breakthrough potion.
But his expression got worried while thinking about the breakthrough. Because for body temper to Iron Knight, it’s about forming an aether seed.
While iron knight to bronze knight is more than that. "The core will shatter!"
Yeah, which worried him a lot. Because this stage forms a new aether core, which is also known as the "Bronze core."
And this core is essential for future progression because it makes the body truly compatible with the Ascension series. So the body can hold or bear the pressure of the techniques.
[Luke, don’t worry about this. The potion you have received didn’t have a failure chance at all.] Seeing Luke’s worried face, the system explains this to him. Which finally relaxed his expression.
"Ok." With that, he uncorked the potion vial. "Huh?" But then he noticed something.
"There is also bronze radiance swirling inside it. " he muttered while remembering that, when he showed this potion to everyone, he only saw black-silver liquid.
"It seems like I didn’t look properly." He shook his head to remove this thought. But one thing still bugs him.
"I also lost the chance to sell those Origin fruits," because he was planning to sell them after the spar. However, who can think? That demon whisper would attack the count’s territory.
So after they return. Many nobles were already left the territory.
"Whatever," He muttered before drinking down the potion in one gulp.
The black-silver liquid slid down his throat before erupting into a scorching torrent of energy that surged through every meridian.
His Peak Iron Knight body trembled violently as the immense Aether flooded every muscle, bone, organ, and drop of blood.
Inside him, the perfectly refined Iron Aether Core also began spinning faster and faster until it reached its limit.
Crack...
Slowly fine fractures start spreading across its surface.
On this Luke clenched his teeth, because he was enduring the unbearable pressure as the core inside him collapsed into countless radiant fragments.
But instead of dispersing, the fragments rapidly compressed toward the center of his dantian.
Finally, under the overwhelming force of the potion, they fused together again, condensing into a far denser and more powerful "Bronze Aether Core."
BOOM!
A terrifying wave of Bronze Aether exploded from the newly formed Core, sweeping through his entire body. Even the air inside the room got blasted backward.
Then his every meridian expanded. Along with every muscle, bone, and organ underwent another round of refinement, adapting to the tremendous pressure and explosive power of the evolved core.
Eventually, minutes later, the violent energy gradually subsided.
Then Luke slowly opened his eyes. And a bronze radiance flashed within his pupils before disappearing.
He clenched his fist with a smile when he felt the overwhelming surge of strength that was coursing through his body.
Luke had officially stepped into the "Bronze Knight Realm."
"Good!" With an excited smile, he muttered and thought about the new titan. Which will unlock with his new realm.
"System, show me!" So, with a little raised voice, he said to the system, but the response was something he didn’t expect.
"What??" Luke looked at those emojis, and a bad feeling rose into his heart.

[Ahem! Luke...actually, your form is loading, so it will take some time to unlock it.] The system with an embarrassed expression said this to Luke. Because of a previous incident related to faceless titan, he got some problem with the summoning, and now he has to fix that.
"No new form?? So...we woke up for nothing." But then Luke got startled by the sudden words, however he got calmed down in the next moment.
Because there Nyx and Myrkhal somehow appeared beside him and were now looking at the system message.
But after saying those words, both of them return back to sleep. Like greeting Luke is not necessary.
"Well..." He just uttered those words before stopping and shook his head.
At least he got tons of rewards, and now his titan forms can be used for long time and he don’t have to worry about stamina consumption. which is enough for him.
"Ughh! The smell!" But while he was lost in his thoughts, a sudden strong odor choked him, and he looked down.
There black goo was appearing all around his body. because of his realm breakthrough and earlier knight stage tempering.
So without any words, he ran back to the bathroom and took the bath again.
After washing more than ten times. The smell finally left his body. But when he came out and saw the mattress was also dirty with black goo. His face changed to worry.
"I hope the cat women would not resent us." With that, he dressed up and left the room.

But after reaching Margaret’s room, he found that Margaret, Aurielle, and Vaelira were not here. So when he came down and asked his knights. They replied that the three of them got the invitation from Lady Nyra for a ’women-only party.’ So they left earlier because of this.
"Huh? A women’s only party." Luke got baffled, after hearing this term were also exist, in this world as well.
"So I have to, do the shopping alone," Luke said with a sigh, because he wants to buy many things for the territory. Which is why he was finding them.
But seeing that it can’t be helped. He left the building alone toward the nearest association.
"La~la~" The female cat person, as usual, starts doing her room cleaning work.
But when she opened the door of the last room to finish her morning cleaning. "WHAT THE F**K! WHO S**T HERE!" She closed her nose with both hands, and the broom and wiper dropped to the ground.
Because the smell inside was unbearable. But then she noticed it was not shit; it was waste after the breakthrough.
"Ugh...doesn’t the person know that they should use the bathroom while doing a breakthrough or in a separate room?" While complaining, she gritted her teeth and cleaned the room properly.
Inside a dim room, ten people, all dressed in black robes, were seated on chairs around the circular table.
In the corner some lanterns flickered slightly as the tension in the room was high.
"What’s happened with the earlier assassination that Viscount Ashenford gave??" One person with a white glove, which has a black open hand with a single eye in between, asked.
Silence...all the ten members also have the same symbol on their gloves, but their glove color is azure blue. Couldn’t be able to say anything in the presence of a higher ranker.
Seeing he is not getting replies from anyone. He became displeased, so just as he was about to shout again... one person from the group finally replied.
"Sir Nightmare...the mission got failed, and the Reaper along with Fangs got killed," the person, with a sweat-covered forehead, replied with a little pause.
Because the person sitting in front of him is Nightmare title assassin. For this, the person need the Diamond Knight stage realm, and then only they can wear the white glove.
The Nightmare assassin got more displeased after hearing this answer. Because they got the commission to kill some talentless hero, not a strong one.

But the members even failed at that. ’Did a goddess intervene? ’ The white-gloved assassin with furrowed brows thought before he shook his head. ’No, that’s impossible.’ Because those giants can’t move or do anything before the awakening ceremony.

So with a sigh, he asked about the status, and they replied. "Sir, previously viscount spend the money for the Reaper level. But now the viscount has given us more money and is asking us to send the executioner title assassin."
GASPED!
The present assassins got shocked by this info. because they were all busy and were not in charge of this mission. So they don’t know much about this.
But still Executioner, which is golden knight level. ’Doesn’t seem too much?’ This thought comes into everyone’s mind.

The Nightmare assassin also got surprised by this. Because even for their organization, Executioner is an important asset. So if someone hires at this level, then the amount of money they have to spend is also very huge.
"Sir, I think. The viscount has already heard what happened during Count Magnus’s daughter’s birthday.
When the same person said this, the white-glove assassin nodded. But when he heard the name Magnus, he flinched slightly with fear.
Because even though both of them are in the same realm. Magnus was an monster in human skin, because once he also exchanged blows with him. Due to the mission and nearly got killed.

However, the speaking assassin didn’t notice this and continue. "Maybe the viscount is worried about the count’s youngest daughter, Nyra." With that, he explains how some gossip spread. That maybe Nyra has already fallen for Hero Luke, and if the viscount attacks their territory, then maybe... Luke will ask for help from Nyra.
The other assassins also nodded on this. The Nightmare assassin finally came out of his thoughts and accepted the mission.
"Send one early-stage Executioner assassin for this. And this should be enough." With that, he stood up before leaving the meeting.

Seeing that the main head is already left. Others also followed suit. But sadly no one knows. That Luke and his wives have already killed a peak golden knight-level powerhouse. Even though it was a fake one. But they did.
[Chapter End]

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Lucy’s Desperate Smile, Please Don’t Take My Customer
paragraphs: After coming out of the inn, morning sunlight directly hit Luke’s eyes. "What a welcome!" So while shielding his eyes, he headed toward the market district.
"Too many things to buy." Luke muttered after recalling the list he had prepared.
For mages, he have to buy magic scrolls for learning.
For new knights, he have to buy weapons and armors.
For territory, he has to buy raw ingots, weapons or armor blueprints, seeds, livestock, and one of the main things, ’tons of potions.’ of both types, health potion and Aether potions.
"My 11000 gold coins budget will be drained today." Throughout the journey he only muttered this while keep sighing. which bring some oddglances from onlookers.
And finally, after half an hour of walking... "why walking??" Because he wants to enjoy the morning breeze, he reached the market district.
"Wow!" But then an exclamation escaped his mouth after seeing the scenery. Even though he has already seen this at the start. still it’s amazed him.

’Those towering structures are something.’ He thought while noticing. That whole market is already filled with many people, and some other races members can be seen. Who were buying and selling and many carriages also passing through.

"Wait...the count celebration didn’t have many races present." then Luke muttered while recalling that only a few people of the ocean race or a few other elves were present. While the majority were still humans from the surrounding territory.
"It seems like most of the races come into Stormveil County are just merchants or adventurers." With that, he moved toward one of the towering structures, "the Mage Association."
But when he reached the association, he got stunned. "What the hell!"
Because there in the distance stands a 45m tall tower with an 80 meter width. The tower was six stories and was made up of pale white marbles.
And the whole cylindrical tower is covered with countless magic symbols, which seem to be some type of formation.

While above the entrance was floating its association’s emblem. which is a massive open spellbook with a radiant eight-pointed star hovering above its pages. And it was not stationary, but it kept rotating slowly.
"Damn!" Luke felt jealous of this scene, and this amazing view. "My territory will also have structure better than this in the future." While saying that he moved toward the spacious granite plaza.
The whole pathway was surrounded on both sides by magic lanterns, and even though it was day, he could still see their glow.
"hehe~"
"Ahh! The exam is close, and I didn’t even read."
"The prices have gone up for the magic scroll."
While walking Luke also heard people chatter and complain, while he completely ignored the first voice.

There were also many young apprentice mages wearing blue robes who were constantly entering and exiting the tower with smiles or worried faces while carrying books, magic scrolls, and crystal containers.
Occasionally he can also hear some nobles carriages stopping outside the plaza, So when he turns toward them. There they were, bringing their children or talented ones for a test.
"Feels like a university." Luke, with a nostalgic smile, muttered and thought about his college days.
Finally, he reached the main entrance, and there were three massive white oak doors, each nearly eight meters tall, placed.
The doors were engraved with thousands of runes, which occasionally glow with aether.
Several guards were also standing outside, and each wore enchanted robes, which provides defense against magic attacks.
When he took steps toward the gates, along with other people. The runes on the gate light up for a moment, and the gate automatically opens.
"Automatic doors??" he became surprised by the development of magic in this world.
Then he looked inside and again got amazed by the scene. The first-floor ceiling is as high as 30 meters, while hundreds of magic crystals hang there. Which illuminates the whole public hall.
Yeah, public hall. Because he could see long reception counters stretched across one side of the hall, where elegantly dressed female mages with smiles assisted visitors.

Also the whole ground is covered with white marble, which reflects magic crystal light and Following that, he turned his gaze to the other side, and there various crystal display cases showcased various magical artifacts, enchanted staffs, spell scrolls, and mana crystals.
And behind them stood towering bookshelves, with thousands of books and tomes.
"Sir, can I assist you with something?" See, Luke was lost by the scenery; one young female mage wearing a blue robe came toward him for assistance.
"Huh??" Luke came out of the beautiful sight when he heard the young and sweet voice.
"Sure." He turned toward the person, who is a young woman with long black hair and green eyes. She seems like magic apprentices who were doing part-time work for her study.
After hearing Luke answer, a bright smile appeared on Lucy’s face. "Please, here sir."
With that, she brings Luke toward one sofa, and with the same smile, offers him the seat first.
"Thanks," Luke said while sitting, and she asked him what he would like to purchase.
Luke nodded to this and presented the list he had prepared beforehand to her.
’What!!!’ Lucy Dawnvale became completely shocked after seeing the content.
Because if the gentlemen really bought all of this, which is roughly 8,000 - 9,000 gold, then her commission would also be huge.
So her smile becomes brighter toward Luke. But Luke nearly got blinded by that big smile. ’So bright!’
"Sir, please follow me." After telling him about some info on the products, she brings Luke near one counter. Which was selling magic scrolls.

Katarina Blackford, because of punishment, was also doing the assistant job today and, as usual, was waiting for the customer while sitting on the sofa, so when she saw Lucy was bringing a young man with an smile toward the counter. Her face become unhappy.
"Why do I have to see her face today?" She cursed under her breath because she didn’t like her at all.

"What a welcome!" So while shielding his eyes, he headed toward the market district.
"Too many things to buy." Luke muttered after recalling the list he had prepared.
For mages, he have to buy magic scrolls for learning.
For new knights, he have to buy weapons and armors.

"why walking??" Because he wants to enjoy the morning breeze, he reached the market district.
"Wow!" But then an exclamation escaped his mouth after seeing the scenery.
Even though he has already seen this at the start. still it’s amazed him.
’Those towering structures are something.’ He thought while noticing.
That whole market is already filled with many people, and some other races members can be seen.

paragraphs: "Sir, why not take my assistance, and I will help you with the things you want to purchase." Katarina, with the same smile, said to Luke.
Lucy, with a worried and pleading face, looks toward Luke. Who was now looking at Katarina but what he was thinking. She didn’t know.
Luke felt Lucy’s pleading gaze and turned toward her. But before he reassure her, a soft sensation suddenly comes from the side.
He got baffled by the sudden soft feeling and shifted his attention toward the right side.
There was Katarina now standing close with the same smile, clinging to his shoulder, and her breasts were tightly pressed against it.
’This is bad.’ Instantly a few sweats formed on his forehead, and he looked around warily.
After searching for a few moments. "Huff!" He took a deep breath after finding Aurielle was not here.
He doesn’t know why, but whenever some girl or woman gets close to him. She somehow was present there and gave a death glare to him.
Katarina saw Luke’s reaction and misunderstood. That he was being shy, which is why he was looking around.
So with a slightly low voice, she whispered in his ear. "Sir~ the time you are here, you can spend with me~ rather than spending it with a boring girl."
’Huh???’ A big question mark appeared on Luke’s face after hearing Katarina’s voice, and he gave her a weird look. ’Do I look like a man? Who is here to enjoy the beauty?’
But sadly Katarina again misunderstood his look to be hesitation. So she added another word in a seductive voice. "If Sir wants...I can even give a kiss on your cheek~"

Lucy, from the side, saw all this and got demotivated. ’Now everything is over.’ With that thought, her shoulder slumped, and she tried to move back, toward the entrance, in hope maybe someone would get her assistance.
Katarina, while leaning on Luke, saw this scene. Which brings a satisfying smile to her face. ’serves you right.’ But just as she was celebrating her victory, a voice came from the young man.
"No, need!" Luke didn’t care about Katarina’s beauty at all. And he also don’t like backing away from his words. So Lucy comes first to him, and then he will take her help.

Silent...Katarina got completely silent, while her smile cracked after hearing Luke reply. Because she have met many young man and many of them are even nobles. But never once she have faced rejection by the opposite sex. However now she did.
"What! Katarina got rejected!" Some boys and girls were also watching the show from the corner. got shocked by this reversal.
Because when she tightly clings to the young man, all of them thought. Now he will say yes for sure. But this will happen, they didn’t expect.
"If she clings to my shoulder, then I would even become her dog. But this ungrateful man can’t see her beauty at all." One boy from her same class. Gritted his teeth and muttered.
’Hah?’ his friend got confused and thought. ’Buddy, are you angry? Or do you want the man to claim her? ’ He gave a speechless look to him, but the person... attention was still at Luke.
Lucy, with slumped shoulders and a tear in her eyes, was moving back. got stunned when she heard Luke’s words from behind.
So she slowly turned toward them and got shocked, because Luke was breaking free from Katarina’s embrace. while Katarina completely became a wax statue.
Then Luke turns toward her, which brings a genuine gratitude smile to her face, and she wipes away the tear that was about to drop from her eyes.
Sadly, her happiness didn’t last long.
Katarina came out of her statue-like state and saw Lucy’s happy face, which irritates her more than the rejection she faced just now.

So she gave a displeased glare toward Lucy, who was now smiling with relief. And said something, which completely removed the smile from Lucy’s face that had just come, and the surrounding classmates also got stunned.
"Sir! Think again. She is cursed!" Katarina’s voice came a little loud this time, but she didn’t care.
Though the same was not for everyone.
"Is she going to say those words?"
"Don’t you think that’s too much?"
"Poor, Lucy."

The surrounding students start gossiping about the talk, which they also have heard. But as this was a Lucy personal matter, they never discussed it outside. But now Katarina is going to tell that to an outsider, which didn’t feel right with them.
Katarina’s attention was all on Lucy. So when she saw Lucy face had now become pale and filled with panic. This brings an immediate satisfaction to her. ’Got you, bi**h!’

Lucy, closed her mouth with both hands and shook her head toward Katarina, "to please don’t say those words." But Katarina smiled with satisfaction, as she has already lost her mind after Luke rejection and in her jealosy toward Lucy.
Luke got baffled by this scene. ’What the hell is going on??’ And this thought comes into his mind. Because he just come here to buy things, but now it’s become some secret revealed drama.
"Sir, if you took her help. then maybe you will die."
’Hah?’ Luke heard Katarina, vioce and become even more baffled. ’why would I die just after taking her help?’ though he didn’t have to wait much, as Katarina next word soon followed.

"Sir, she got engaged to three people, and all of them died after that. And even that was not enough. Her family nearly got bankrupt after that." Katarina kept talking and didn’t even notice the tear in Lucy’s eyes. which was threatens to come out.
The surrounding people also got surprised and looked toward Lucy with different eyes. But her classmates just shook their heads.
As she was very talented in the whole class, but after that incident, her life became worse day by day. And now she coudn’t even able to afford her tuition fees.
But some looked at her with "serves right" expression. Because Katarina, one friend, was the sister of an earlier dead engaged man.
In the class, he has fallen for Lucy and proposed to her. But Lucy rejects him, so he brings his family to her house and there, She was engaged to him.
But just after a few weeks, he died with black spots on his body.
Lucy, with shaky eyes, looked toward everyone and felt the same gaze. which she got from everyone, when those rumors spread. ’Please, don’t look at me like that; I am not cursed.’

She closed her eyes, while her body kept trembling, and she pleaded this in her mind. So at least one person can hear her. "Why?? In her mind??" Because she did say to everyone that she is not cursed and it was not her fault. But none of them believed her.
Luke’s face also changed after seeing all these. And he felt disgusted toward the person who spread this rumor.
There he observed Lucy, who was trembling with closed eyes. And he can feel what she is going through.
’She looks like 18 and already suffering from bullying and pear pressure.’ He shook his head with pity.
"hmm..." But then he heard the same voice, which startled him in the morning.
’What?’ he said in his mind toward Nyx, who had just come out and was now looking at Lucy. That she has something hidden in her.
Nyx even after focusing at her, didn’t find the thing he want, so he shook his head and said. "She is cursed...by someone."
’What!’ Luke got shocked after finding that she was really cursed. ’Ofcourse, someone did this to her.’

’why?’ He asked Nyx, who gave him a speechless look. "earlier, I tried this, but coudn’t able to find it." Nyx said this to Luke and also added. That his power is too weak now, so he can’t find the hidden things inside her.
"But, you know. who can find that." Nyx settle down on Luke shoulder while saying.
Yeah, that emoji. "System, can you tell?" Luke looked toward Emoji with an annoyed expression and said in his mind.
The system glitched for a moment, like deciding to tell him or not. So Luke waited for a few seconds while Lucy’s tears started dropping on the ground and more crowd also gathered around them.
’Do they not have any work to do?’ Luke thought while waiting for the system answer.
[Well...Luke, she is a carrier for one of the heavenly virtues.]
Now this time, it was Luke’s turn to become stunned. ’Heavinly Virtue!’ These words kept repeating in his mind while Nyx nodded. Like he also found what was missing.
’Then who cursed her?’ Luke after coming out of his shocked state, asked to the system.
[Hmm...Luke, you know. Seven heavenly virtues and seven deadly sins are almost the same. just a different side of one coin.]

Luke nodded at the system explanation, then the system added. Then someone doesn’t want her to awaken her virtue body, but rather they want to corrupt her. So they can prepare her body for deadly sins.
System also told, that her heavenly virtue body is not decided yet and that’s why the person is doing experiment on her, to convert her into their desirable deadly sin.
’This is absurd!’ This thought, comes into his mind. Because he never expected to find someone who is a holder of virtue, and now she is being targeted so they can make her sin.
’Now what?’ Luke asked irritably, as a bad feeling came inside after seeing the system "0-0" emoji.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: The Hero Didn’t Walk Away
paragraphs: [Luke, normally these things, like finding someone with a virtuous body, are nearllyl impossible. Unless they knew about them before hand. But since you are a hero, the laws of Valtharion. allowed this to happen.]
[And of course, Valtharion. wants you to protect them. That’s why you met her here, before she turned into sin.]
’Wait a sec!’ Luke got confused by this, because the system told him. That Valtharion’s connection with him was cut off and it didn’t give him any blessing. which results, he can’t cultivate at all.
But now, the system is saying. That Valtharion wants him to do the hero work???.
So he said those words to the system as well. Who, after a moment, gave him the reply.

[Luke, first of all. Someone interferes with your summoning, which results in your connections being cut off from Valtharion. At least related to Aether. But because you are the chosen hero of the Goddess of Light.]
[Valtharion also sees you as a hero. which is why all those fateful things. though, I don’t know why. Valtharion is not fixing your cultivation issue.]

Finally, the system told him all the things, which brings more doubt to him. ’who interfere with my summoning.’ This bring endless rage to him. because of that incident. He becomes a laughing stock and also can’t cultivate at all.
Seeing Luke, lost in thought and the surrounding situation getting worse. system said to Luke.
[Still, Luke. I would suggest, you helped her. So maybe you can get her help when she awakens her virtue body. and which will be very helpful to your territory and the fight against demons.]
Luke’s rage calmed down little bit after hearing the system voice. Then he took a deep breath. After that he brings his right hand over Lucy’s head. Who was still crying with her eyes closed?
Because now she was sure no one was going to take her help, and she would also not be able to study in the magic tower.
’How would I be able to pay off the debt from my family?’ When this thought comes into her mind, her tears coming out speed even more increased.
’Huh?’ But then she felt a hand touch her head and start rubbing gently. And then comes the voice.
"Don’t worry, Lucy. I am not changing my helper."
When she heard the voice, she got stunned. Because this voice belongs to the same gentleman, who saw and heard everything.
She thought maybe he had already left, but now hearing his voice awakens a feeling. which she had buried deep inside her heart. ’There are still some nice people.’
Lucy slowly opened her eyes, and there in the front, the same man was smiling while looking at her.
"Why??" without even her releazing this word escaped her mouth. on which Luke, with a still-smiling face, brought his one hand toward her cheek and gently wiped her tears.
"Because I don’t back away from my words." Lucy’s eyes widened on that, while surrounding people got shocked.
’Doesn’t he hear? She is cursed, and maybe he will die.’ This thought comes into everyone’s mind, but then one voice echoed from the crowd.
"Wait... isn’t he the current Hero summoned by the Goddess of Light?"
Silence spread among the crowd, and some gossip that was going around also instantly got quieted down. after they heard that sentence.
Because some rumors spread recently that the same person who is patting Lucy’s head. present a luxury and beneficial gift to Lady Nyra, which won her heart.
And they also heard. That he, single-handedly with his first-stage iron knight cultivation, defeated the thirty iron knight instantly with one punch, and some were even peak iron knights among them.
So when they heard the name Hero, they didn’t mock him. like they used to do it before. Because most of the people are here, below bronze knight, and the same for mage as well.
So they don’t want to provoke the rage of the hero by taunting him. Even though they know that no fight is allowed here.
’Hero.’ Lucy also heard this term before. When her dorm-mate said that a talentless hero was summoned this time. At that time, she didn’t focus on this.
Because of her studies and jobs, she couldn’t distribute her focus like other rich girls and boys.
But now, when the crowd said those sentence, she only heard one term. ’Hero.’
"Yeah, because right now. The man in front of her, who was patting her head with a smile. is definitely looks like a hero.
"So, let’s go." He said those words, which bring a little blush to her face. As she didn’t even know...when she held his warm hand.
But fortunately, the hero didn’t say anything about this. So she released his hand and brought him toward the counter who was selling magic scrolls.
"What!!!" Katarina was completely stunned by this scene. because she never thought that the person she was trying to seduce was the hero.
"I have to return to territory fast." She said in panic and then immediately moved toward her room back. Her friends, seeing her leaving in a hurry, tried to call her, but she didn’t hear anything.
’Did you hear? The hero’s five princess wives are psycho.’ This info comes into her mind. and with a hope that they will not come for her. She starts packing her things.

"Here is the list." After reaching the counter, Lucy placed the list. While the attendant, without any reaction, starts bringing one thing after another. Like previous drama in the public hall didn’t occured and she didn’t care about that.
Lucy checked the quality of everything after double-checking everything to make sure. Then she nodded while presenting the list of purchase items with quantity and prices to Luke.
☀️ Light Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Light Arrow, Flash, Minor Holy Shield, Mana Recovery.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Holy Ray.
🌱 Nature Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Thorn Whip, Root Bind, Plant Sense, Seed Acceleration.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Vine Prison.
💧 Water Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Water Bullet, Water Shield, Mist Screen, Water Blade.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Water Cannon.
🪨 Earth Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Earth Spike, Stone Shield, Stone Fist, Rock Throw.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Earth Prison.
🔥 Fire Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Fireball, Flame Arrow, Flame Burst, Heat Wave.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Flame Lance.
🌪 Wind Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Wind Step, Air Cutter, Wind Shield, Gust Push.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Gale Slash.
🛡 Barrier Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Reinforced Barrier, Barrier Expansion, Mana Barrier, Barrier Repair.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Fortress Barrier.
🌿 Herb Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Herb Identification, Poison Analysis, Medicinal Extraction, Herb Preservation.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Greater Detoxification.
⚡ Lightning Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Lightning Bolt, Thunder Shot, Static Field, Lightning Enhancement.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Chain Lightning.
🌑 Shadow Magic
Purchased G-Rank Learning Scrolls: Shadow Needle, Silent Movement, Shadow Hand, Dark Vision.
Purchased F-Rank Learning Scroll: Shadow Bind.
Luke just checked the magic scrolls names, but not their prices and quantity.
"Good." He nodded with satisfaction after seeing G-rank and F-rank skills.
He brought more G-rank skills for his mage because he wants them to learn basic magic first. Then only focus on F-rank spells.
For armors, weapons, and magic scrolls or books, they are divided into different ranks, and those are represented by G rank and above.
Where G rank resources equal the body temperature realm, for mages, it’s the mana awakening realm. And this moves on with like E, F, D, and so on.
So after paying the price, it was 490 gold coins for G-rank scrolls and 190 gold for F-rank scrolls. Then Luke, along with Lucy, moved toward the second floor.
Because the next item he wants, was there.
The Magic Tower, Second Floor.
"Library." Luke muttered those words because the second floor was filled with hundreds of bookshelves, and each seemed to be filled with magical tomes and magic books.
"Hehe~" Lucy, seeing Luke’s shocked expression, giggled slowly. Because after getting assurance from him that he will not leave her. She became more cheerful and even opened up a little bit for him.
"In Stormveil County, only our The Eight Pillars of Magic tower holds this many books." With a little proud expression, she told Luke about this.
"I can see that." Luke also nodded, and soon they reached the counter.
There was an elderly man sitting, who was reading a book whose title Luke couldn’t understand at all.
’What’s that word or language?’ While he was lost in thought. Lucy gave the elder person the list, who, after closing his book, just gave a one look toward the list.
And then swing his finger in the air. For a moment nothing happened, which confused Luke.
But the next instant, he heard some rumble sound. Like something was awakening.
"This!" Soon, more than hundreds of books, one by one, come out from the shelves themselves. And while floating, they reached near the counter. Before stacking on one side.
’Magic is sure cool! ’ Luke didn’t speak this time but still thought this with amazed expression.
Lucy was observing Luke’s face all the time. So when he again became amazed, a small smile also appeared on her face, and she thought. ’Sir, Hero, doesn’t seem to know magic.’

chapters.title: Chapter 107: I’ll Pay Your 100,000 Gold Debt
paragraphs: "Here, Sir Hero." So after checking everything, Lucy present the bill to Luke. But when she mention the word "hero" the elderly man who was about to return back to his reading, paused slightly.
Then continue, as nothing happened at all. Luke and Lucy, didn’t notice this.
Luke nodded and took the bill, which include some formation manuals, which will help or teach his formation mage. How to make formation on large scale.
And some magic elementary books, so his mage can also learn basic spells.
"230 and 160 gold coins." Luke muttered before paying the price.
With that, his shopping for Mages done and now other things to buy.
But before that he have one more matter.
Luke turned toward Lucy, whose face also become little down. because she also knows, Luke is leaving and she don’t know. If she can ever able to meet him again.
"Lucy." Lucy, startled little, when she heard Luke voice and turned toward him.
There he was looking at her, which bring a little blush to her face. and she start fidgeting with her fingers.
"Lucy, do you have a moment to talk? Alone?" So when she heard, Luke asking her for talk and that would be Alone. Her face become even more red. So she replied, while stuttering. "Sure...Sir...Luke."
’Luke, sure don’t know. How much womanizer he have.’ system thought, while looking at Lucy red face.
After that both of them left the Eight Spell Tower. On the way many people saw them, with different expression, when they left, . But Luke didn’t care much about them and the same was with Lucy.
After leaving the tower, Luke didn’t bring Lucy to a fantasy restaurant.
Instead they start moving toward next destination, where he will buy different things for his territory.
So, while walking, he asked her about herself. On this she paused, and after a moment of hesitation she mention that her family name is Dawnvale and she is daughter of Baron.
Luke didn’t interupt her and listen her fully.

Then she mention her territory was Suncrest Vale with everything fine, untill one day. Consecutive crop failures happened, and Merchant caravans gradually stopped trading in Suncrest Vale. and many more.
So to fix the situation, her father took emergency loans with high interest, but coudn’t able to clear them on time, which leads to accumulated amount of gold coins.
Luke also feels sad on this, because earlier blackstone territory was also like this. and Aurielle was also facing the same situtaion.
"So how much debt, your family own?" then finally he asked the main question. On which her face changed and she become sad.
Seeing her face Luke felt maybe it was too much. But he didn’t said anything, instead waited for her reply.
Finally after waiting for a moment, with a little shaky voice she said. "Sir my house own 100k gold coins debt."
’What!!’ Luke, becomes completely shocked after hearing this. ’I know, her father took loans with heavy interest and coudn’t able to repay.’ But still that amount is completly crazy.
But then he thought about the person, who cursed Lucy and he understood. ’the same person is also responsible for this.’ with that he looked toward Lucy and saw her downcast expression.
"hmm... Lucy, if you want I can help your debt." So Luke with sympathy filled voice told her.
On which she become completely stunned, and stopped in the middle of road., which bring some curses from the surrounding crowd.
So Luke hurriedly hold her hand to bring her to sideways. and asked "if she is ok."
"huh?" Lucy, confused voice come, as she was earlier, become too confused and stunned after hearing about someone is going to pay her family all debt. then doubt comes into her mind.
’why would anyone do that.?’ with that thought, she look toward Luke, with little suspicious eyes, and another thought comes into her mind. ’is he really saying truth, if yes, then why?’
This questions still bugs her, Luke saw her confusion and suspicious face, so he understood.
So with a little laugh he told her. "Lucy, I am not doing that for free of course."
Lucy, eyes narrowed, as she also thought, ’yeah, who will give that much money for free.’
So while again contnuing their journey, Luke told her why he wants to help her.

"Lucy, I saw potential in you. and thought it would be waste to let it go. So I am willing to clear your debt and for that, you have to work for me or for my territory. Whichever you find sound best."
Lucy, heard Luke voice clearly then asked about his territory, to which Luke nodded and told her about his Blackstone Highlands territory, which just start getting rebuild and developing.
Lucy, become little surprise after finding, that Sir hero is already is Baron. because she didn’t know that before.
"Sir Luke, can I get some time to think?" Lucy after hearing everything, finally uttered those words and hoping to get some time to think.
Luke nodded and told her, that she have the time, while they are doing shopping.
Lucy felt it was not enough, But Luke didn’t say anything else, as they have already arrived at Alchemist Association which is named "Essence Research Hall."
The buidling, embelm was an "a human hand firmly holding an emerald flask."
It was also Six-story tall but was made of polished gray granite reinforced with bronze pillars.
So "why he come here first?" because for clearing Lucy debt and for his territory growth, he need more money,. so for that he have to separate with his Iron tempering knight stage potion.

yeah, he is about to sell those ’perfect quality potion.’ because maybe he will later get better rewards and maybe he can even buy some high tier potion for his territory with those money, rather than holding millions on him.
After entering the place, they met with large crowd, which consists of adventurers, merchants, other races. and many other beings, who is here to buy or sell potions. and even learn alchemist.
Though, he have herb mage with him in his territory. but she is not real alchemist and she also need to learn all of this.
Lucy expression didn’t change much from this. and this was not the first time for her here.
Though, she still can’t used to this crowd of Alchemist association, which shows their popularity, among masses were more than mage tower.
Because potions were consumable, while Mage scrolls were more costly, so used less.
After some time, they finally enter the Alchemist association inside. and there they found the counter. So with the help of assistance he first, bought the things, which he needed.
Of course, what else could be. it was all potions, of health and aether potion.
Potion Purchase ✅ Completed
Purchased:
F-Rank Health Potion × 10,000
F-Rank Aether Potion × 10,000
G-Rank Health Potion × 50,000
G-Rank Aether Potion × 50,000
Total Potions: 120,000
Total Cost: 9,500 Gold Coins
Lucy, again become surprised by the purchase amount. but thinking about Luke Baron identity, she find it acceptable, because he have to take care of his people.
After purchasing everything, Luke asked if there is some higher person present among them, like their manager.
The assistant, raised her eyebrow and asked Luke why. so He said, he have large batch of perfect quality Iron stage knight potion to sell.

The assistant got surprised on this and start thinking ’does the person is telling truth or not.’ but then she decided it’s better to call her manager, or else if she makes mistake here and the person really have real potion. then she would be doom.
"Sure sir, please follow me." With that she left the counter to other attendant and bring Luke and Lucy, to a separate private room.
Soon, some fruits, drinks and tea served to both of them on which they didn’t taste any, just waited.
The assistant didn’t mind and after a few minutes, a middle-aged man, looks early forty with ash gray hair and black eyes. Dressed in luxurious emerald-and-white formal attire, entered the room.
’Seems like manager’ Luke thought this and the same was Lucy as well. because this was the first time, she have seen the manager.
With a smile the Maxwell Dorian, greet both Luke and Lucy, then took the seat.
"Yes sir, how may I help you." He asked the main thing with a professional smile, on which Luke nodded and told him about his perfect quality potion, which also stabilized the realm after tempering.
Yup, he is selling only tempering potion, but not breakthrough. because those things can work on many occasion.
Maxwell Dorian got surprised by this. As only few people, sold this type of potion and prefer to rather use on themselves.
"Sure sir. Please show me the sample." he asked for a sample, on which Luke nodded and bring out one potion from his spatial ring, before presenting to the manager.
’Amazing!’ After checking the potion quality, Dorain thought. Because he have years of experience, in this field. So he instantly identified. That this potion is best and can be sold for good price.
While he was excited in the inside, Dorain face outside, didn’t show any change in emotion. But it was not same with Lucy, who got really surprised.
’Crazy!’ this thought, comes into her mind. Because Sir Luke was even selling things, which is only produce by high-tier Alchemist.
"Sir, how many you have this?" Dorain asked the real question. because if it’s one or two, then it’s will not make much profit, because of it’s Iron knight stage realm.
Luke noticed that Manager face didn’t show the any reaction. But he didn’t mind. as he also knows about this poker face trick form his previous world.
So he also placed his card. "This depends upon your price sir, Because if the price is suitable, then maybe I can sell 100k potion to you. now!"
Dorian and Lucy, eyes completely become wide after hearing the ridiculous amount.
Because even their this association can’t able to produce that much of this potion in a single day. they only produce, 40/60 perfect quality potion per month.
Lucy also got completly stunned from the amount. Because if Sir, Luke really sold those amount. This he can easily pay her territory debt.
Doran felt his poker face broke, so he cough and return back to his poker face and finally after deciding and negotiation, they decided to settle on different price.
The initial price was 20 gold coins, but after negotiation it was 22 gold coins each.
So for 100,000 potions. He got 2,200,000 Gold Coins. Which is 2.2million gold coins.
’Now I am rich for sure.’ Luke thought excitedly but still he, didn’t sell all the potion he have.
Because he don’t need that much money right now. and if he really need so he can sell again later.
’then why sold 100k?’ because for those amount of gold, only Golden knight can move. and now he don’t afraid them anymore. that’s why he sold this.
"Nice doing business with you sir and here our association Gold Card. with that you can get discount and other benefits.
He presented a gold card to Luke, while also telling different benefits to him, on which some were. 10% Discount, Monthly Premium Auction Invitation, VIP Reception Room, etc..
Luke nodded and took the card, then without buying anything more. he left the association building with stunned Lucy, who still didn’t come out of shock after seeing those large money.
So while they were leaving a white robbed man with black mask suddenly appeared beside the manager and asked, "sir, do we need to tail him.?"
Dorian, took out one cigar from his pocket and light up. Then he took a sip, before releasing puff of smoke outside.
Without even turning toward black masked man, he shook his head and said. "No need."
