So with a little laugh he told her.
"Lucy, I am not doing that for free of course."
Lucy, eyes narrowed, as she also thought, ’yeah, who will give that much money for free.’
So while again contnuing their journey, Luke told her why he wants to help her.
"Lucy, I saw potential in you. and thought it would be waste to let it go.
So I am willing to clear your debt and for that, you have to work for me or for my territory.
Whichever you find sound best."
Lucy, heard Luke voice clearly then asked about his territory, to which Luke nodded and told her about his Blackstone Highlands territory, which just start getting rebuild and developing.
Lucy, become little surprise after finding, that Sir hero is already is Baron. because she didn’t know that before.
"Sir Luke, can I get some time to think?" Lucy after hearing everything, finally uttered those words and hoping to get some time to think.
Luke nodded and told her, that she have the time, while they are doing shopping.
Lucy felt it was not enough, But Luke didn’t say anything else, as they have already arrived at Alchemist Association which is named "Essence Research Hall."
The buidling, embelm was an "a human hand firmly holding an emerald flask."
It was also Six-story tall but was made of polished gray granite reinforced with bronze pillars.
So "why he come here first?" because for clearing Lucy debt and for his territory growth, he need more money,. so for that he have to separate with his Iron tempering knight stage potion.

yeah, he is about to sell those ’perfect quality potion.’ because maybe he will later get better rewards and maybe he can even buy some high tier potion for his territory with those money, rather than holding millions on him.
After entering the place, they met with large crowd, which consists of adventurers, merchants, other races. and many other beings, who is here to buy or sell potions. and even learn alchemist.
Though, he have herb mage with him in his territory. but she is not real alchemist and she also need to learn all of this.
Lucy expression didn’t change much from this. and this was not the first time for her here.
Though, she still can’t used to this crowd of Alchemist association, which shows their popularity, among masses were more than mage tower.
Because potions were consumable, while Mage scrolls were more costly, so used less.
After some time, they finally enter the Alchemist association inside. and there they found the counter.
So with the help of assistance he first, bought the things, which he needed.
Of course, what else could be. it was all potions, of health and aether potion.
Potion Purchase ✅ Completed
Purchased:
F-Rank Health Potion × 10,000
F-Rank Aether Potion × 10,000
G-Rank Health Potion × 50,000
G-Rank Aether Potion × 50,000
Total Potions: 120,000
Total Cost: 9,500 Gold Coins
Lucy, again become surprised by the purchase amount. but thinking about Luke Baron identity, she find it acceptable, because he have to take care of his people.
After purchasing everything, Luke asked if there is some higher person present among them, like their manager.
The assistant, raised her eyebrow and asked Luke why. so He said, he have large batch of perfect quality Iron stage knight potion to sell.

The assistant got surprised on this and start thinking ’does the person is telling truth or not.’ but then she decided it’s better to call her manager, or else if she makes mistake here and the person really have real potion. then she would be doom.
"Sure sir, please follow me." With that she left the counter to other attendant and bring Luke and Lucy, to a separate private room.
Soon, some fruits, drinks and tea served to both of them on which they didn’t taste any, just waited.
The assistant didn’t mind and after a few minutes, a middle-aged man, looks early forty with ash gray hair and black eyes.
Dressed in luxurious emerald-and-white formal attire, entered the room.
’Seems like manager’ Luke thought this and the same was Lucy as well. because this was the first time, she have seen the manager.
With a smile the Maxwell Dorian, greet both Luke and Lucy, then took the seat.
"Yes sir, how may I help you." He asked the main thing with a professional smile, on which Luke nodded and told him about his perfect quality potion, which also stabilized the realm after tempering.
Yup, he is selling only tempering potion, but not breakthrough. because those things can work on many occasion.
Maxwell Dorian got surprised by this.
As only few people, sold this type of potion and prefer to rather use on themselves.
"Sure sir.
Please show me the sample." he asked for a sample, on which Luke nodded and bring out one potion from his spatial ring, before presenting to the manager.
’Amazing!’ After checking the potion quality, Dorain thought.
Because he have years of experience, in this field.
So he instantly identified.
That this potion is best and can be sold for good price.
While he was excited in the inside, Dorain face outside, didn’t show any change in emotion.
But it was not same with Lucy, who got really surprised.
’Crazy!’ this thought, comes into her mind.
Because Sir Luke was even selling things, which is only produce by high-tier Alchemist.
"Sir, how many you have this?" Dorain asked the real question. because if it’s one or two, then it’s will not make much profit, because of it’s Iron knight stage realm.
Luke noticed that Manager face didn’t show the any reaction.
But he didn’t mind. as he also knows about this poker face trick form his previous world.
So he also placed his card.
"This depends upon your price sir, Because if the price is suitable, then maybe I can sell 100k potion to you. now!"
Dorian and Lucy, eyes completely become wide after hearing the ridiculous amount.
Because even their this association can’t able to produce that much of this potion in a single day. they only produce, 40/60 perfect quality potion per month.
Lucy also got completly stunned from the amount.
Because if Sir, Luke really sold those amount.
This he can easily pay her territory debt.
Doran felt his poker face broke, so he cough and return back to his poker face and finally after deciding and negotiation, they decided to settle on different price.
The initial price was 20 gold coins, but after negotiation it was 22 gold coins each.
So for 100,000 potions.
He got 2,200,000 Gold Coins.
Which is 2.2million gold coins.
’Now I am rich for sure.’ Luke thought excitedly but still he, didn’t sell all the potion he have.
Because he don’t need that much money right now. and if he really need so he can sell again later.
’then why sold 100k?’ because for those amount of gold, only Golden knight can move. and now he don’t afraid them anymore. that’s why he sold this.
"Nice doing business with you sir and here our association Gold Card. with that you can get discount and other benefits.
He presented a gold card to Luke, while also telling different benefits to him, on which some were.
10% Discount, Monthly Premium Auction Invitation, VIP Reception Room, etc..
Luke nodded and took the card, then without buying anything more. he left the association building with stunned Lucy, who still didn’t come out of shock after seeing those large money.
So while they were leaving a white robbed man with black mask suddenly appeared beside the manager and asked, "sir, do we need to tail him.?"
Dorian, took out one cigar from his pocket and light up.
Then he took a sip, before releasing puff of smoke outside.
Without even turning toward black masked man, he shook his head and said.
"No need."

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Blackstone’s Greatest Crisis!
paragraphs: "Sir Luke, now where to?" Lucy finally came out of her shocked expression, then with more respect asked him about their next destination.
Luke paused slightly after noticing the tone change in Lucy’s voice, but he didn’t comment on this instead took out his list before saying, "Blacksmith Association."
Lucy nodded and along with Luke, they headed toward the Blacksmith Association building. After walking for a few minutes, they finally reached the building.
Even though it was not luxurious compared to the Magic Tower and Alchemist Association, it was still good, and smoke could be seen coming out before getting filtered by some magic arrays.
The whole place also gave the sense of cleanliness, which was remarkable for their blacksmith title.
In the Forgemaster Hall, that was the name of the Blacksmith Association building, they didn’t even have to spend much time and quickly bought everything what Luke’s was needed.
Which was, of course, weapons, armor, and some raw ingots, along with some weapon and armor blueprints.
Following that, he checked the basic short summary of the products.
| G-Rank Blueprints | 10 Gold 80 Silver Coins |
| F-Rank Blueprints | 11 Gold Coins |
| Materials & Tools | 261 Gold Coins |
| Finished Equipment (110,000 pieces) | 66,000 Gold Coins |
| Grand Total | 66,282 Gold 80 Silver Coins |
Lucy also saw the price, but this time didn’t become shocked and just quietly followed after Luke, who was nodding with satisfaction while checking the list.
After that, they reached other locations as well. There, they bought farm materials, like wheat seeds and other seeds along with livestock.
Then again he checked the basic summary.
| Seeds | 2,500 Gold |
| Fruit Saplings | 700 Gold |
| Livestock | 13,500 Gold |
| Farming Equipment | 1,800 Gold |
| Animal Supplies | 500 Gold |
| Total | 19,000 Gold Coins |
Though Luke have stored most of the purchased items in his spatial ring, but since livestock couldn’t be stored inside, he arranged for them to be delivered to his territory later.
"Can’t be helped." Luke sighed, then gave the advance payment, while the rest would be given when they reached the territory.
Finally, the shopping was finished, which brought relief to Lucy’s face.
"Too tiring!" she said after slumping down on the wooden bench.
Luke also sat down beside her and gave her a bottle of water.
She took it, thanking him before gulping down the whole bottle of water.
After finishing drinking, she turned toward Luke, who was now watching the pedestrians passing by with a calm expression.
’Should I take his help?’ she thought, with reduced hesitation toward his offer.
Even though the time she spent with Luke can’t be said to be much. But he seems to be a genuine person. ’And also rich.’ this thought came into her mind, while thinking about those ridiculous deals.
’But becoming his employee...’ On this, she sighed and leaned against the bench, while looking toward the sky.
Luke, who was just watching the people passing, noticed Lucy’s actions. So he said to her, "If you are worried about your freedom, then be not."
Lucy heard Luke’s voice, to which she slowly turned toward him.
Who was now looking straight into her eyes. Then he continued.
"I want you to work for me for 5 years. After that, you can go whenever you want, and I will give you a salary and better equipment, skills, and scrolls during that duration."
Lucy became even more surprised after hearing this. Because previously, Luke didn’t mention this.
So after thinking for a moment, she found that this was a very good deal and one of the most important things.

Lucy paused her thoughts and looked straight toward Luke’s blue eyes. ’Sir Luke is helping me when I need help the most.’ Only this thought kept her here all this time, or else she would not have come with him.
Because she also knew she was talented. Of course, not the part which Luke said. But yeah, she knew magic pretty well.
So... she had some good future, if her family’s debt was removed. But..."I agree." In the end, she agreed.
On this, a large smile appeared on Luke’s face. Lucy saw this, and a thought came into her mind, ’This might be not bad.’ and a smile also appeared on her face as well.
With that, Luke shook her hand, which confused her. So he told it was a common custom from his world, where if something was settled down, they shook hands with each other.

After everything was done and hiring Lucy. Luke didn’t give her the money immediately. Instead, he told her to pack her things and come to his territory first. After that, they would return to her territory, and there he would pay the money.
Lucy’s expression became a little conflicted after hearing this, because now she had to suddenly leave the tower during her mid-study, and the payment was also not upfront.
But then Luke added, "The amount is very high, which can easily lead to some robbers targeting you."
Which calmed down Lucy somewhat, and she nodded before moving toward the Magic Tower, though she still gave one last look toward him before continuing.
[😎👍👍 Awesome Luke!!] the system praised Luke for its strategy to lure the Heavenly Virtue Carrier to his territory.
Luke nodded to the system, but completely ignored the luring part.
"Let’s also return." Luke murmured this after noticing that it was afternoon already. And while moving, he hoped Aurielle and the others should have returned.
Inside the luxurious mansion, many beautiful noblewomen were dancing and enjoying their drinks.
Aurielle leaned back in her chair, leisurely sipping her wine, when Nyra suddenly asked, "Lady Aurielle, how is Sir Luke?"
On this, she turned toward her. There Nyra was at some moment, having appeared beside her with a drink in her hand.
"He is fine." She only said this and turned back again toward the dance.
Nyra saw Aurielle’s cold reaction, but didn’t mind and got close to her, then asked again with a shy voice.
"Lady Aurielle, what’s Sir Luke like? Like his choices regarding fruits or anything special he likes?"

Aurielle, who was forced to come here by Margaret, was now regretting the decision. Again heard Nyra’s question, on which her eyes twitched, especially the part about Luke’s likes, so without thinking, a sentence escaped her mouth.
"He likes to go rough."
"O_O"
Nyra stared at Aurielle with her mouth agape. Only after a moment did Aurielle realize what she had just blurted out, causing her cheeks to redden with embarrassment.
’Everything, all that pervert’s fault.’ She put all the blame on Luke, to convince herself that it was not her fault at all.

But Nyra’s imagination was already running wild. ’He likes to go rough!!!’ Nyra’s face also became red. On this, Aurielle gave her a speechlees look. ’Young woman, don’t think too much.’ But sadly, Nyra was already lost in her thoughts.
So Aurielle just shook her head and turned sideways. There, Vaelira was also just standing and didn’t even touch any food from the start.
"Why don’t you remove your mask and try some food?" Aurielle said, looking at Vaelira with a hint of curiosity. She couldn’t help but wonder what lay behind the mask.
But Vaelira didn’t respond immediately. Only a moment later, she said, "I can remove this mask only in front of Master."
Aurielle’s eyebrow twitched again at her words. ’Master here!, Master there!’ She thought irritably, while shaking her head.
’There’s already one woman in the territory who keeps clinging to him, and now he’s brought another one.’ Annoyed by the thought, Aurielle downed her entire drink in one gulp.
But the moment she finished her drink, one maid came to her, "Lady Aurielle, there is a letter for you." simultaneously showing the letter.

"Huh?" Aurielle got surprised. ’Who would have sent a letter to me?’ Just as she was thinking this, she saw the letter contained the Blackstone Highlands territory seal. ’The letter from the Territory!’
Seeing this, a bad premonition rose into her heart, and immediately she tore the seal before reading the full content inside.
Nyra and Vaelira, from the side, also saw this scene, so they got close to Aurielle and waited for her to read the letter.
"This is bad!" A few moments later, Aurielle exclaimed with urgency, which surprised both of them. So Nyra asked what happened.
Aurielle turned toward Nyra and told her that Viscount Ashenford had attacked the Blackstone Highlands and already captured all the villages and towns surrounding the territory.
"What!" Nyra also got shocked by this news, even though she did hear about Ashenford’s one son and his brother’s disappearance from Blackstone territory, and they had a valid reason to attack.
But she didn’t expect them to attack now and without even waiting for her birthday party to be over.
"I have to go." Aurielle said to Nyra, and with Vaelira, they turned to leave while also picking Margaret from the maids lounge.
"Lady Aurielle, if you need my help, please tell me. I will ask my father about this." Nyra’s voice from behind reached her.
On this, Aurielle paused slightly, and her face changed to distrust. Because she still remembered the past incident, that’s why. She didn’t want to trust the Count family again.
Still, she nodded at Nyra and didn’t answer anything. ’First, I have to tell this to Luke.’ She didn’t know why. But she felt only Luke could help in this situation.
With that, they finally left.
Meanwhile, inside the Count Mansion.
In the study room.
Count Stormveil was reading the latest report from the Blackstone Highlands, while his expression became darker and darker.
"So, Ashenford finally made his move." He placed the report on the table and looked outside the window. "I knew he wouldn’t let this matter go."
Standing beside him, his butler remained silent.
"My Lord, should we intervene?" the butler finally asked.
Count Stormveil shook his head.
"Not yet."
"If Luke can’t even survive something like this, then he isn’t worthy of standing on the stage of this kingdom."
The butler nodded.
"But..." The Count’s eyes narrowed.
"If Ashenford crosses the bottom line..."
"...then I will have to remind him whose territory this truly is."
A terrifying pressure instantly spread throughout the room before quickly disappearing again.
The butler lowered his head even further. "As expected of my Lord."
The Count waved his hand. "Continue monitoring the situation."
"Yes, my Lord."

chapters.title: Chapter 109: The Road Home Became a Death Trap!
paragraphs: When Luke returned back to the Inn, he found that Aurielle and the others had already returned. But he felt the atmosphere was something off.
’Why does everyone seem angry?’ This thought suddenly came into his mind after noticing that many knights, even Kai, had faces filled with anger.
’Did something happen with Aurielle and the others??’ A bad premonition rose into his heart, so with hurried footsteps and a worried expression, he made his way toward the upper floor.
On the way, he also nodded to the cat woman’s greeting. Though when he passed by her, she was giving him a different look, ’like he had dirtied her place.’
But as Luke was in a hurry, he didn’t think much about that.
Soon, Luke arrived at his room. There, he found Aurielle sitting quietly on the bed, staring out the window with a distant look in her eyes.
But seeing her safe, a relief washed over his heart.
After that, Luke walked over to her, wrapped her in a gentle hug, and planted a few kisses on her cheek before asking, "Honey, what’s wrong?"

Aurielle, who had been lost in thought over the Ashenford attack and was thinking the countermeasures against it, snapped out of her thoughts when she felt Luke’s loving embrace and the gentle kisses on her cheeks.
Which also relaxed her.
Then she told him everything about the letter. For a few minutes, Luke just listened with a serious face, and when she finally finished, he asked her a question.
"How many Golden Knights do they have?"
"Only the Viscount is a Mid Golden Knight, while he also has two Early Golden Knights, his commander and vice commander."
After hearing the answer, Luke calculated. He also had some measures against Golden Knights. It’s just he had to face a real Golden Knight to find their real strength in a proper battle.
’I hope the system will unlock the third Titan before the big battle.’ Because right now, he can’t use the 5x or 3x strength multiplier from his Titan Transformation form, only 1x is available.
"And what about their military strength?" Luke asked her, on which she also told him their numbers, which she had found and heard before.
Total Military Strength
Category Number
Golden Knights 3
Silver Knights 100
Bronze Knights 1,000
Iron Knights 30,000
Body Tempering 100,000
"This!" Luke became shocked after seeing the huge numbers. Aurielle mentioned that normally Viscount forces are not that high.
But he got some backing, which resulted in him growing so much.

After thinking for a moment, he said to Aurielle, "Okay, you don’t have to worry. I will take care of it." With that, he got up and prepared to leave the Count territory first, then fly back to Blackstone Highlands.
Seeing Luke’s reaction, Aurielle had already guessed what he was about to do. "If you’re thinking of returning to the territory, then I’m coming with you," she said firmly.
Luke paused at this and thought for a second before nodding. Because in her peak form, she could also exhibit Golden Knight raw power.
CREEEK!
With that, Luke opened the gate of the Inn room and got surprised.
There in the front, Vaelira was standing and was now looking straight into his eyes before saying, "Master, I also want to go."
"Sigh." Luke sighed and nodded, because her strength was also very useful.

Then they reached the ground floor. There, Margaret and Kai suddenly came forward. "My Lord, Master." and greeted, but just as they were about to continue, Luke raised his hand to stop them and said firmly, "No!"
Both of them got stunned, because they didn’t even say anything. But Luke could already guess that they also wanted to come with them.
So after declining this, he also told them that one young girl with the name Lucy Dawnvale would come here. After that, return back to the territory with her and make sure everyone would be safe.
The last part was directed at Kai, who immediately saluted and shouted, "YES, MASTER!" Luke nodded in satisfaction before handing him a Whispering Tide Conch and explaining how to use it.
Everyone was surprised by the new artifact, that Luke had brought out, but he paid little attention to their reactions and headed toward Stormveil County’s main gate with Aurielle and Vaelira.
Though just after leaving the Inn, Luke felt a lioness’s gaze, which was like a dagger, along with came a loving voice. "Who is Lucy~"
But that voice seemed wrong, like it wanted to open up his mind and find out the girl’s identity.
"A girl who was getting bullied, and I saved her." Luke only said this and With that he increased his speed, without giving Aurielle more chance to ask him about Lucy.
"Tch." Aurielle clicked her tongue in irritation after seeing Luke’s behavior and narrowed her eyes. "Sus..."
Vaelira also saw this scene and added another name to her mental note, which contained the names of the women or girls who had fallen for Master. ’Lucy.’
As the celebration was over, the people’s flow had decreased inside the territory, and it could be seen at the main gate as well.
"Stay in line!" the guards shouted at the people waiting in the queue, while their eyes constantly scanning the surroundings to keep everything under control.
"Let’s go." Luke said to them, and they nodded. After that, he first transformed into the Faceless Titan, then instantly transformed into Sylvarion.
Soon, a 15-foot-tall winged giant man with long silver hair appeared in front of everyone.
"What’s this!!!" Everyone exclaimed and backed away instantly from the winged giant. While the guards at the gate also gave wary glances toward Luke, who had just become a giant.

’Isn’t this the hero from last time?’ The same Peak Silver Knight guard captain thought, while remembering the scene when they came. At that time, they were mocked by everyone, and now all of them were backing away after seeing his strength.
"His knights are not here." The attendant beside him added, on which he nodded but didn’t dwell on this.
"Well, as long as he doesn’t attack." With that, he leaned back in his chair and returned to his sleep.
Luke ignored the reaction of the surrounding people and held Aurielle and Vaelira in his hand. Then, with a heavy swing, he flew straight to the sky.
WHOSSSH!
"Damn it! I got sand in my mouth." Because of this, many people got the taste of sand, and among them, the same merchant from Ashenford territory was also included.
"HOLD TIGHT!" Luke said to them, on which they increased the strength of their grip on his hand.
Soon, the wind speed around him increased, and his whole body started glowing with a green glow, which further increased the speed of the wind around him.
"FAST!" He shouted, and with that, swung his wings even faster and soon his speed reached a very high level.
’When will they come?’ Corvus Kaine was hiding between tree branches and was looking toward the main road, which connected Blackstone Highlands with Stormveil County.
He was getting bored. Even though he was a bona fide Executioner-rank assassin from the black hand, but still sending him to hunt down an Iron Knight was really too much.
With that, he recalled the mission. "Only kill the hero and don’t touch Aurielle Valmont!"
"Whatever." Corvus muttered and brought a drink from his black-robed pocket. "I hope they come fast so I can go and deal with the other mission soon." With a sigh, he started drinking.

’Huh??’ But just a few moments later, his Raven Familiar, which was created by his technique, Raven Blade Human Ascension Series, gave him a signal that something was flying very fast toward this direction.
So he shifted his senses to his Raven, which was one kilometer away from him and was made entirely of his aether.
’A giant bird?’ He looked toward the sky and got confused. There, a 15-foot person with a 40-foot-long wingspan was flying and heading toward Blackstone Highlands.
’Winged race?’ He thought confusedly, because he had seen them, but they were not that big. So when he focused more, he found out that the winged man was holding two people in his hand.

After focusing more, he soon found the identity of one person. ’Aurielle Valmont?’ But this made him even more confused. Because Corvus didn’t know anything about Luke’s ability at all, which created this confusion.
"Whatever, then I will ask the princess about Luke’s whereabouts." With that, he ordered his small black aether Raven to fly toward them.
"Huh?" Luke was flying very fast, so he didn’t notice when a small black raven suddenly came in front of him. Only when he was about to collide with it did he notice it.
But before he could collide with the raven, Corvus snapped his fingers in the distance.
BANG!
With a bang, the raven exploded into many feathers.
Luke got startled, hurriedly raised his wing to shield Aurielle and Vaelira, but this also reduced his speed.
’Gotcha!’ Corvus thought excitedly, and the next moment, those feathers burst into black smoke, which made Luke and the others completely blind.
’Ambush!’ This thought immediately came into their minds, and Luke tried to swing his wings to remove the black smoke with the help of the wind, which surprisingly didn’t move at all.

But he felt the atmosphere was something off.
’Why does everyone seem angry?’ This thought suddenly came into his mind after noticing that many knights, even Kai, had faces filled with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Golden Knight Aurora!
paragraphs: So he tried to move away from the location, but the black smoke had stuck to him like glue, and the surroundings within 100 meters couldn’t be seen at all.
"Aurielle! Vaelira! Be careful." Luke warned them and again tried to make some distance from the black smoke.

’It’s not easy to escape my C-rank Ascension Series.’ Corvus thought excitedly, then brought out one dagger, and the next instant, the dagger got covered with black feathers as well. After that, crimson lines formed on it.
"Raven’s Talon!" Corvus said before throwing it straight toward Luke with full confidence. Because even though he was at the Early Golden Knight stage.
He had even killed a Mid Golden Knight with the help of this skill.
SHRINK!
Suddenly, a raven’s cry echoed for an instant as the dagger flew straight toward the winged man’s heart, while leaving behind a crescent of black energy shaped like a raven’s wing.
’Danger.’ Luke’s Titan instinct screamed at him, but before he could react, a dagger covered with raven feathers instantly appeared near his heart.
Tang!
Fortunately, a tang sound was heard, which indicated that the dagger had faced an obstacle and couldn’t pierce the target.
Yeah, Luke was still wearing those Seven Queen Wards. So when the ring sensed a life-threatening situation, it summoned a barrier around its bearer.
But because Luke’s body was bigger than before, so rather than a spherical shield, a frontal shield appeared, which successfully blocked the attack.
"Eclipse Arrow."
While this was happening, Vaelira summoned her bow from the spatial ring and attacked toward the direction from where the dagger came.
WHOSSSH!
Corvus, who had gritted his teeth at the failure, didn’t notice when an arrow suddenly appeared beside him.
BANG!
"THIS!" His pupils dilated when the tree beside him was completely destroyed, and he didn’t even know when the attack came.
Luckily for him, Vaelira didn’t know his earlier position, or Corvus would have at least been injured by the attack.
But his relaxation didn’t last long, as another arrow came, but this time it was a freaking gigantic arrow.
’What the f**k!’ He cursed and used his Raven Veil to hide himself with the help of the surrounding shadows and moved away from his earlier location.

Luke released both Aurielle and Vaelira into the air. On this, Aurielle summoned her Armour Shadow Wings ability to fly. But sadly, her armour main ability was on cooldown. So no Queen Descent ability.
Meanwhile, Vaelira used the trees to land safely, but while mid-air, she attacked again toward the same location with a Titan Breaker Arrow.
"Voltrax." Luke instantly transformed back into the Faceless Titan before transforming into the Thunder Titan. Then he used Form Assimilation of Sylvarion and summoned its wings on Voltrax’s back.
Soon, Nullex also surrounded his body, and he used his special ability toward the location where the attacker should be.
"Thunderfall!"
’Damn it!’ Corvus cursed while dodging here and there, as more and more arrows and shadow attacks kept coming toward his location.
Corvus mood was getting worse with each moment. because his target was missing, and now he was being pushed back by people who were of a lower realm than him.
But then he heard the winged man’s loud voice and looked toward it.
’What the!!!’ His eyes widened because there in the distance, large storm clouds suddenly gathered around the winged man and kept releasing lightning toward his back.

On this, Corvus felt dread toward the ongoing scene, and only one thought came into his mind. ’I will die if that person succeeds in what he is doing.’ So without wasting any time, he poured all of his aether into his attacking move.
’There.’ Vaelira, who kept trying to track the location of the attacker, instantly felt the flow of aether, and Aurielle also noticed this. Then both of them summoned their ultimate abilities.
"Abyssal Destruction!"
"Celestial Hunt: Final Descent!"
A 10-meter-long dark-purple blade, entirely made of shadow aether, appeared above Aurielle, and with one hand motion, she threw it toward the attacker.
The same was with Vaelira, but her attack came from the sky and was nearly undetectable by Corvus.
’What!!!’ Corvus’ pupils dilated when he felt another attack coming, which was even more powerful than the lightning winged man’s, but he couldn’t find it.
’I should have run.’ His facial expression became ugly, and he felt regret about revealing his location.
Luke charged his spine bones and armour fully with lightning. Even though his current raw strength and aether were only at Peak Bronze Knight,
his attack power contained the pure destruction of lightning, which could even threaten an Early Golden Knight.

"Why?" Because he was now a Bronze Knight. ’A real Bronze Knight.’ So his aether was more refined than before, which was the reason his power was also higher. Even though its quantity had become lower, its quality had become higher.
"DIE!" With that, he released the lightning beam that he had gathered in his horns, and the result.
BOOOOOM!
The surrounding trees were instantly blasted apart, while the attacker was seriously injured and was on his last breath.
But Corvus didn’t even get the time to breathe because another attack came from the sky along with Aurielle’s attack as well.
’Hah.’ Seeing death coming toward him, Corvus laughed in his mind. Because never would he have thought of dying by a lower-realm enemy. And now here he was.
’Well, whatever. Aurielle Valmont, your territory is doomed for sure.’ While thinking of the information he had gotten before, he closed his eyes, and the next moment.
BOOOM! BANG!

When Aurielle’s attack collided with his body, a small explosion occurred, which destroyed the already destroyed land even more. Then Vaelira’s silent gigantic arrow also came and blasted apart his body, along with everything.
Luke and the others looked toward the destruction. Seeing no further movement, they took deep breaths to calm down themselves and again looked around warily for possible other ambushes or enemies.
But seeing that even after a few minutes, no one was coming, they relaxed somewhat and took a rest near one large tree to recover their lost aether and stamina.
"This should be sent by Ashenford." Aurielle said to Luke while resting, who nodded but didn’t comment on this.
Because when he would face the Ashenford army, then he would show them ’what’s hell.’

After resting for a few minutes, they finally recovered their stamina somewhat. With that, Luke again transformed into Sylvarion and picked up both of them before heading straight toward their territory.

While he was flying high above the ground, [Luke, the third Titan is available for summon!] he heard the system’s mechanical voice, which excited him. But still, he would check this after reaching his territory.
So, while flying, they looked down and saw that many villages and towns now had the Ashenford family flag.
"Bastard." Even though Luke knew he would deal with them soon, seeing their territory captured left a bad taste in his mouth.
But one thing reassured him: after defeating the Ashenford family, they could capture their territory as well. So they would be the final winner.
Fortunately, this time Luke was flying very high, and that’s why the people present below didn’t notice that three people had crossed their barricades.
Yeah, they had blocked the Blackstone Highlands’ main roads, so the Blackstone Highlands would not be able to get any help quickly. And they could capture the territory completely.
Soon, Luke and the others reached the territory, which was situated at the peak of a mountain beside the Stormhowl Mountains.

Luke looked down and found that the territory was almost become empty. And Only some pedestrians were buying things. But still, many were hiding inside their rooms, hoping that the Ashenford army would not harm them.
He also noticed that none of those merchants and Adventurer groups could be seen.
"Seems like they also got the news of the blockade, so they chose to pay the toll money and leave the territory." Aurielle said from beside him.
On this Luke’s expression became uglier because he had worked hard to clear the surroundings so merchants could come to their territory. But now all of his work had gone to waste.
Aurielle saw Luke’s expression but didn’t say anything, as she knew that all of them were waiting for the final winner. After that, they would start their trade again.
"Master!!!"
While they were talking and thinking, a loud voice suddenly came from inside the Lord’s Estate.
There, Aurora, normally dressed in a loose robe, was running toward them with a large smile.
Cough! Cough!
Running toward Luke with a large smile.
So just as Luke landed and transformed back into human form, Aurora, with a sudden burst of speed, instantly appeared in front of Luke and hugged him tightly while shouting, "Master, I missed you!"
’What!!!’ Luke, Aurielle, and Vaelira got shocked upon this, because just now, they couldn’t track her movements with their eyes.
It meant only one thing. ’Golden Knight!!!’ At this, a big smile appeared on Luke’s face.
Meanwhile, Aurielle’s face twitched because now she couldn’t control Aurora anymore. And she could already see the result.
Because there, Aurora was pressing her big breasts hard against Luke’s chest, and with each excited motion, she was also rubbing them against him.
’You are feeling so good already.’ Aurielle narrowed her eyes when she noticed Luke smiling with his horny smile, which was clearly a misunderstanding.

While Aurielle was misunderstanding the situation, Vaelira got surprised by Aurora’s actions and thought, ’Another woman, and even stronger than the previous one.’ So with that, she added a new name to her mental note, which seemed to keep increasing with each passing day.
"Darling~ are you done enjoying?" When Luke was happily smiling at the news of a Golden Knight appearing in their territory, he heard Aurielle’s somewhat dangerous voice.

’Huh?’ He got confused. Why would her voice be dangerous? After all, Aurora was just hugging him normally...! But the next instant, his eyes became wide. Be-because... there Aurora was pressing her big breasts heavily against him, a-and! ’They are soft...! What the f**k!’
[kekeke! Ye boy!]
Luke instantly shook his head to remove those dangerous thoughts, as well as the system’s weird words from his previous world, and then tried to remove Aurora’s strong grip.
Because behind him, he could feel Aurielle’s gaze becoming more and more dangerous with each passing moment.

"Aurora, that’s enough. Give me some space to breathe." So Luke finally decided to stop those big soft things and said this to Aurora, on which she paused and slowly separated from Luke with a sorry expression.
Because in her happiness, she didn’t even notice that she was nearly choking her Master.

"Seems like they also got the news of the blockade, so they chose to pay the toll money and leave the territory." Aurielle said from beside him.
On this Luke’s expression became uglier because he had worked hard to clear the surroundings so merchants could come to their territory.
But now all of his work had gone to waste.
Aurielle saw Luke’s expression but didn’t say anything, as she knew that all of them were waiting for the final winner.
After that, they would start their trade again.
"Master!!!"
While they were talking and thinking, a loud voice suddenly came from inside the Lord’s Estate.
There, Aurora, normally dressed in a loose robe, was running toward them with a large smile.
Cough!
Cough!
Running toward Luke with a large smile.
So just as Luke landed and transformed back into human form, Aurora, with a sudden burst of speed, instantly appeared in front of Luke and hugged him tightly while shouting, "Master, I missed you!"
’What!!!’ Luke, Aurielle, and Vaelira got shocked upon this, because just now, they couldn’t track her movements with their eyes.
It meant only one thing. ’Golden Knight!!!’ At this, a big smile appeared on Luke’s face.
Meanwhile, Aurielle’s face twitched because now she couldn’t control Aurora anymore.
And she could already see the result.
Because there, Aurora was pressing her big breasts hard against Luke’s chest, and with each excited motion, she was also rubbing them against him.
’You are feeling so good already.’ Aurielle narrowed her eyes when she noticed Luke smiling with his horny smile, which was clearly a misunderstanding.

While Aurielle was misunderstanding the situation, Vaelira got surprised by Aurora’s actions and thought, ’Another woman, and even stronger than the previous one.’ So with that, she added a new name to her mental note, which seemed to keep increasing with each passing day.
"Darling~ are you done enjoying?" When Luke was happily smiling at the news of a Golden Knight appearing in their territory, he heard Aurielle’s somewhat dangerous voice.
’Huh?’ He got confused.
Why would her voice be dangerous?
After all, Aurora was just hugging him normally...!
But the next instant, his eyes became wide.
Be-because... there Aurora was pressing her big breasts heavily against him, a-and! ’They are soft...!
What the f**k!’
[kekeke!
Ye boy!]
Luke instantly shook his head to remove those dangerous thoughts, as well as the system’s weird words from his previous world, and then tried to remove Aurora’s strong grip.
Because behind him, he could feel Aurielle’s gaze becoming more and more dangerous with each passing moment.
"Aurora, that’s enough.
Give me some space to breathe." So Luke finally decided to stop those big soft things and said this to Aurora, on which she paused and slowly separated from Luke with a sorry expression.
Because in her happiness, she didn’t even notice that she was nearly choking her Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: What Came Out of Those Scrolls...
paragraphs: "Sorry, Master." Aurora murmured, lowering her gaze.
Luke finally relaxed and looked behind. There, Aurielle was still glaring at him. On this, he gave her an awkward smile to calm down the situation.
Soon, other people from the territory also appeared with excited smiles on their faces.
"My Lord!!!" After everyone arrived, they kneeled with respect to their lord, who had just returned from his journey.
Seeing the loyalty of everyone, a genuine smile appeared on Aurielle’s face, and her previous emotions also calmed down. Because she was genuinely happy for her husband.

"Rise!" After a while, Luke said to everyone, upon which all of them stood up. Following that, he ordered everyone to come inside the Time Chamber, and there he was also going to check the status of the territory during his absence.
Inside the Time Chamber, everything was the same as before. The forest, mountains, and rivers. Nothing changed at all during his absence, which was really a miracle.
’Seems like growth inside the Time Chamber is fixed for this terrain.’ Luke observed and asked Osric about the status of what had happened until now.
Osric came toward Luke and explained that everything started this morning. "My Lord, all of a sudden, we saw smoke rising from almost all the villages and towns present below the mountains."
"After observing this from above, we even saw the flag of the Ashenford family placed there."
"Which confirmed that they had attacked our territory."
"As this news appeared among the masses, panic spread among everyone, and all the merchants and adventurers chose to flee the territory, while the citizens locked themselves behind their gates."
Luke listened seriously to everything, and after Osric had finished narrating, he asked one important question.
"Is their Golden Knight here?" At this question, everyone’s faces changed, as all of them had heard of the terror of a Golden Knight. that what’s Luke thought.
Osric again told what had actually happened. "My Lord, one Early Golden Knight, who was the Ashenford Vice Commander, indeed come, but—"
He paused at this and gave a fearful look toward Aurora, who kept trying to get near Luke. But Aurielle was holding her loose robe to stop her.
The same was true for the other people as well. At this, Luke already felt what had happened before, but he still asked for confirmation.
Osric came out of his earlier thoughts after hearing Luke’s question again. So he told him the scene, which was too absurd.
"My Lord, the Ashenfor Vice Commander did bring all his elites, which included hundreds of Silver Knights and thousands of Bronze Knights."
"B-But... Lady Aurora, alone, with her Early Golden Knight Stage strength, beat all of them so badly that they had to run back down."
"Even their Golden Knight got seriously injured."
"o-o"
Everyone lowered their heads after hearing this. Because they also wanted to show their strength, but she alone overwhelmed the enemy.
Luke also got surprised and turned to look toward Aurora, who had somehow managed to reach him, even with her loose robe getting pulled back.
And because of this, the clear outline of her breast shape could be seen through the robe.
’She shouldn’t wear a loose robe again.’ With this thought, he smiled and praised Aurora while patting her head.
"Aurora is a good girl."
"Master~" Aurora muttered with a lost voice after hearing her master’s praise and his gentle touch, which brought a big smile to her face.
’Is this the same monster who beat every enemy with her hands?’ A big question mark appeared on everyone’s faces after seeing Lady Aurora’s expression.
Because after she badly injured the Golden Knight, she used her hands to keep beating him, even when he was running back.
At that time, the Blackstone Legion even felt that they were the bullies and felt sympathy toward the Golden Knight, who was giving Aurora a look. ’You guys are monsters.’
Meanwhile, Aurielle facepalmed at this scene with a resigned expression. But after a few moments, she let it be.
Because she also knew that even though Aurora’s body was definitely top-tier and mature, her mind was like that of a teenage girl. So she just wanted her master’s attention.
And after hearing that Aurora single-handedly defended their territory.
All the remaining little bit of jealousy she felt toward Aurora also got removed.
But then she heard Vaelira’s voice from the side. "She is again clinging to Master."
At this, Aurielle turned toward them and also saw that somehow, while Luke was patting her head, she got close and was now again pressing her breasts against him while sticking to him like a koala.
’This...’ Aurielle shook her head, then moved toward Aurora and separated her from the happy Luke. ’Yeah, he is surely happy by being pressed by those big melons.’
Aurielle’s brow twitched, and she gave Luke a shameless glare, upon which he flinched and removed his smile.
Then she brought Aurora toward their earlier location.
"Cough! Cough!" Luke coughed to hide his embarrassment and became serious.
"Seems like they want to cut off our supply or external help, while waiting for further reinforcements from their territory." Luke said to everyone, upon which Osric and Aurielle nodded.
As they also felt this was likely the case.
But on this, Luke laughed slightly. "Sadly for them, the more time we got, the stronger we become."
Hearing their lord’s words, everyone got confused. So Luke told them that, with the help of the Time Chamber, all of them could train fast in a few days.
But this created another problem, which was what they would train?, because breaking through a realm took time.
Luke also offered the solution for this.
"I have done some shopping in the Count’s territory, and with that, everyone can become stronger."
When Luke finished this, everyone’s expressions brightened, and they became excited about the things their lord had purchased.
Luke didn’t let them wait for too long and instantly opened his treasury, then brought out all the summoning scrolls.
Because all the present people were his trustworthy army and had already been bound with Aurora Chains, so he could completely do this small summoning thing.
’This!’
Everyone became surprised after seeing so many magic scrolls. But the Blackstone Legion didn’t get surprised by seeing summoning scrolls.

Though it was not the same for Osric, Edmund, and some others. Even Aurielle got surprised by the sheer amount, which made her confused, because she didn’t believe that Luke could bought so large quantity of these summoning magic scrolls, atleast in Count territory.
’From where did these come?? Again, Goddess of Luck?’ So she thought this, on which she again gave Luke a look, but no one knew the meaning behind that.
"COME FORTH!" While they were thinking all kinds of things, Luke shouted and ordered the System to use all the scrolls.
[Now, even this little work. I have to do that. 😒] The System, with a grumbling voice, followed the command.
Luke’s face twitched at the System’s grumbling, but soon returned to normal while replying in his mind. ’You are my System, and you should at least do that much.’
The System ignored Luke’s bickering. Instead, the next moment,
- Peak Wild Beast Realm Warhorses (Iron Knight equivalent) x 1,000 (Male)
- Peak Iron Knight Archers x 1,000 (Male)
- Peak Marinthian Coral Guards x 100 (Male)
Magic scrolls from the System Space disappeared one by one, and thousands of magic circles appeared all over the area. Forests, mountains, and even the river bank got fully covered by them.

"WHAT!!!" Even though everyone had already guessed what was going to happen, still seeing so many magic circles appearing at the same time made them very excited, and some even exclaimed loudly at this.
WHOSSSSH!
With a gust of wind, one thousand fully armoured male knights, along with weapons, and the same for the warhorses as well, which were heavily armoured, appeared on the field.
So even if some arrows or weapons collided with them, they could easily block them.

But when one hundred Marinthian Coral Guards of the Tide Keeper Realm appeared on the river bank, the whole surrounding suddenly became wet, and water molecules from the river started floating toward the surrounding vicinity.

At first, many people got confused by the sudden wetness, but when they focused on the unit near the river bank and felt their aura, which was clearly similar to Silver Rank, So after focusing they confirmed it was really Silver Rank equivalent and exclaimed, "Silver Rank??? 100!!!"
They became completely shocked. Because you couldn’t even see a single Silver Knight in many Baron Territories, but now their lord had summoned hundreds of them!! ’Crazy!’
If someone saw this scene, then they would definitely say, ’This is Viscount-level upper force.’
"MASTER!!!"
"NEEEIGHHH!!!"
Then everyone present heard their loud voices as they knelt toward Luke, while the warhorses neighed and they also got down on their legs toward Luke.
’Awesome!’ This thought came into everyone’s minds because their lord had just gained the loyalty of thousands of beasts and hundreds of Silver Rank experts.
Which was absurd. Because from what they had heard, even if someone used magic scrolls for summoning, then they had to subdue the summons first to gain their recognition.
While everyone praised Luke heavily in their minds, Luke was just smiling toward everyone.
Because the System products came with absolute loyalty, so he didn’t have to face the situation that normal summoners faced.
"RISE!" Luke’s order echoed through the surroundings, and every new summon immediately stood up.
After that, he observed them.
First, he checked the Wild Beast Realm Warhorses. They had broad shoulders with a height reaching 7 feet, and their heads were almost at 9 feet.
Their eyes were amber in color, while their manes were black. Also, their hooves were covered with mana-infused materials, which were capable of even cracking stone just by stepping.
Their whole bodies were covered with fully armoured reinforced plate barding, and military saddles were present on their backs.
"These things are definitely built for devastating cavalry charges." Luke muttered with satisfaction.
Osric and Aurielle also shared the same thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Nyx’s Third Authority Has Finally Awakened!
paragraphs: After that he looked toward Peak Iron Knight Archers. They were fully armored with dark steel plate armor, while an enchanted bow could be seen on their backs.
And they also carried a longsword and a short dagger as secondary weapons.
"Finally, a long-range support." Luke nodded with satisfaction because his territory doesn’t have any proper ranged attack method. Then he turned toward the Marinthians.
They had azure-blue skin with glowing coral patterns, and their hair was long and sea-blue with sapphire-colored eyes.
All of them were armored with Sea-forged Coral Scale Armor, while their hands held an 8-foot-tall rune-engraved sapphire coral staff, which had a sapphire crystal on its top.
After observing their skin color, Luke got confused. Because Naira was also a Marinthian, and the same went for her step-brother. ’But their skin color was normal.’

So he asked the System for an answer, to which it replied. [All Marinthians shed their blue skin color after reaching land. And in large bodies of water or in the ocean, they return to their blue color.]
[Also, some other features of the Marinthian species can only be seen in the ocean.]
The System also told Luke that this unit had just been summoned. That’s why they were retaining their original skin color, and it would become normal soon.
Luke nodded after hearing every word from the System... or that’s what he thought.
[Kekeke.]
Until he heard the System’s weird laugh, which unsettled him.
But the System didn’t care about Luke’s reaction. Instead, it asked him a question.
[Luke, do you want to know what other features Marinthians show in the ocean? Like, what your wife Naira’s form will be in the ocean?]
At first Luke didn’t care much, but when the System added the Naira part, it really made him curious. ’How will she look in the ocean?’ and this question repeated in his mind.
So he said okay in his mind, to which the System told him the answer.
[If you have thought you have seen Naira’s real beauty, then you are totally wrong, Luke...]
[Because only in the ocean can she transform into her real form, which is the Royal Marinthian form.]
Luke was listening to everything very clearly. So clearly that he was even tolerating the System’s stretched words.
But the surrounding people looked toward him with a ’Where is he lost?’ expression because he was standing there while keeping staring at the Marinthians.
Luke also noticed this, but he didn’t react, as the System was finally going to tell him the answer.
[The Royal Marinthian form is... a mermaid!]
"O_O"
Luke’s mouth literally opened wide before he hurriedly closed it. Because in his previous world he had heard about mermaids in legends and even saw them in movies.
But whenever female mermaids were mentioned, one thing definitely followed. ’In the ocean, female mermaids are the most beautiful womens.’
Yeah, beauty. And now the System was telling him that one of his wives was a mermaid.
’Damn it! If I had known it before, then I would have requested Naira at least once to show me her real form.’ Luke sighed with a regretful expression while imagining her beautiful appearance.
Though the next moment, he calmed himself down. As she was still his wife, and he would meet her again.
After that he brought out the Ascension Series and distributed the copied version to everyone. On this, everyone again became surprised.
But without changing any expression, Luke also distributed potions, like Health Potions, Aether Potions, and Iron Knight Temper Potions as well, so Iron Knights could increase their strength fast.
Sadly, Mana Pool and Health Spring liquids, after leaving them, lost most of their effects, which resulted in them becoming low-tier potions.
’I still have around approximately 900 Iron Knight Breakthrough Potions, and now they can be used.’ Luke thought while distributing.
Then he also brought out the 10 Warwalker Fortresses 🏰, so everyone could try and become familiar with them. Because he felt they would need them soon.
After all this was done, Luke turned toward Aurielle and asked, "Aurielle, do you have an Ascension Series?"

At this, Aurielle’s mood got a little down, and she shook her head and said, that before reaching Bronze Knight, no one distributed them to their younger members. "And I got exiled before that." With a lowered voice, she muttered the last part.
Seeing this, Luke felt sorry for her. So he moved close to her before hugging her gently.
Sadly, Aurielle couldn’t use those C-rank Ascension Series because he found out that her Origin Skill was S-rank. So she needed at least A-rank and above to see some change in her strength.
"I will bring the best one for you." Luke whispered those words into her ear, which reduced Aurielle’s sadness, and a small smile appeared on her face. Then she whispered,
"I know. Because my husband is the best~" Though the last part she said playfully.
On this, Luke gave her a smile and a small peck on her cheek.
When Luke hugged Aurielle, almost everyone lowered their heads. Except Vaelira and Aurora.
Luke and Aurielle stayed in that position for a few moments before separating.
"Ok! Everyone go and train! Because soon we need to remove those invaders from our territory.!"
Luke’s loud voice echoed in the vicinity, which burned flames in their eyes, and all of them slammed their fists toward their chests before shouting,
"YES MY LORD!!!"
Luke nodded at this and, with Aurielle, Vaelira, and Aurora, moved toward the center hut location to start their training.
After that, Luke separated from them and moved to a far location near the mountains. Because he was going to check his new Titan.
And with that, also going to try its combat power. "I hope something good will come."
"Why don’t you first check the new abilities?" But just as he was about to do that, Nyx and Myrkhal suddenly came outside. Then Nyx asked him.
Luke paused at this and gave them a look. ’I thought you were going to sleep for eternity.’

Nyx and Myrkhal didn’t react to his look because even Nyx didn’t know why they were sleeping too much. ’Is it related to our powers?’ he thought while looking toward Myrkhal, who had already settled on Luke’s shoulder.
’I hope this will be fixed soon.’ With that, he also settled down on Luke’s right shoulder.
"Ok." Luke said before first checking Nyx’s info.
[Nyx Skills]
Body Temper: Shadow of Nyx (First Ability)
Iron Knight: Null Veil of Nyx (Second Ability)
Bronze Knight: Authority of Severance (Third Ability) {NEW!}
"huh? You unlocked this." Nyx from the side said with a surprised voice, while Myrkhal also raised his brow at this.
Luke got confused by their reaction, upon which Nyx explained.
"Before, I was thinking why you didn’t have any of my attack abilities. But now, seeing this, I guess you don’t need them anymore." Nyx finished his sentence with a little laugh.
Luke also became curious. "What’s so special about this ability?" So he opened the System info.
[🌌 Authority of Severance]
📖 Type: Forbidden Authority
👑 Titan: Nyx, the Void Titan
⚫ "The Void recognizes no connection."

Among all the Authorities governed by the Void, "Severance" is one of the oldest and most feared. It does not create destruction, nor does it rely on overwhelming force. Instead, it rejects the invisible bonds that hold existence together.
⚔️ It simply declares that what was once connected... no longer is.
"Crazy!" A loud exclamation left his mouth after reading its description.
"Isn’t t-this too broken?" Luke gave both of them a look before asking this. But before Nyx could respond, the System’s voice came.
[Check the full details before asking.]
Luke got stunned before turning his attention toward the "Read more..." button. "You make them so small, and now you’re asking me to read instantly." Luke cursed the System while pressing it.
Nyx just shook his head, then also looked toward the System screen to see how much of his Authority was given.
[🥉 Bronze Knight]
⚔️ Physical Severance
The user can sever only physical matter.
📌 Examples
* 🗡️ Cut through weapons.
* 🛡️ Cut through armor.
* ⛓️ Sever chains.
* 🛡️ Split shields.
* ✨ Cut magical projectiles.
* ⚡ Ignore part of a target’s physical durability.
⚠️ Limitations
* ⚔️ Must be delivered through his weapon.
* 📏 Maximum range: Weapon reach.
* 🚫 Cannot sever living bodies completely unless his strength already surpasses the opponent.
* 🔒 Cannot affect mana, souls, concepts, or space.
"O_O" Luke’s mouth fully opened after reading this, not because of disappointment, though it was there but only a small part.
Still, the Physical Severance was already broken, because if a person even brought god-level armor, he could still split that apart.
Of course, Luke was overthinking the god armor part because he forgot. ⚡ Ignore part of a target’s physical durability.
Yeah, not one shot, but ignore part of the durability.
Meanwhile, Nyx nodded with a normal expression. Because he already expected Luke to not get his full Authority.
Luke finally calmed down a moment later and read the ability description again.
’So, previously my body was too weak to even use Physical Severance, that’s why it started at Bronze Knight.’ He thought after double-checking with the System, who also nodded and told him.
[The further Realm-unlocked Severance will be shown after reaching that Realm.]
"It’s fine. As I am already satisfied with Nyx’s ability." Luke didn’t care about the further Severance because he couldn’t even use them now.
After that, Luke rubbed his hands excitedly, hoping to get an even better skill for Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan.
Who just smiled with his big blue mouth.
