sentences.text: After that he looked toward Peak Iron Knight Archers.
They were fully armored with dark steel plate armor, while an enchanted bow could be seen on their backs.
And they also carried a longsword and a short dagger as secondary weapons.
"Finally, a long-range support." Luke nodded with satisfaction because his territory doesn’t have any proper ranged attack method.
Then he turned toward the Marinthians.
They had azure-blue skin with glowing coral patterns, and their hair was long and sea-blue with sapphire-colored eyes.
All of them were armored with Sea-forged Coral Scale Armor, while their hands held an 8-foot-tall rune-engraved sapphire coral staff, which had a sapphire crystal on its top.
After observing their skin color, Luke got confused.
Because Naira was also a Marinthian, and the same went for her step-brother. ’But their skin color was normal.’
So he asked the System for an answer, to which it replied.
[All Marinthians shed their blue skin color after reaching land.
And in large bodies of water or in the ocean, they return to their blue color.]
[Also, some other features of the Marinthian species can only be seen in the ocean.]
The System also told Luke that this unit had just been summoned.
That’s why they were retaining their original skin color, and it would become normal soon.
Luke nodded after hearing every word from the System... or that’s what he thought.
[Kekeke.]
Until he heard the System’s weird laugh, which unsettled him.
But the System didn’t care about Luke’s reaction.
Instead, it asked him a question.
[Luke, do you want to know what other features Marinthians show in the ocean?
Like, what your wife Naira’s form will be in the ocean?]
At first Luke didn’t care much, but when the System added the Naira part, it really made him curious. ’How will she look in the ocean?’ and this question repeated in his mind.
So he said okay in his mind, to which the System told him the answer.
[If you have thought you have seen Naira’s real beauty, then you are totally wrong, Luke...]
[Because only in the ocean can she transform into her real form, which is the Royal Marinthian form.]
Luke was listening to everything very clearly.
So clearly that he was even tolerating the System’s stretched words.
But the surrounding people looked toward him with a ’Where is he lost?’ expression because he was standing there while keeping staring at the Marinthians.
Luke also noticed this, but he didn’t react, as the System was finally going to tell him the answer.
[The Royal Marinthian form is... a mermaid!]
"O_O"
Luke’s mouth literally opened wide before he hurriedly closed it.
Because in his previous world he had heard about mermaids in legends and even saw them in movies.
But whenever female mermaids were mentioned, one thing definitely followed. ’In the ocean, female mermaids are the most beautiful womens.’
Yeah, beauty.
And now the System was telling him that one of his wives was a mermaid.
’Damn it!
If I had known it before, then I would have requested Naira at least once to show me her real form.’ Luke sighed with a regretful expression while imagining her beautiful appearance.
Though the next moment, he calmed himself down.
As she was still his wife, and he would meet her again.
After that he brought out the Ascension Series and distributed the copied version to everyone.
On this, everyone again became surprised.
But without changing any expression, Luke also distributed potions, like Health Potions, Aether Potions, and Iron Knight Temper Potions as well, so Iron Knights could increase their strength fast.
Sadly, Mana Pool and Health Spring liquids, after leaving them, lost most of their effects, which resulted in them becoming low-tier potions.
’I still have around approximately 900 Iron Knight Breakthrough Potions, and now they can be used.’ Luke thought while distributing.
Then he also brought out the 10 Warwalker Fortresses 🏰, so everyone could try and become familiar with them.
Because he felt they would need them soon.
After all this was done, Luke turned toward Aurielle and asked, "Aurielle, do you have an Ascension Series?"
At this, Aurielle’s mood got a little down, and she shook her head and said, that before reaching Bronze Knight, no one distributed them to their younger members.
"And I got exiled before that." With a lowered voice, she muttered the last part.
Seeing this, Luke felt sorry for her.
So he moved close to her before hugging her gently.
Sadly, Aurielle couldn’t use those C-rank Ascension Series because he found out that her Origin Skill was S-rank.
So she needed at least A-rank and above to see some change in her strength.
"I will bring the best one for you." Luke whispered those words into her ear, which reduced Aurielle’s sadness, and a small smile appeared on her face.
Then she whispered,
"I know.
Because my husband is the best~" Though the last part she said playfully.
On this, Luke gave her a smile and a small peck on her cheek.
When Luke hugged Aurielle, almost everyone lowered their heads.
Except Vaelira and Aurora.
Luke and Aurielle stayed in that position for a few moments before separating.
"Ok!
Everyone go and train!
Because soon we need to remove those invaders from our territory.!"
Luke’s loud voice echoed in the vicinity, which burned flames in their eyes, and all of them slammed their fists toward their chests before shouting,
"YES MY LORD!!!"
Luke nodded at this and, with Aurielle, Vaelira, and Aurora, moved toward the center hut location to start their training.
After that, Luke separated from them and moved to a far location near the mountains.
Because he was going to check his new Titan.
And with that, also going to try its combat power.
"I hope something good will come."
"Why don’t you first check the new abilities?" But just as he was about to do that, Nyx and Myrkhal suddenly came outside.
Then Nyx asked him.
Luke paused at this and gave them a look. ’I thought you were going to sleep for eternity.’

Nyx and Myrkhal didn’t react to his look because even Nyx didn’t know why they were sleeping too much. ’Is it related to our powers?’ he thought while looking toward Myrkhal, who had already settled on Luke’s shoulder.
’I hope this will be fixed soon.’ With that, he also settled down on Luke’s right shoulder.
"Ok." Luke said before first checking Nyx’s info.
[Nyx Skills]
Body Temper: Shadow of Nyx (First Ability)
Iron Knight: Null Veil of Nyx (Second Ability)
Bronze Knight: Authority of Severance (Third Ability) {NEW!}
"huh?
You unlocked this." Nyx from the side said with a surprised voice, while Myrkhal also raised his brow at this.
Luke got confused by their reaction, upon which Nyx explained.
"Before, I was thinking why you didn’t have any of my attack abilities.
But now, seeing this, I guess you don’t need them anymore." Nyx finished his sentence with a little laugh.
Luke also became curious.
"What’s so special about this ability?" So he opened the System info.
[🌌 Authority of Severance]
📖 Type: Forbidden Authority
👑 Titan: Nyx, the Void Titan
⚫ "The Void recognizes no connection."
Among all the Authorities governed by the Void, "Severance" is one of the oldest and most feared.
It does not create destruction, nor does it rely on overwhelming force.
Instead, it rejects the invisible bonds that hold existence together.
⚔️ It simply declares that what was once connected... no longer is.
"Crazy!" A loud exclamation left his mouth after reading its description.
"Isn’t t-this too broken?" Luke gave both of them a look before asking this.
But before Nyx could respond, the System’s voice came.
[Check the full details before asking.]
Luke got stunned before turning his attention toward the "Read more..." button.
"You make them so small, and now you’re asking me to read instantly." Luke cursed the System while pressing it.
Nyx just shook his head, then also looked toward the System screen to see how much of his Authority was given.
[🥉 Bronze Knight]
⚔️ Physical Severance
The user can sever only physical matter.
📌 Examples
* 🗡️ Cut through weapons.
* 🛡️ Cut through armor.
* ⛓️ Sever chains.
* 🛡️ Split shields.
* ✨ Cut magical projectiles.
* ⚡ Ignore part of a target’s physical durability.
⚠️ Limitations
* ⚔️ Must be delivered through his weapon.
* 📏 Maximum range: Weapon reach.
* 🚫 Cannot sever living bodies completely unless his strength already surpasses the opponent.
* 🔒 Cannot affect mana, souls, concepts, or space.
"O_O" Luke’s mouth fully opened after reading this, not because of disappointment, though it was there but only a small part.
Still, the Physical Severance was already broken, because if a person even brought god-level armor, he could still split that apart.
Of course, Luke was overthinking the god armor part because he forgot. ⚡ Ignore part of a target’s physical durability.
Yeah, not one shot, but ignore part of the durability.
Meanwhile, Nyx nodded with a normal expression.
Because he already expected Luke to not get his full Authority.
Luke finally calmed down a moment later and read the ability description again.
’So, previously my body was too weak to even use Physical Severance, that’s why it started at Bronze Knight.’ He thought after double-checking with the System, who also nodded and told him.
[The further Realm-unlocked Severance will be shown after reaching that Realm.]
"It’s fine.
As I am already satisfied with Nyx’s ability." Luke didn’t care about the further Severance because he couldn’t even use them now.
After that, Luke rubbed his hands excitedly, hoping to get an even better skill for Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan.
Who just smiled with his big blue mouth.
Believe me, your support really helps me a lot and keeps motivating me to write more.
Because I know someone is reading my novel.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: The Third Forbidden Titan
paragraphs: [🌑 Authority of Primal Awakening]
📖 Type: Forbidden Authority
👑 Titan: Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan
🕶️ "Every Titan Face carries a sleeping legend."
The Faceless Titan is not merely a collector of forms.

Every Titan Face it possesses is an ancient lineage born at the peak of existence. However, countless abilities, instincts, and primordial traits remain dormant, sealed deep within each Titan’s Origin.
The Authority of Primal Awakening allows its wielder to gradually awaken those sleeping powers.
It does not create new abilities.
It simply allows each Titan Face to remember what it once was.
As the wielder grows stronger, deeper layers of every Titan’s true power are awakened, revealing abilities that have slumbered since the beginning of creation.
"Well now I don’t have to focus on awakening their ability by myself." Luke laughed as he read the description, while Myrkhal showed a surprised expression at the info.
Because he didn’t expect Luke to get the same ability, which, in one way, was stopping the full power of Form Transformation.
[Luke, at your current realm, only one ability can be awakened from each Titan form.]
While Luke was laughing about the new abilities, the System message, as always, brought his mood back to normal.
"Well, what can I expect from you?" Luke shrugged his shoulders because he had already guessed this would happen.

"Now Titan Time." Then he looked toward the System screen, which was showing [Third Titan Available.] and he clicked on it. Surprisingly, this time the Titan was available before summoning, and its ability could be checked.
[Third Titan Unlocked]
👑 Caelith, The Cosmic Heart Titan
🏛 Ancient Title: Warden of Genesis
🚫 Forbidden Path: Genesis Path
Among the Titans who governed Forbidden power, the Cosmic Heart Titan is known as the Warden of Genesis.
Unlike beings who borrow the power of stars, planets, or galaxies, she creates them from within her own existence.
Every cosmic body is born inside her heart before becoming reality.
She is the origin of countless celestial creations, the keeper of the first spark that illuminated the void.
"Amazing!" Luke said before turning toward Nyx and Myrkhal. There, Nyx was flabbergasted and muttered, "Big Sister??"
Myrkhal, though, didn’t react much and, with the same smile, just kept watching everything.
Luke didn’t ask Nyx anything because the System had already told him before that they were brother and sister.
But then a thought came into his mind. ’Will I also become female after transformation?’ and this thought gave him goosebumps.
Fortunately, the System explained. [Your Forbidden Titan Ascension just slightly transforms your body. Not the whole structure. So you don’t have to worry about that part.]
After hearing the System’s words, Luke finally felt relieved and nodded. After that, he checked her ability.
🌌 Passive Ability
⭐ Cosmos Body
The user’s body becomes a living cosmos.
Each realm breakthrough creates a new Celestial body within their core, continuously generating Aether and empowering their body.
All Celestial bodies may be used together, or one may be focused upon to greatly amplify its unique attribute.
Present Bodies:
Body Temper : Meteor / Asteroid (1)
Iron Knight : Moon (2)
Bronze Knight : Planet (Terrestrial) (3)
"A Cosmos body!" Luke muttered with a shocked expression because, when he read Present Bodies and saw all those, he nearly got stunned.
Because a Planet was already formed at Bronze Knight, ’then would Silver Knight have literally a Solar System within it?’
But still, he asked the System for confirmation because a Bronze Knight having literally a planet inside them was too much.
[Nop, all of them are miniature, but real celestial bodies.] That’s what the System said.
"Guessed it." Luke muttered with a little regret in his voice, but was still happy about this new ability. After that, he checked her other ability.
🌠 Active Ability
☄ Cosmos Manifestation
Manifest the Celestial bodies created within the Cosmos Body into reality.
Each body retains its own natural properties—gravity, mass, heat, atmosphere, pressure, and more—allowing them to be used as weapons, shields, or battlefield constructs.
Their power grows as stronger Celestial bodies are born through future realm breakthroughs.
Present Bodies:
Body Temper : Meteor / Asteroid (1)
Iron Knight : Moon (2)
Bronze Knight : Planet (Terrestrial) (3)

"Another absurd ability, that’s all I can say." Luke nodded with an already amazed expression. Even though those celestial bodies are really not celestial-sized. But summoning them outside will be really crazy.
Then Luke checked for a third ability and found... n-none! "What??" With a confused expression, he looked toward Nyx and the System screen, on which Nyx said.
"Caelith is known for her creation ability and always used it for attack. Like she literally one time threw down a whole galaxy toward the enemy."
When Nyx said the last part, even his face became amazed.
’A galaxy??’ Luke looked toward the description and thought again. ’Totally Crazy!’
Then the System voice came and answered the question fully.
[So for Caelith, you will unlock a new Celestial body with each realm rather than a new ability.]
Luke nodded after a moment of thinking and said. "Seems like every Titan has their own method." On this, Nyx nodded and didn’t elaborate.
"Ok then. Let’s welcome her!" Luke said to the three of them.
Nyx nodded with a calm face, while Myrkhal always had the same smile, and the System...[0-0], yeah, the same emoji.
Luke took a deep breath before uttering the forbidden words.
"Before stars..."
Somewhere far, the moment those words reached there, the endless prison trembled. And soon tiny specks of golden light appeared throughout Caelith’s prison region.
"Before worlds..."
The lights didn’t reduce but multiplied. Thousands! Millions!
Like newborn stars illuminating the darkness. Yet at the center of it all...
A giant figure remained motionless.
"Before even time remembered its name..."
Finally, the darkness surrounding the Titan prison slowly transformed.
Nebulae drifted across the void. Planets appeared and vanished. Galaxies spiraled into existence before dissolving once more.
The entire prison region resembled the first moments of creation.
And in the center, the colossal female Titan’s appearance finally became visible.
She was colossal, same as her other siblings. Her skin was pale golden in color. While her long hair flowed behind like liquid starlight.
But her body... galaxies were drifting beneath her skin. And a miniature cosmos was visible within her chest.

Though her eyes remained closed. But two ancient chains tightly wrapped around her both arms, and each of them was covered in ancient runes which were stretching endlessly into the darkness, binding the Warden of Genesis.
"There beat a single heart."
THUMP!
When this word echoed through the endless prison, the miniature cosmos inside her chest pulsed.
On this, countless stars were created in an instant, which made the whole prison brighten. Along with them came planets, which again began orbiting her. Then nebulae expanded.
"The heart that created all things."
THUMP!!
Another heartbeat, louder than before. Which nearly shook the entire prison, or it tried to, until those chains rattled violently.
CLANG... CLANG... CLANG...
Like whatever was happening, they were not going to let it happen. Sadly, they failed just after a moment later, as small golden cracks spread across the first chain.
"The Warden of the Genesis Path."
On this the orbiting stars speed was increasing with each second, or with each eternity?
Faster!!
Faster!!!
Faster!!!
Within a moment, an entire galaxy system formed around her sleeping body.
Moons. Planets. Asteroids. All started revolving around the Titan. As if she were the center of creation itself.
"Awaken, Caelith!"
Finally, her eyes opened. In which twin galaxies were rotating slowly, then with hazy eyes, she stared into her cracked chains, before looking toward the boy who was calling her.
KRAAAAAAAAAK!
The first chain around her arms shattered. And countless fragments of golden light scattered through the prison.
On which clarity returned to her eyes, but she couldn’t find the entity who was breaking her chains.
But far away, whenever the boy said those words, the chains got more and more cracked.
BOOOOOOOM!
And finally, the second chain also exploded. Which filled the entire prison region with cosmic radiance.
"..." She muttered some words, which weren’t understandable at all. But the System knew what she said. ’Freedom??’
With that, she moved toward the call, as one portal opened in front of her, but she still gave one last look toward her siblings before she stepped into it.
"Awaken, Caelith."
The moment Luke finished those words, the entire Time Chamber shook. Like an entity which should not exist had appeared inside it.
"What’s happened!!!"
All the knights brought out their weapons and became wary toward the upcoming enemy.
While Aurielle, Aurora, and Vaelira also came out from their meditation and looked worriedly toward Luke’s location.
"Is Master alright!" Aurora, with a panicked voice, said to both of them, but didn’t try to reach toward him.
As he had already mentioned, that whatever happened, don’t come unless he called them.
Aurielle’s worry was also increasing with each moment, but the next instant the shaking disappeared like it had never happened in the first place.
On which everyone’s expression finally relaxed somewhat. But still every gaze remained fixed toward Luke’s position.
While all this was happening inside the Time Chamber, Luke’s body was already transformed into The Cosmic Heart Titan, Caelith.
"Hmm... he really doesn’t turn into a female Titan." Nyx muttered while watching Luke’s appearance.
Who was now 12 feet tall with a lean-built normal human body, which looked a little feminine. But no female organs could be seen.
His hair, though, had become long and reached his waist, which was now filled with flowing starlight. ’Literally flowing starlight.’
And his eyes... ’Yeah, the same galaxy eyes like her.’ Nyx thought.
Meanwhile Myrkhal’s mouth changed this time, and it became a yellow mouth, which still had the same smile as before.
’Then what’s the point of changing the color.’ Luke looked away from Myrkhal’s mouth, which he felt was somehow laughing at him.
Soon he felt that his stats buff’s 5x multiplier activated again, which brought a big smile to his face.
While Luke was feeling the new strength and was about to compare his raw strength with the Knight stage, a voice suddenly came toward the three of them.
"So both of you are already here."
At this, all six eyes...Cough! Cough! four eyes turned toward the voice as Myrkhal was faceless , and there she was, floating behind Nyx and Myrkhal with a smile, the mini Caelith.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Why Were My Mages Blushing?
paragraphs: Seeing Caelith, none of them got surprised. As they were already expecting her appearance as well.
"Seems like many things have changed." Again, Caelith’s voice came, as she looked around with a melancholy look, like she was remembering her previous old days.
Nyx didn’t comment on this, because he often spent his time alone in the void. So he didn’t get much attached to the world.
And for Myrkhal, he was still smiling. Luke didn’t know why. But after the first encounter. Myrkhal had completely become silent and only talked occasionally.

When he asked Nyx about this, he answered. "Myrkhal is the most unpredictable among them." And he also added, that they don’t even know. If Myrkhal is really their brother or not. Though he didn’t explain that part and got silent.
After thinking all of this for a moment, Luke chose to stop asking. and concentrate on the present situation.
"Welcome, Miss Caelith." Luke, with a warm smile, greeted Caelith, upon this she paused and turned to look toward Luke.
’He called me here?? Did he also break the chains??’ and a confusing thought came into her mind.
Because she could feel, Luke was not strong enough, or even calling him strong compared to her peak, was totally absurd. ’Then how??’
An awkward silence spread among them. Because Caelith, suddenly became silent after his greeting and he didn’t know how to continue the conversation.
While Nyx and Myrkhal returned back to his shoulder, but were also not saying anything.
The System saw all of this, so to remove this awkward silence, he chose to appear.
[0-0] But that’s all the System showed.
Luke’s eyes twitched on this, but Caelith’s reaction was different. "It was you!" With a little high tone, she pointed toward the System screen and said.
She didn’t know why. but she felt this thing was there, when those words echoed in the surroundings, ’or maybe it was this one, who was echoing the words.’
"Miss Caelith, this is my System. who freed you." Luke, seeing another silence, spoke those words and explained to her.
That the System had bound them with him, which resulted in him being able to use their powers, though not fully.
’This!’ But Caelith got surprised from this, while Nyx and Myrkhal didn’t react much. Because they were already done that when they first met him, or at least Nyx did.
Feeling everything was totally out of her understanding, she chose to calm down. and stopped thinking about those things.
But when she saw Nyx and Myrkhal were sitting on Luke’s both shoulders, she got confused again. ’Do I also have to sit there? and if yes, then where?’
Seeing not any space left on Luke’s shoulder, she floated and settled on Luke’s head instead. "This will do."
That’s what Luke heard. on this he just smiled and chose to return toward the hut location.
"Master!" Upon reaching, Aurora instantly appeared in front of him, before hugging him tightly.
Luke felt suffocated by her tight embrace and also felt the soft sensation again. ’Ugh...’
"I am fine, Aurora." So, with difficulty, he uttered those words, on which Aurora’s grip finally loosened.
There Luke saw her eyes, that were a little moist. which brought a little guilt to him. Because he didn’t expect the whole Time Chamber to shake as well.
Aurielle and Vaelira also appeared from behind her, before Aurielle said angrily, "If you are going to do something dangerous again, then please let me come with you."
Also added. "Because you don’t listen to me at all."

On this, Luke lowered his gaze slightly with a sorry expression, but this brought a little blush to him. As there he could see Aurora’s cleavage clearly. ’So big!’ and this thought immediately came into his mind.
As most of the time Aurora wore knight armour or tight clothing. But today she was wearing a loose robe, which was becoming bad for his health.
Aurora was still hugging her master with a worried expression, without knowing that he was enjoying the view down there.
But next moment Luke turned his face away, to not let anyone know, what happened here.
After a moment, when he calmed down a little, Luke said to everyone, "All of you go back to your training, I will check on the mages." on this Aurora reluctantly separated from Luke.
While Aurielle gave a sus look toward Luke after noticing a small blush on his face. But before she could ask anything, he ran away towards the mages location.

’Definitely sus.’ She narrowed her eyes while looking toward Luke’s running figure and then turned toward Aurora’s breasts, which were almost the same size as hers. ’or maybe a little bigger.’ though the last part she didn’t believe.
"Uff! Finally safe." Luke took a sigh of relief, while removing the thought of Aurora’s hot body.
Then Caelith’s voice came from above, who was watching everything from the start. "Who were they?"
And this brought another blush to his face. ’Did she saw me? When my gaze turned to Aurora’s cleavage?’
But seeing she was not talking about that, he explained to her all the things, which happened after he was summoned to this world.
"Interesting." A little smile appeared on her golden pale face after hearing Luke story. Because in their time, there was not any being, who called themselves God. but now there are many.
But when Nyx mentioned, that Abyssal beings were still present, which worsened her mood a little.
Luke saw all this, but didn’t ask them. Because he doesn’t like to pry into information which doesn’t relate to him.
Though, Nyx already mentioned something about the Abyssal, which was enough for him.
After travelling for some time, he reached the location, which was a forest, that also had a large lake and some huts made from wood could also be seen in the vicinity.

But when he took a few more steps, he heard the playful sound of mages and water splashing coming from the front, which was covered with bushes and branches. "Hehe~ Elena, it seems like your breasts have become even bigger than before~"

’They are bathing.’ Luke got stunned and didn’t cross the bushes, but he still got baffled because today he was really running into these types of awkward situations too many times, which had not happened before.
"Ahhh, who’s there!" But then he heard a few startled shouts, and along came spell attacks.
Seeing this, Luke sighed and easily dodged them before shouting. "Can’t you even identify your master anymore!"
On this, complete silence spread from the other side, then came hasty rustling sounds, which were likely from them putting on their clothes.
"M-Master!" Then came their panicked and apologetic voices. But Luke didn’t say anything and waited for them.
Soon all ten mages appeared one by one, though because all of this happened suddenly and they didn’t get the time to dry themselves. So now their clothes were tightly clinging to their wet bodies.
’Damn it! Not again.’ Seeing their hot and wet bodies, Luke shook his head and accepted. That maybe someone was doing this, or else this would not have happened.

"Elena, tell me all of your progress in your mage realm." Elena, the healer mage, got worried, but after hearing her master’s question, because she thought that maybe her master was angry with their earlier shout, still she gathered her courage and told him.
"M-Master... I have completed the engraving of my first Arcane Circle and now I am a Circled Mage. (Circled Mage, third rank on the mage power classification, equal to a Bronze Knight.)"
Luke heard her words clearly, but he was not angry. Instead he got surprised. because mages trained very slowly and they also had few resources available for them.
And that’s why when he reached the Mage Tower, he asked Lucy about the potion which could help the mage realm.
But she said. "Only tower mages could buy those and for nobles, only viscounts and above could purchase."
She also added that even for nobles, they had to promise to provide help and support when they got attacked or were in need.
’This is clearly asking for them to become slaves to the tower.’ At that time Luke got angry because of this.

Sadly only the Mage Association held this potion strictly. and outside methods or resources for mages were too costly. ’Despite that, they were not available for normal purchases and only the Auction House could provide them.’
For that he was really grateful toward the Alchemist Association manager, for the Gold VIP card.
"I have to attend next month’s Auction for sure." Luke muttered in a normal voice, while Elena also told him the other mages progress as well.
"Everyone is at the peak of the Apprentice Realm and maybe in a few months, they would also be able to break through."
When she finished her sentence, the mages standing behind her, looked nervously toward their master. Hoping that he would not be dissatisfied with their progress.
Luke saw everyone’s face and understood this, so he reassured them. "Don’t worry, I am not angry." Which brought a sigh of relief from them.
"Here, is the gift for all of you." After that Luke brought out all the magic scrolls and magic books and even the 10 E-rank Origin Fruits for them. and now he had only 88 E-rank Origin Fruits left.
"Master, this!!!" But when they saw all these things, they became so shocked, because after living inside the territory and interacting with everyone.
They also knew some world knowledge, so they clearly knew. that even viscounts had to pay a hefty price for this. and for Origin Fruits, which were even more priceless.
Luke saw the hesitation on everyone’s face. Even Elena got paused.
He shook his head and said. "All of you are mine, as I am your master."
When Luke mentioned the part about, that they belonged to him, all of their faces turned a little red. though Luke didn’t notice this, but he heard the System’s voice along with the emoji.
[keke! 😏]
’What?’ Luke gave a weird look toward the System screen, while Nyx and Caelith were discussing something among themselves, as they had already returned inside his body along with Myrkhal.
Seeing the System was not answering, he chose to ignore him and continue. "So take it. and the next time don’t hesitate, or it will be an insult towards me."
When Luke mentioned the last part, all the mages faces turned pale and they apologized to Luke. Because for them, disrespecting their master was the most heinous crime, which they would never do.
After Luke distributed everything, he separately called one mage.
"Nora, come here." Nora, who was smiling happily after getting a gift from her master, heard his voice. So with her deep dark blue eyes, she looked toward him.
There he was calling her, on this a sly smile appeared on the surrounding mages, which Luke didn’t notice, but Nora saw this and a blush appeared on her cheeks. ’Does master want to do something?’
With those thoughts, she moved slowly toward him with her long wet black hair, as it clung tightly to her robes.
Luke saw the smile on the surrounding mages and just thought, ’Maybe they were happy with the gift.’ and then shifted his attention toward Nora.
When he observed her, he noticed that how he always missed how beautiful his female summons were.
Because right now Nora, with her dark blue eyes and long black hair, could easily win the beauty competition if she was compared to baron noble daughters.
Soon Nora reached toward him and gave him a shy smile, which enhanced her beauty even more.
"Cough!" Luke coughed slightly to concentrate and gave her the basic formation books of Alarm, Barrier, Defense and some more. Because in the territory, only she was a Barrier Mage.
"Nora, I want you to learn this. And after that you have to surround our Lord Estate with these formations."
When she heard her master’s words, she got stunned, then shook her head at her earlier thought and looked curiously toward the new books, which her master had just presented to her.
After checking them slightly, she raised her eyes to look into his eyes and with a smile she nodded. "Sure, Master."
"Good." Luke also smiled and patted her head, which brought another blush to Nora’s face. while the surrounding mages gave a longing look toward Luke and thought, ’Why is master not caressing us?’
Luke didn’t notice their looks and soon returned back to the secluded area, for training his abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Territory’s Thirty-Day Progress | Testing the Cosmic Titan
paragraphs: 30 days inside Time chamber...

"Aurora, I told you to not wear this loose robe." Luke said irritably to Aurora, who was running around the training ground while practising her skills. But because of that, her breast was bouncing too much, and some occasional glances from far knights could be seen here.
Aurora, who just completed her today’s training, stopped on her master’s words and gave him an innocent smile.
Luke sighed helplessly on this, because he had repeatedly told her, but she didn’t listen a single time and said, "It’s not comfortable."
So he asked Aurielle on this, who suggested letting her wear a bra. But she took it out the next day with the same answer.
"Whatever." He shook his head. Right now, Aurora is too innocent, which he noticed during this duration. Therefore, she will understand with time.
After that, he took the mana water from his side before slowly drinking it. "Huff." This is definitely the best.
Luke muttered with satisfaction. As he also completed his today’s training and was taking rest.
After 30 days inside, he had become more familiar with his titan form and could now use some of its abilities better.

He also used his third titan to fight with Aurora but got badly beaten, because his titan form gave him a 5x stats buff, which brought him to early silver knight stage raw power, which was clearly not enough against a golden knight, even with his titan ability, which is three cosmic systems he can use now. He couldn’t defeat her.

His first system allowed him to use their masses and characteristics, like the first system consists of meteors or asteroids, so he could use their combined weight to do everything, like attack, defend, or more, which brought his attack power to peak silver knight.

But this doesn’t stop there. He could also use their generated gravity, though it is very low now. And if worse comes, he can manifest them outside, then throw them toward enemies to kill it instantly.
And the second system, which consists of moons and satellites, also follows the same as the first, but with more masses and more gravity. So his attack power reached very close to half-golden knight.
And the third system, which is planetary, is even more absurd, because it allowed his attack power to reach half-golden knight stage.
On this, Luke thought about using the planet as an attack, and that was the craziest part.
A 200m planet with rough terrain literally appeared above Luke, which even formed a small gravity zone around the area.
And when he threw it toward Aurora, even she felt the threat, which resulted in using her ultimate origin ability, which destroyed the planet. But then came the even crazier part.
Because she destroyed not a normal boulder but a planet, which had an active core. Yes, a freaking core.
Which resulted in a devastating explosion that destroyed the surrounding mountains, and even the time chamber shook slightly from this.
Fortunately, both of them were already prepared and escaped the explosion range immediately. As this power touched peak of early golden knight stage.

After that, he summoned his third armour, and yeah, this armour is cool, named "Elythos." This armour could make structures and materials from the celestial bodies inside him, which gives him many new methods, like crowd control, attack, defense, and even more.
And he also found out that the Armour bonus of 3x depends upon who is wearing it. If Luke, in his human form, summoned it, then it would increase his human form strength by 3 times.
But if it’s Titan form, then the titan stats will further multiply by 3x, which was absurd.
Because the system didn’t tell him anything about this before, and he found out after training.
[You didn’t ask.] That’s what he said on asking.
So with the armor buff, his titan raw power reached peak silver knight, and his cosmic system attack power reached half-golden knight, and the third cosmic system reached early golden knight stage.
But even with that, he struggled against Aurora and couldn’t break her defense. Because she was defense type. Though he didn’t dare to use the manifestation attack again.

On that, he finally understood how broken Myrkhal was. Because his form transformation and form assimilation both gave some stats buff, which allowed his previously early Iron knight stage to touch early golden knight stage attack, which let him damage the golden knight beings.
Sadly, now with Myrkhal forms, his attack could only reach early golden knight stage. And not more.
Even though it was still amazing, because he could use Myrkhal titan now for more time.
With that, he also tried different abilities of form transformation, and each one was good.

After a few moments later, he came out from those thoughts and then checked the status of his people during these 30 days inside. First, no breakthrough among mages. Though they learned all the G-rank spells, and they need time for mastery.
While only Elena has learned G and F-rank spells, but she also needs time for complete mastery.
Next, all the Iron knights present in the territory became peak Iron knights, as they used Iron knight tempering potions.
Meanwhile, 900 Iron Knight Archers that were recently summoned used Iron Knight breakthrough potions to become 900 Bronze Knight Archers. And only 100 were left at peak Iron Knight.

However, not a single Body Temper Realm member was inside the time chamber, because all previous Body Temper Realm members, except the border ones, had already become Iron Knights, and all the Body Temper Realm members are recent recruits.
Which have not gone through the loyalty test and Aurora’s chain binding. "I will deal with them after this war."
Luke was pretty sure that almost 1/4th of them were spies, while almost half had sold themselves.
Because it doesn’t make sense to not leave the territory which is going to fight a losing war. ’Well, according to outside people.’
Luke shook his head and stopped thinking about them.
With that, he checked the progress regarding Ascension Series and regretfully not a single person had mastered them. "Approx. 90 previous bronze knights present here, and none has mastered this."
Luke was counting the number after removing ten bronze knights, who were still on the way from Count territory, and not including the recent 900 bronze knight archers.
Sadly, the same for Marinthians as well.

"Our military strength didn’t increase much in case of lower strength." Luke muttered with a little regret in his voice. Apparently, he had accepted that anyone can master this series with a little bit of time.

"No wonder Silver knights are few, compared to bronze knights." With that, Luke looked toward the far distance. There, Aurielle and Vaelira were sparring as each of their attacks equaled a grenade explosion.

"Vaelira was still far from the half-golden knight stage, but Aurielle has already reached late bronze knight." Luke’s expression brightened, and he felt Aurielle was really talented, but sadly, due to not getting resources early from her family, she was left behind her peers.
"Don’t worry, Aurielle. I will give you everything which you would never be able to get before." Luke took a silent vow.
At this time, Aurielle’s position shifted toward him, and her eyes also met Luke’s, and both smiled at the same time.
Then Luke shifted his attention from them, toward Mana Well and Healing Spring. "If we can bring their water outside with its effectiveness remains, then it would be great."
For this, he asked the system if there was any way, to which it replied. [Well, you can get a blueprint or an upgrade blueprint for this.] Even though the system didn’t explain much, Luke understood.
Though at least one thing happened which improved his mood. The system’s previous two days rewards.
The first one was very helpful to their current territory.
[Reward: E-Rank Enchanted Watchtower]
[Base Quantity: 1]
[100x Return Activated: 100 Watchtowers]
[Deployment: Territorial Defense Grid]
[Detection Range: 5km per tower]
[Communication Link: All towers connected]
[Suggestion: Network placement recommended for maximum coverage]
Yeah, a watchtower, and a magical one. Sadly, they are operated best with Mages in them. But knights can also operate them, though that will require at least two knights.
"With this, the territory defense parameters will almost become impossible to breach, at least for normal units or assassins."
When Luke was smiling while thinking where to place the watchtowers, the system’s slightly low voice came.
[Luke...]

And a bad premonition immediately rose in his heart. ’He is going to give some bad news again.’ And this thought instantly came into his mind, which made his expression like, "Stay away from me, you horny system."
But the system didn’t care about Luke’s reaction and told him the bad news. ’Heh?? This is not bad news, at least for me.’
[The newbie benefits are off.]
"And what were the newbie benefits that I was getting?" Luke, with scrutinizing eyes, asked the system.
[All the summoned units come at peak realm, which should be early realm, while rewards come in bundles instead of one.]
[And now rewards will be linked with wives realms and calculated according to G-rank and above.]
[So rewards will not cross the threshold, like earlier summoning a Relic or legendary grade artifact.]

"NO!" Luke looked toward the system with a betrayed expression. But the system kept saying, you were supposed to get single rewards from each wife every time. It was he who tempered this slightly, but since he became Bronze Knight, he can’t do that anymore.
"This..." After hearing this, Luke calmed down a little bit, but he still felt bad.

sentences.text: 30 days inside Time chamber...
"Aurora, I told you to not wear this loose robe." Luke said irritably to Aurora, who was running around the training ground while practising her skills.
But because of that, her breast was bouncing too much, and some occasional glances from far knights could be seen here.
Aurora, who just completed her today’s training, stopped on her master’s words and gave him an innocent smile.
Luke sighed helplessly on this, because he had repeatedly told her, but she didn’t listen a single time and said, "It’s not comfortable."
So he asked Aurielle on this, who suggested letting her wear a bra.
But she took it out the next day with the same answer.
"Whatever." He shook his head.
Right now, Aurora is too innocent, which he noticed during this duration.
Therefore, she will understand with time.
After that, he took the mana water from his side before slowly drinking it.
"Huff." This is definitely the best.
Luke muttered with satisfaction.
As he also completed his today’s training and was taking rest.
After 30 days inside, he had become more familiar with his titan form and could now use some of its abilities better.

He also used his third titan to fight with Aurora but got badly beaten, because his titan form gave him a 5x stats buff, which brought him to early silver knight stage raw power, which was clearly not enough against a golden knight, even with his titan ability, which is three cosmic systems he can use now.
He couldn’t defeat her.

His first system allowed him to use their masses and characteristics, like the first system consists of meteors or asteroids, so he could use their combined weight to do everything, like attack, defend, or more, which brought his attack power to peak silver knight.
But this doesn’t stop there.
He could also use their generated gravity, though it is very low now.
And if worse comes, he can manifest them outside, then throw them toward enemies to kill it instantly.
And the second system, which consists of moons and satellites, also follows the same as the first, but with more masses and more gravity.
So his attack power reached very close to half-golden knight.
And the third system, which is planetary, is even more absurd, because it allowed his attack power to reach half-golden knight stage.
On this, Luke thought about using the planet as an attack, and that was the craziest part.
A 200m planet with rough terrain literally appeared above Luke, which even formed a small gravity zone around the area.
And when he threw it toward Aurora, even she felt the threat, which resulted in using her ultimate origin ability, which destroyed the planet.
But then came the even crazier part.
Because she destroyed not a normal boulder but a planet, which had an active core.
Yes, a freaking core.
Which resulted in a devastating explosion that destroyed the surrounding mountains, and even the time chamber shook slightly from this.
Fortunately, both of them were already prepared and escaped the explosion range immediately.
As this power touched peak of early golden knight stage.

After that, he summoned his third armour, and yeah, this armour is cool, named "Elythos." This armour could make structures and materials from the celestial bodies inside him, which gives him many new methods, like crowd control, attack, defense, and even more.
And he also found out that the Armour bonus of 3x depends upon who is wearing it.
If Luke, in his human form, summoned it, then it would increase his human form strength by 3 times.
But if it’s Titan form, then the titan stats will further multiply by 3x, which was absurd.
Because the system didn’t tell him anything about this before, and he found out after training.
[You didn’t ask.] That’s what he said on asking.
So with the armor buff, his titan raw power reached peak silver knight, and his cosmic system attack power reached half-golden knight, and the third cosmic system reached early golden knight stage.
But even with that, he struggled against Aurora and couldn’t break her defense.
Because she was defense type.
Though he didn’t dare to use the manifestation attack again.
On that, he finally understood how broken Myrkhal was.

Because his form transformation and form assimilation both gave some stats buff, which allowed his previously early Iron knight stage to touch early golden knight stage attack, which let him damage the golden knight beings.
Sadly, now with Myrkhal forms, his attack could only reach early golden knight stage.
And not more.
Even though it was still amazing, because he could use Myrkhal titan now for more time.
With that, he also tried different abilities of form transformation, and each one was good.
After a few moments later, he came out from those thoughts and then checked the status of his people during these 30 days inside.
First, no breakthrough among mages.
Though they learned all the G-rank spells, and they need time for mastery.
While only Elena has learned G and F-rank spells, but she also needs time for complete mastery.
Next, all the Iron knights present in the territory became peak Iron knights, as they used Iron knight tempering potions.
Meanwhile, 900 Iron Knight Archers that were recently summoned used Iron Knight breakthrough potions to become 900 Bronze Knight Archers.
And only 100 were left at peak Iron Knight.

However, not a single Body Temper Realm member was inside the time chamber, because all previous Body Temper Realm members, except the border ones, had already become Iron Knights, and all the Body Temper Realm members are recent recruits.
Which have not gone through the loyalty test and Aurora’s chain binding.
"I will deal with them after this war."
Luke was pretty sure that almost 1/4th of them were spies, while almost half had sold themselves.
Because it doesn’t make sense to not leave the territory which is going to fight a losing war. ’Well, according to outside people.’
Luke shook his head and stopped thinking about them.
With that, he checked the progress regarding Ascension Series and regretfully not a single person had mastered them.
"Approx.
90 previous bronze knights present here, and none has mastered this."
Luke was counting the number after removing ten bronze knights, who were still on the way from Count territory, and not including the recent 900 bronze knight archers.
Sadly, the same for Marinthians as well.
"Our military strength didn’t increase much in case of lower strength." Luke muttered with a little regret in his voice.
Apparently, he had accepted that anyone can master this series with a little bit of time.
"No wonder Silver knights are few, compared to bronze knights." With that, Luke looked toward the far distance.
There, Aurielle and Vaelira were sparring as each of their attacks equaled a grenade explosion.

"Vaelira was still far from the half-golden knight stage, but Aurielle has already reached late bronze knight." Luke’s expression brightened, and he felt Aurielle was really talented, but sadly, due to not getting resources early from her family, she was left behind her peers.
"Don’t worry, Aurielle.
I will give you everything which you would never be able to get before." Luke took a silent vow.
At this time, Aurielle’s position shifted toward him, and her eyes also met Luke’s, and both smiled at the same time.
Then Luke shifted his attention from them, toward Mana Well and Healing Spring.
"If we can bring their water outside with its effectiveness remains, then it would be great."
For this, he asked the system if there was any way, to which it replied.
[Well, you can get a blueprint or an upgrade blueprint for this.] Even though the system didn’t explain much, Luke understood.
Though at least one thing happened which improved his mood.
The system’s previous two days rewards.
The first one was very helpful to their current territory.
[Reward: E-Rank Enchanted Watchtower]
[Base Quantity: 1]
[100x Return Activated: 100 Watchtowers]
[Deployment: Territorial Defense Grid]
[Detection Range: 5km per tower]
[Communication Link: All towers connected]
[Suggestion: Network placement recommended for maximum coverage]
Yeah, a watchtower, and a magical one.
Sadly, they are operated best with Mages in them.
But knights can also operate them, though that will require at least two knights.
"With this, the territory defense parameters will almost become impossible to breach, at least for normal units or assassins."
When Luke was smiling while thinking where to place the watchtowers, the system’s slightly low voice came.
[Luke...]

And a bad premonition immediately rose in his heart. ’He is going to give some bad news again.’ And this thought instantly came into his mind, which made his expression like, "Stay away from me, you horny system."
But the system didn’t care about Luke’s reaction and told him the bad news. ’Heh??
This is not bad news, at least for me.’
[The newbie benefits are off.]
"And what were the newbie benefits that I was getting?" Luke, with scrutinizing eyes, asked the system.
[All the summoned units come at peak realm, which should be early realm, while rewards come in bundles instead of one.]
[And now rewards will be linked with wives realms and calculated according to G-rank and above.]
[So rewards will not cross the threshold, like earlier summoning a Relic or legendary grade artifact.]
"NO!" Luke looked toward the system with a betrayed expression.
But the system kept saying, you were supposed to get single rewards from each wife every time.
It was he who tempered this slightly, but since he became Bronze Knight, he can’t do that anymore.
"This..." After hearing this, Luke calmed down a little bit, but he still felt bad.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: The Viscount Ashenford Finally Panics
paragraphs: "Wait???" Then suddenly he remembered the last reward in which he got E-rank and D-rank rewards, though he did get them inside a bundle. ’Was the system already know that I was about to make a breakthrough and done that?’
On this, Luke narrowed his eyes and asked the system, who glitched a little and said. [0-0]
"Yeah, this is it, other than that. What the f**k do you even know." Luke’s mood again became bad and he freaked out.

So the system tried to calm him down, while explaining. [Luke, you are getting rewards daily, and the previous stone things also got removed. So now rewards will still be random, but at least start with G-rank. And there is also a high chance of getting same-rank rewards as your wife’s rank is.]

With that, the system gave Luke an example, like right now Aurielle is in the Bronze Realm, then he will get a random reward from G-rank to E-rank, unless new emotions are found or a huge change happened in emotion.

Luke heard everything and calmed down a little. At least he was getting rewards daily, and if he brings all his five wives together, then he can even get 5 rewards daily, which is way better than before.

"But..." He shook his head, when he recalled his other wives’ looks and their problems. "Everything will be solved if I am strong enough and rich enough." The last part, because he has the system, while the first part, because he had SSS-rank Titan Knight skills.
With that, he checked the second reward as well.
[Reward: F-Rank Enchanted Spyglass]
Base Quantity: 1
100x Return Activated: 100 Spyglasses
Rank: F-Rank (Iron Knight Equivalent)
Type: Utility / Scouting / Detection
Range: 10km
Effect: Magnifies vision up to 10 kilometers; (Iron-grade or below)
Recommended Use: Assign to scout units, watchtower operators, and border patrol commanders

"Well, not bad, I guess." Although it wasn’t the best reward, nor was it even E-rank, Luke didn’t mind. "At least we have a telescope now." Rising from the grassy field, he ordered a maid to gather everyone outside, fully equipped and ready.
Because Luke is finally going to attack the Ashenford army.
1 day earlier | Inside Windmarch Reach Territory...

"My lord, our army at Blackstone Highlands couldn’t able to capture the lord estate." A kneeling man said to the seated person on the throne, the kneeling man was wearing butler form and his expression seemed nervous.
While the person seated on the throne had brown hair and his eyes were cold gray color. His build was broad, which said only one thing. "Strength."
Tap. Tap. Tap.
After a moment later, the butler heard three tap sounds, but didn’t dare to raise his head, just kept waiting for the further orders.
"How many knights did Alistair take with him." Finally he heard the question, which calmed down his nerves a little and he answered without raising his head.
"My lord, for Silver Knights 100, for Bronze Knights 500, for Iron Knights 15,000, and for Body Temper 50,000. All this army consisted of Infantry, archers, and Cavalry-"
"And they still failed..." But then his voice cut off, on which sweat formed on his forehead and he said.
"My lord, Blackstone Territory holds a powerful Early Golden Stage Knight. And she single-handedly forced the army back."

Viscount Aldric Ashenford, who was getting angry from hearing this, but then he got stunned when the Golden Knight part was mentioned. ’From where did that backward, dying territory bring a Golden Knight?’

’Did someone help? Like my enemies? Or did the Count interfere himself?’ Aldric kept thinking about all the possible answers regarding this Golden Knight’s sudden appearance, but then he heard something else which shocked him the most.
"And my lord, our spies in Blackstone sent the news that Baron Luke, along with Aurielle, has returned."
"What?" The instant the butler finished speaking, Aldric shot to his feet. His throne scraped violently across the floor as a look of utter disbelief twisted his face.
Boom!
And the overwhelming aura of a Mid-Golden Knight erupted from his body like a volcanic explosion, crashing through the room in an invisible wave.

"Ugh...!" The butler, merely a Peak Bronze Knight, was crushed to the floor before he could even react. His knees slammed against the ground, his palms instinctively bracing himself as cold sweat streamed down his face. Every breath became a struggle, and horror filled his eyes.
Rumble...

The entire mansion trembled under the pressure. Chandeliers swayed violently, windows rattled, and decorative ornaments clattered onto the floor. Dust drifted from the ceiling as the oppressive aura spread through every corridor.
The maids let out frightened gasps, hastily grabbing pillars, tables, and walls to keep their balance. Some nearly collapsed under the invisible pressure, their faces turning pale.

Even the knights patrolling outside suddenly stiffened. Their expressions changed drastically as they instinctively gripped their weapons, beads of sweat forming on their foreheads while they looked toward the lord’s residence in alarm.
Not far away, a man with iron-gray hair and dark brown eyes slowly raised his head toward the trembling mansion. "Aldric is angry," and he muttered calmly.
Although he addressed their lord by name, none of the nearby knights dared rebuke him. Instead, they lowered their heads slightly, knowing full well he possessed the qualifications to do so.
Because the person is the Commander of the Ashenford army, Sorin Ironclad, an Early Golden Knight with years of experience.
He waved his hand and his Aether spread out, which suppressed the surrounding suppressive aura.
On this, the surrounding knights got amazed again, because even though Sorin is an Early Golden Knight, he is at peak, and his mastery of his Aether is also top-tier.
After reducing the pressure, Sorin headed straight toward the mansion.

’How could this happen!’ Aldric was again lost in thought, but this time with worry, because he had ordered a Golden Knight-level assassin from the Hidden Hand, and now here he was hearing the report that Luke had come home safely and didn’t mention anything about them being injured at all.
’Did someone really interfere?’ His thoughts kept going again and again toward this angle.
CREEK!
Then his thoughts were interrupted when Sorin opened the door and moved close toward him without being affected by his aura.
"Sorin." His name escaped his mouth and his eyes lit up. "Go take the remaining army with you and take down Blackstone Highlands and also deal with that Early Golden Knight."
As Sorin entered, he got bombarded with new orders, but this confused him. ’Golden Knight? Since when does Blackstone Territory have a Golden Knight?’ So he asked Aldric about the details.
Aldric didn’t get angry at him, because Sorin was his old friend, which was also why he was the army commander of Ashenford.
When Sorin entered the hall, Aldric’s pressure also retracted back, which allowed the butler to breathe a sigh of relief. So he again got in a kneeling position.
Sorin heard everything, even the part of Luke’s failed assassination, which also worried him. ’There is definitely a third party involved. Or else who could have dealt with an Early Golden Knight.’
After Aldric finished saying everything, he nodded and left the room, because he had to prepare the army.
Aldric saw Sorin leaving, which also reduced his tension somewhat. ’Now that Golden Knight is dead for sure.’ And this thought came into his mind.
But still a small uneasiness remained in his heart when he thought about Luke’s failed assassination.

So he looked toward the butler, who was now kneeling again, and ordered, "Send the letter to the Hidden Hand and write, ’Clear your mess, or else if he survives, then he will come for you as well.’" And waved his hand to go away.

The butler nodded and stood up to leave the room, but while he was moving, he was thinking one thing. ’Will those people even agree to this?’ Though he still didn’t dare to voice out his thoughts and did what had been told to him.
Again a meeting was being held inside the dark chamber, but this time the main head seat was empty, and only Platinum Knight-level black-robed men were seated.

"What do you think about the Viscount’s letter?" One person asked everyone, on which all of them fell into deep thought. Because they also heard that Executioner was dead, as his soul lamp was destroyed.

"Seems like a third party was involved." One person said his thoughts out loud, because none of those present here believed that a talentless hero who was at the Early Iron Knight stage could do this.

Though their details were outdated, as Luke was already an Early Bronze Knight. Still, even if they knew that, they couldn’t relate this to Luke, because a Bronze killing a Golden would only happen if a God Child did that.
"Then should we send more Executioners?" The person with the letter asked everyone, on which they thought for a moment before nodding.
With that, the meeting adjourned and everyone left the room. Only the letter-holding person remained. ’Those demon worshipers also want heroes for an unknown reason.’
He recalled this info, which only high-level members knew, but because of his connection he also found this. ’Should I sell the hero to them?’ And this thought came into his mind.
Because he needed more resources for his Diamond Knight breakthrough.
Though after a moment, he shook his head, because this plan was very risky.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: The Army at the Gates?!
paragraphs: For Blackstone citizens, who were always living in poverty and suppression. Finally, something happened that changed their lives.
Recently, the new lord was appointed by the princess, though they don’t even have seen her clearly in those years, and only a few occasional glances of her could be seen during these long years.
So when she changed the lord, none of them cared much. Because they knew, their lives were going to be the same, "poor" "Suppressed" "Slaves" "Helpless"
But then a miracle occurred.
Soon news spread, that the new lord had imprisoned the water manager, because of his exploitation.

At the start, no one believed, so when the villagers confirmed by themselves, they found out. That lord has not only punished him but even filled all the wells near the residence and farms. He also supplied enough water for the whole month for free.

Everyone thought this was a dream, however, when they tasted the water, tears came out from their eyes, and finally all the gathered people felt. "It was real." With that, each of them cried for the whole day with happiness or with relief. That from now on they don’t have to beg even for water.
Sadly, this happiness didn’t last long, and all the villagers heard the news, that the Lord’s estate got attacked and many soldiers rebelled during this.
And this brought fear to everyone, however, every one of them still prayed for the good lord, who extinguished their thirst for water.

So after a whole night of battle, the citizens finally heard the news of the lord’s victory, which made every one of them happy, but before they could celebrate, the bad news came, that the Lord had killed the enemy’s two nobles and now the territory was doomed.

With that, many soldiers and families left the territory, but tt-they couldn’t do that. Because each of them was born here and lived here, and even if the citizens wanted to...then they couldn’t, the reason being every one of them didn’t have enough money.
So everyone waited for the nobles rage, but the next day, the Lord came out again and dealt with the gangs which were harassing everyone for decades.

Seeing this, the gathered people thought, that...m-maybe the lord could save the territory and every one of them really didn’t have to run anymore, so the citizens waited and another news came of the lord clearing the surrounding bandits. Which increased their morale even more.

However, one problem still remained. All of them were hungry. Even though everyone had become numb to this, but this year, water shortage problems occurred many times, resulting in crops getting destroyed.
So previously, when the elders tried to ask the princess lord for help. The vice commander Roland didn’t let them enter the gate at all. Even beat them mercilessly.
But surprisingly, this time every one of them heard another news, that the new lord had released jobs for everyone, which included their meals and even money for their families.

On that day, every single person in Blackstone felt as though the heavens themselves had blessed them. For the first time in what felt like a lifetime, they went to sleep with full stomachs after an honest day’s work. No gnawing hunger. No empty bowls. No despair.
Warm smiles appeared on everyone faces that had long forgotten how to smile, while laughter quietly returned to homes that had remained silent for years.
"God bless our Lord..."
The heartfelt prayer escaped countless lips, carried by the evening breeze as if the entire territory itself was whispering its gratitude.
And for the next several days, those same words continued to echo through every village, every street, and every household in Blackstone, becoming the most heartfelt blessing anyone could offer.
Then each of them heard, that the Lord was going to another territory for something, which brought an uneasiness in them.
As the Lord was here and everything was going alright, but suddenly the lord was going out, which started making them afraid.

And what the citizens had feared finally came to pass. No sooner had the lord departed than countless newcomers began pouring into the territory, enlisting in the army. With no one left to keep them in check, they soon started oppressing and harassing the helpless citizens, turning their lives into a waking nightmare.
On this, the elders tried to complain, but couldn’t meet the higher-ups.

Soon afterward, word spread that Viscount Ashenford’s army was marching toward the territory. The news struck the gathered citizens like a bolt from the heavens, making it feel as though the very ground had vanished beneath their feet.

Panic erupted instantly, and despair spread through the crowd. With trembling hearts, they could only pray for one miracle—that their lord would return once more. Only then, they believed, might there still be hope to save them.
But days passed and the lord didn’t come, instead came the army. Which led them to think they were doomed for sure, but something different happened.
The Ashenford army, which came with valor. Was beaten so badly that they had to run with shame and fear.

Which surprised everyone and all the citizens tried to find out what happened. So when they really found out, everyone again praised their lord. Because "Lord has left his strongest commander to protect the territory." And she did.

Though the atmosphere of fear didn’t disappear, it gradually began to subside. Before long, the citizens watched as the adventurers and greedy merchants abandoned the territory one after another. As they left, they all repeated the same grim words:
"Once Viscount Ashenford’s main army arrives, this territory is doomed for sure."
Which also worried them a lot, so they closed their gates and windows tightly and also stopped going outside. Hoping that the army didn’t touch them as every one of them was an innocent citizen.
So while everyone was waiting, they heard the lord had returned, which excited everyone. However each of them still couldn’t bring themselves out. The cause was the Ashenford main army.
So they remained hidden in the hope, that everything would be over soon.
Present day.
THOOM... THOOM... THOOM... THOOM... THOOM... THOOM...
The morning sunrays came toward Blackstone territory and came along with the sound of an army marching.
"W-What?! An... army?!"

Startled awake, every sleeping citizen sprang from their beds and hurried to their windows, cautiously pushing them open just enough to peek outside. But the moment their eyes fell upon the scene beyond, every one of them was left utterly stunned.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Luke’s Greatest Gamble!
paragraphs: Outside, thousands of soldiers wearing the Blackstone Highlands logo, along with flags, were marching toward the exit.
Clank! Clink! Clang!
With each motion, the sound of their weapons colliding with their armor could be heard.

"We have soo many soldiers? How could we not know?" The citizens started whispering those words with shocked expression and the same was happening with many Body Temper Realm cultivators, who were also included in this army.
’Thousands of Bronze Knights and hundreds of Silver Knights!!!’ Many spies and people who had sold themselves, became frightened after seeing this number.
Because when they had counted the knight earlier, there hadn’t been nearly this many. A single question echoed through every body temper soldier mind.
’Then... where did all these knights come from?’
Clip-clop! Clip-clop!
Then, the thunderous rumble of thousands of warhorses shook the streets, their synchronized hoofbeats echoing like rolling thunder across the territory.
Riding at the forefront were the pillars of Blackstone.
"The Lord..."
"The Baroness..."
"Commander Osric..."
"That Brute Force Girl..."
...and many other renowned figures whose names had already become known throughout the territory.
The moment the citizens recognized them, countless eyes lit up with hope.
Luke, from the start, had hidden his large number of soldiers inside the Time Chamber, or that was true for the Bronze Knights.
So the people getting surprised was very normal.
"We are saved!!!" Soon Luke heard the cheers from many houses and their gates also flung open.
Soon the whole roads and streets filled with people, and all of them, with hope in their eyes, looked toward him.
Seeing this, Luke raised his hand and shouted, "HALT!", the result...
SKRRAK! THUD! CLANK!
In a single heartbeat, thousands of marching feet stopped as one. Armor clinked, weapons settled, and an eerie silence swallowed the whole lord estate.
Luke looked around and saw everyone’s expectant gaze, so he raised his voice and said.

"INVADERS HAVE STEPPED INTO OUR LAND. BUT THEY FORGOT WHO RULES HERE." Luke paused after this and saw everyone’s eyes were also filled with fury, because this was the land they had lived in, and now someone wanted to claim it.
"SO WE SHALL SHOW THEM... SHOW THE WHOLE WORLD! THAT BLACKSTONE IS NOT THE PLACE WHERE THEY CAN COME AND GO FREELY."
"ARE YOU AGREE!" Luke shouted toward everyone and the next second the answer also came.
THUMP!! THUMP!! THUMP!!
Soon thousands of synchronized footsteps came, as the soldiers and the citizens started thumping their feet on the ground.
"INVADER MUST DIE!!!"
"INVADER MUST DIE!!!"
"INVADER MUST DIE!!!"
"And they will." Luke heard them and said in a normal voice, before again starting to march toward the downhill.
Aurielle and others also followed Luke with different expressions.
Seeing this, the spies panicked while the scouts observing from afar also noticed this commotion and relayed the information back toward the army.
Soon the onlookers who had also come to watch the show, got this information and started gathering around the area.
"Please, sister, if something happened to Sir Luke, then you will save him." Nyra said worriedly toward Octavia, who facepalmed herself.
Because yesterday she was forced to come here by her little sister, who pleaded with her so much.
While new onlookers kept gathering and already discussing the outcome of the battle. though a person from high above was looking down at everything calmly and muttered.
"And they will."
The person who said that was also...Luke!
Two Lukes.
In the air, was situated an ancient magic tower, which was floating without any supports, and its whole body runes were glowing.
"Master, we are ready." Luke heard the ten mages’ voices come from behind as they asked for his permission.
On this, Luke recalled his earlier talk with Aurielle.
"Here, take this." Luke handed Aurielle 10 small iron balls.
Aurielle looked down at the glowing iron balls, which had many runes engraved on them. "What’s this?"
She raised her face and asked Luke.
On this, Luke replied. "Warwalker Fortress." Then explained, just throw them on the ground before pressing this red button and soon a large Warwalker Fortress will appear.
He also told her its benefits, which he didn’t explain at the start. But this confused Aurielle even more and she asked. "Why don’t you do this by yourself? I mean, why are you giving me these?"
After hearing that, he paused and took a breath...before telling the crazy thing he was going to do.
"I will go to Windmarch Reach and kill the Viscount by myself."
Aurielle’s eyes widened to the extreme upon this, because the Viscount was a mid-Golden Knight and going to his territory, where many defenses would be present, was a clear suicide.
"NO." So she immediately declined this, but Luke shook his head and said.
"Aurielle, you know. If we even win this war, we can’t kill him as he is a noble."
At this, she paused, and lost in thought. Because she also knew, if the Viscount was left alone, then he would retaliate in the future for sure.
Because he had lost his son and brother to us and also the assassination part. If exposed then he will face empire or kingdom forces.
’But we don’t have any proof, which points this assassination toward the Viscount.’ She thought worriedly and Luke also noticed this.
"So that’s why I have to do this." He said while holding her shoulder. On this, she looked into his eyes, which were shining with confidence, but she was still worried.

"And don’t worry, my recent transformation has something, which can take care of the Viscount, plus I still have Queen wards." Luke reassured her more and more, even mentioning, that his third form no one had seen. So no one would be able to find him suspicious.
’After all, how can an early Bronze Knight kill a mid-Golden Knight?’ This was also his confidence, which would save his territory from suspicion and finish the enemy as well.
Despite this, Aurielle still didn’t agree and suggested bringing someone, however Luke shook his head and finally after 10 minutes, she agreed.

"Promise me, you will come back safe." Aurielle asked this and Luke nodded. "Sure, how can I ignore my most beautiful wife’s words." Hearing his sweet talk brought a small blush to her face. And how could Luke let go of this chance, so he leaned in and kissed her deeply.
"Master is doing this again." Aurora muttered while eating roasted meat, beside her Vaelira looked worriedly toward her master.

Even though they were at a far distance, both of them could hear their talk clearly. ’Please be safe, Master.’ Vaelira prayed, While Aurora just kept eating, because Master had already told her to protect Aurielle since she was strong. In return, Master would protect her. So she agreed.
After a few minutes, he separated and muttered the words in his mind, ’Nyx first form.’ and the next instant his body blurred for a moment, before another Luke appeared in beside him.
The second Luke looked toward him before nodding and moved toward the exit, while Luke moved toward the mages.
Aurielle looked at everything worriedly, but she also followed behind the second Luke. Because Luke had told her to hide this Luke as much as possible.
Luke, while moving, thought, ’Nyx Shadow is really something.’ because first, the clone didn’t have any distance limit. Second, his clone could do everything and had all his memories.
It was just that his stamina was being consumed while this form was active, but because he was in the Bronze Realm, he had plenty of stamina.
As he was thinking all this, he heard Nyx’s voice from inside, ’Luke, don’t change to another form or transform into another Titan. Because the moment you do, your clone will disappear.’
At this, he nodded and told the mages to be prepared.
"Now it’s your time." Luke, after reaching the Mage Tower, muttered. Because he had always wanted to try this, and now was the perfect moment.
