chapters.title: Chapter 119: The Hero They Mocked Is Finally Revealed
paragraphs: In the Ashenford army camp...
Inside the tent Alistair was telling Sorin everything about his previous encounter with the Blackstone Golden Knight.
Then suddenly one soldier entered without announcing his arrival, his breath was high. Seems like he had run straight here.
Alistair and Sorin paused on this, and turned toward him with inquiring eyes, while Alistair gave him the displeased glare.
The soldier flinched at the vice commander’s gaze, because the news was so important, that in panic he forgot to announce his arrival.
Alistair became even more displeased, after seeing the soldier was not saying anything, so he shouted. "What’s happened!"
This brought the soldier out of his afraid state and then he told the news he was carrying with a nervous voice. "S-Sir! The Blackstone armies are marching toward us!"

Upon hearing this Alistair’s face became completely pale, while Sorin just raised his eyebrow, because he never knew that the Blackstone legions were so brave, that they would left their safe ground, their advantageous position.
On the side, Sorin also noticed Alistair’s pale face, on which he shook his head and asked other things from the soldier.
Soon the soldier answered everything one by one, like the numbers of knights and Body Temper soldiers, while also detailing about warhorses and other units. In the last he also added.
"Sir, Baron Luke, along with Baroness an-" On the last part he gave a nervous look toward the pale-faced Alistair, who was also listening to everything after getting a little calm down.
But seeing the soldier’s look, a bad premonition rose into his heart, while Sorin urged the soldier to continue.
"Sir, that early Golden Knight woman is also among them." The moment the soldier finished, a bam sound echoed and Alistair, with horror, slammed against the table.
Sorin, seeing this, became confused, because he did hear about their loss in defeat, but why Alistair was being so afraid of her.
Alistair, didn’t care about the looks Sorin was giving him, because even though he didn’t get much wounded from the earlier fight, but her attacks were really painful. Which he never felt before.
Seeing Alistair was not in any condition to lead, he ordered the soldier to prepare everyone and with that he also headed out, while leaving a word for Alistair, "Rest for a few minutes, then come.

On the place, where battle will likely going to happen, the surrounding onlookers were discussing the outcome of the battle with excited tone. Hell, some even bet 10,000 gold coins on Ashenford victory, while saying.
"The Blackstone territory is going to lose for sure. Because I have seen the numbers and they are not their match at all."
But the many onlookers, didn’t participate in their betting, they just waited for the battle to begin.
Nyra and Octavia were standing a little far from everyone, but even then many noble men and women had surrounded both of them, while keep trying to exchange in conversation with them.

On this Nyra only gave occasional nods and didn’t much reply to the groups. After that she observed the surrounding, that around 20 baron territory people’s, which were under her father’s rule, had come here.
’Don’t they have any work to do.’ She thought irritably, after noticing some noble descendants among the crowds.
Following that her gaze turned to the other side, there merchants and adventurers had made their own separate groups, but even then their numbers were way more than the nobles.
"Sophia, we should not be here." Damien Blackriver, the eldest brother of Sophia Blackriver said.
Sophia stood there with a smile, patiently waiting for Sir Luke. Ever since he had saved her, her faith in him had never wavered.
Hearing her brother complain for what felt like the hundredth time, she smiled and replied, "Brother, you should have faith in Sir Luke. I know he’ll win this war. I’m certain of it."
Sophia was not confident about this earlier, but after hearing that the Blackstone territory also had an Golden Knight, she decided to bet on Blackstone and share these thoughts with her family.

Even though she kept insisting that Blackstone was the future and that they needed to support Sir Luke to strengthen their family’s influence, her father only replied, "We will wait for the outcome of this war."
And that was how she and Damien ended up here.
Damien, still shook his head, because he heard. That the Ashenford main army was already here and now they have two early Golden Knights, in which one was the renowned Sorin Ironclad.

And this thought was also shared by many adventurers and merchant groups, but still everyone decided to gather here. Because many merchants wanted to sign the deal with the Ashenford family here first.
Sadly for them, they were celebrating far too soon.

Luke had already made his decision. Once the war was over, every merchant who had refused to sign a trade agreement with Blackstone Territory beforehand would pay a heavy price for crossing his lands.
This was Luke’s way of retaliating against those who had turned their backs on Blackstone when it needed them most.
While the adventurer groups were here for fun and were also looking, if they could join the interested party territory, which is likely the Ashenford.
"They are here!!!"
The cry echoed across the battlefield, and everyone immediately turned toward the grasslands.
In the distance, a massive army emerged, tens of thousands strong, marching beneath an ash-gray banner bearing the emblem of "an Iron Fist Clutching a Broken Silver Chain"
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Their overwhelming momentum shook the very earth beneath their feet as they advanced like an unstoppable tide.
At the front rode the renowned Sorin Ironclad, the commander of the Ashenford Army. Beside him marched the vice commander, a brown-haired man and a direct relative of the Ashenford family.
"The Blackstone Legions are here as well!!!"
Another shout rang across the battlefield, drawing everyone’s attention toward the mountains.
There, another army was descending the slopes. Although far smaller in number, its disciplined ranks marched with unwavering precision. In just a few moments, they would arrive at the battlefield.
As everyone waited for a few minutes, finally both armies stopped 1 km apart from each other.
Sorin looked toward the Blackstone legion and also saw the recently popular Hero, though in a negative way. But when he observed more, he found out that the Hero was way different from the rumors.
’He is not afraid.’ Yeah, that piqued his curiosity, there he was sitting on a warhorse calmly, while Luke was also observing his army.

Seeing Alistair was not in any condition to lead, he ordered the soldier to prepare everyone and with that he also headed out, while leaving a word for Alistair, "Rest for a few minutes, then come.
On the place, where battle will likely going to happen, the surrounding onlookers were discussing the outcome of the battle with excited tone.
Hell, some even bet 10,000 gold coins on Ashenford victory, while saying.
"The Blackstone territory is going to lose for sure.
Because I have seen the numbers and they are not their match at all."
But the many onlookers, didn’t participate in their betting, they just waited for the battle to begin.
Nyra and Octavia were standing a little far from everyone, but even then many noble men and women had surrounded both of them, while keep trying to exchange in conversation with them.
On this Nyra only gave occasional nods and didn’t much reply to the groups.
After that she observed the surrounding, that around 20 baron territory people’s, which were under her father’s rule, had come here.
’Don’t they have any work to do.’ She thought irritably, after noticing some noble descendants among the crowds.
Following that her gaze turned to the other side, there merchants and adventurers had made their own separate groups, but even then their numbers were way more than the nobles.
"Sophia, we should not be here." Damien Blackriver, the eldest brother of Sophia Blackriver said.
Sophia stood there with a smile, patiently waiting for Sir Luke.
Ever since he had saved her, her faith in him had never wavered.
Hearing her brother complain for what felt like the hundredth time, she smiled and replied, "Brother, you should have faith in Sir Luke.
I know he’ll win this war.
I’m certain of it."
Sophia was not confident about this earlier, but after hearing that the Blackstone territory also had an Golden Knight, she decided to bet on Blackstone and share these thoughts with her family.

Even though she kept insisting that Blackstone was the future and that they needed to support Sir Luke to strengthen their family’s influence, her father only replied, "We will wait for the outcome of this war."
And that was how she and Damien ended up here.
Damien, still shook his head, because he heard.
That the Ashenford main army was already here and now they have two early Golden Knights, in which one was the renowned Sorin Ironclad.
And this thought was also shared by many adventurers and merchant groups, but still everyone decided to gather here.
Because many merchants wanted to sign the deal with the Ashenford family here first.
Sadly for them, they were celebrating far too soon.
Luke had already made his decision.
Once the war was over, every merchant who had refused to sign a trade agreement with Blackstone Territory beforehand would pay a heavy price for crossing his lands.
This was Luke’s way of retaliating against those who had turned their backs on Blackstone when it needed them most.
While the adventurer groups were here for fun and were also looking, if they could join the interested party territory, which is likely the Ashenford.
"They are here!!!"
The cry echoed across the battlefield, and everyone immediately turned toward the grasslands.
In the distance, a massive army emerged, tens of thousands strong, marching beneath an ash-gray banner bearing the emblem of "an Iron Fist Clutching a Broken Silver Chain"
Thud!
Thud!
Thud!
Their overwhelming momentum shook the very earth beneath their feet as they advanced like an unstoppable tide.
At the front rode the renowned Sorin Ironclad, the commander of the Ashenford Army.
Beside him marched the vice commander, a brown-haired man and a direct relative of the Ashenford family.
"The Blackstone Legions are here as well!!!"
Another shout rang across the battlefield, drawing everyone’s attention toward the mountains.
There, another army was descending the slopes.
Although far smaller in number, its disciplined ranks marched with unwavering precision.
In just a few moments, they would arrive at the battlefield.
As everyone waited for a few minutes, finally both armies stopped 1 km apart from each other.
Sorin looked toward the Blackstone legion and also saw the recently popular Hero, though in a negative way.
But when he observed more, he found out that the Hero was way different from the rumors.
’He is not afraid.’ Yeah, that piqued his curiosity, there he was sitting on a warhorse calmly, while Luke was also observing his army.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Ashenford’s Army Trembles Before the Nyx Titan
paragraphs: ’Does he have that much confidence in the Golden Knight woman?’ and this thought came into his mind, before he turned his gaze toward Aurora, there she was wearing black-silver armour with a white cape that could be seen fluttering.
Her long silver-white hair, flowed gracefully, and she carried one silver sword and a round silver shield with her.
When he was observing her, Aurora’s eyes also turned toward him. There he couldn’t see even a little bit of fear in those eyes as well, which again confused him.
If Aurora would know his thoughts, then she would just laugh at those, because when she was beside her master and was protecting him. Her power increased by a large margin.
Alistair beside Sorin, also saw Aurora, but this time he didn’t react strongly and controlled himself, during that he tried to think how she would soon lose to him, and this somewhat calmed him down.
Luke also observed the Ashenford army and felt, that Sorin was powerful.

’I can use Nyx ascension with this clone, so my power will reach peak Bronze Knight and if I use Nyx ability then killing a Silver Knight is not a big problem, but-’ he did all the calculation in his mind but he couldn’t do anything to a Golden Knight with this clone, even if he summoned more numbers.
Fortunately he doesn’t even need to. As Aurielle, Vaelira and Aurora are more than enough to take care of an early Golden Knight, even if the knight is someone renowned at a time.
"Baron Luke!!" Then Sorin’s loud voice came from the front, on which everyone’s attention turned toward him, and the same for Luke and his armies as well.
Seeing Luke’s attention was on him, Sorin said. "This is the last chance, Baron Luke! Surrender and you will face mercy regarding Roland and Darius Ashenford’s murder!"
His loud voice was heard by everyone, which is a clear tactic to demoralize the enemies, while setting themselves as heroes.
The surrounding nobles and other people also understood this, but Sorin’s words do have a point about Roland and Darius part.

Luke also heard Sorin’s words, but rather than replying, he dismounted from the warhorse. Seeing this everyone got baffled, even Sorin and Alistair felt, ’that’s it??’ because this scene looks like Luke is going to really surrender.
Nyra and Sophia’s faces changed at this, while Damien and Octavia shook their heads and thought. ’This is over.’
While everyone was lost in their own thoughts, they were abruptly snapped out of them the very next second as Luke’s loud voice echoed across the battlefield.
Yet something about it felt... wrong.
"From the darkness beyond the world’s edge... Awaken, Nyx Titan!"
And the next instant a deep darkness began to spread from Luke’s feet. With that the surrounding shadows also stretched unnaturally.

It was as though an invisible mountain had descended upon the battlefield. Every Body Temper Realm, regardless of strength or status, suddenly found it difficult to breathe. Their chests tightened, their legs trembled, and an instinctive fear surged from the depths of their souls.
It didn’t matter who they were. Every single Body Temper Realm expert present felt the same terrifying suffocation.

’W-What’s happening?!’ Panic spread like wildfire as countless frightened gazes turned toward the center of the anomaly, where the endless darkness continued to expand, as though something unimaginably ancient was about to emerge from its depths.
BOOM.
A powerful shockwave erupted from Luke’s body. His muscles expanded along with bone-cracking sounds and it reshaped itself.
CRACK. CRACK. CRACK.
Almost everyone present got goosebumps by this scene, because only a few had even seen Luke’s Nyx Titan, like Nyra, Sophia and Octavia and some more, but even at that time, it was not like this.
And that was true. Luke’s Titan had existed long before creation itself. "So how could its form be so ordinary?"
The answer was simple—Luke had been far too weak at the beginning to withstand its true power, let alone shape or alter its form.
However after reaching Bronze Knight, his body became somewhat capable, though still a very minute level change, but it was there.
That’s why Nyx Titan Ascension was adjusting its power and making Luke the perfect Bronze Realm Nyx Titan.
So perfect that even if the real Nyx was here at Bronze level, then he would feel inferior. And that’s what the system has done to Luke.
Then Luke body began to expand. Six feet... Seven... Eight... And it continued growing with every passing second.

As his physique enlarged, his upper garments slowly retracted until only his pants remained. As he was wearing specially crafted size-changing clothes, which was stretching and adjusting to accommodate his ever-growing frame.

At the same time, his hair lengthened rapidly, cascading past his shoulders before reaching his waist. Its color gradually shifted into a deep, dark blue, flowing unnaturally despite the presence of wind, as though it existed under laws different from the world itself.
Then his eyes transformed.
Twin flames of azure fire ignited within them, burning with an ancient, terrifying brilliance.

Black-blue runic markings spread across his body like living veins, covering his chest, arms, neck, and back. Each rune was incomparably more intricate than the last, pulsing with a mysterious power that seemed capable of distorting reality itself.
The battlefield fell into complete silence.
Every witness stared at the bizarre transformation with widening eyes as an instinctive dread crawled up their spines.
It didn’t matter whether they were Body Temper Realm cultivators or mighty Golden Knights.
Before them stood something that no longer belonged among humans.
Not a hunter...
But a true apex predator.
A forgotten existence that had earned that title through countless ages of bloodshed, leaving behind nothing but fear in the hearts of all who gazed upon it.
"Warden of the Void Path."
Luke slowly swept his gaze across the battlefield. Everyone who was staring back at him, frozen between awe and terror.
Yet he frowned. Because he could feel it.
Something was missing. ’I’m still... incomplete.’
Despite the overwhelming power surging through his veins, he instinctively knew this was not the perfect form of a Bronze Nyx Titan.
’I need more strength... or a body capable of containing all of this power.’ While tightening his fist, Luke took a slow breath.
Just when everyone believed the terrifying transformation had finally come to an end...
Luke spoke once more.
"Descend... Velzareth!"

chapters.title: Chapter 121: The Crown of Void Appears... Even Golden Knights Feel Fear
paragraphs: Luke’s voice echoed across the battlefield once more—louder than before, yet strangely suppressed at the same time.
The contradiction confused everyone. How could a voice be both overwhelming and quiet at the same time? How could it reach every ear without being shouted?
They didn’t understand, nor could they.
Because Nyx was the Void Titan. And the Void didn’t need to shout.
"The Void simply brought its voice to whoever it wanted to hear."
As they were in the middle of their thoughts, behind Luke the air began to distort, which attracted their attention again toward him.

Then a crack formed in reality from which a black void that seemed to swallow all the light could be seen. Eventually it widened slowly, on which they unconsciously forced their eyes to see what was inside, and soon they found something.

There within the endless darkness, a suit of ancient armor floated silently, whose whole metal was black, while azure-blue runes flowed across its surface like living veins. And lastly a dark cape swayed gently despite the complete absence of wind.
Seeing this, an name came into everyone’s mind. "Velzareth", they just knew, that Luke’s earlier words were for this and the name of the armor was Velzareth.
Sorin narrowed his eyes but didn’t dare interrupt. Even he could sense that if he came into contact with that black darkness, he would be erased completely without the slightest chance to resist.
For the first time in a long while, he felt fear—a fear he had almost forgotten.
The next second, Velzareth separated into different pieces and one by one attached to giant Luke’s body.
’So cool.’ Some adventurers and nobles, seeing this, felt awe and thought wearing this would make them cool as well.
Though Velzareth’s attaching process didn’t stop for those onlookers and soon everything completely clicked and bound to Luke.

Now, he stood as a fully armored Titan, towering fourteen feet tall. His breakthrough to the Bronze Knight realm had likely caused the transformation, and a dark cape flowed majestically behind his armor.
’Now it’s enough!’ With that he released his pressure fully, which the Void was holding for him.
WHOSSSSH!
His aura didn’t erupt like an explosion. Instead, a silent ripple spread through the air, sweeping across the battlefield.

Everyone below the Silver Knight realm was forced backward by its overwhelming pressure. Even the Silver Knights would have suffered the same fate had they not immediately used their own strength to resist.

’Interesting.’ As the Void disappeared, the threat Sorin was feeling also disappeared, and when he felt Luke’s aura, which was close to Peak Bronze Knight. But there he could, or everyone could, feel Luke was still an Early Bronze Knight...wait??? "Early Bronze Knight!!!"
Sorin’s eyes widened, and the surrounding onlookers as well. "How!!!"
And this shout escaped from many mouths, though Sorin controlled himself. But he was baffled the same as others.

Because Luke was declared talentless, so the amount of resources he needed to reach each realm was insane. Of course, none of them knew, that Luke couldn’t cultivate at all, the reason there were some people in Valtharion who were also declared talentless or born talentless, but they could still cultivate with resources.

So everyone’s mind was filled with one question. ’Where did he get those huge amounts of resources or does he have some huge secrets?’ Since Aurielle is exiled and couldn’t help him reach Bronze Knight at all.
With this some nobles, merchants and even adventurers eyes turned red with envy and... with greed.
Alistair shared the same thought, but he mocked other people’s, because even if they couldn’t kill Luke because he was a Hero.
But his secrets still belonged to the Ashenford family, so he will also get the benefits.
Meanwhile, 10 km far from the battlefield five figures with plain masks, were hiding and watching everything on the battlefield.

"Sir, if we get the Hero’s secret, then wouldn’t we also become strong." one person with a red plain mask and the other three who also had same mask, said to the front person, who was wearing an orange plain mask with a normal mercenary outfit.
"Idiot." The second man smacked him on the head before saying, "He’s only one, so how could all of us share that secret? Only Sir is worthy of using it."
As he said the last word, he glanced at the man standing in front of them.
Because he wanted to make a connection with him.
Soren paid no attention to their conversation and simply reprimanded them. "Remember, we are not from the Hidden Hand Organization. Whatever we do, it must never point back to the organization.
*{The Black Hand orginization which keep sending assassin are The Hidden Hand. the name has been fixed.}*
At this everyone’s expression, became serious, because they had got a special mission, kill the Hero at all cost, without bringing the name of their organization.
While they were thinking this, Soren’s thoughts were somewhere else. ’That Saintness lied to everyone.’ Soren cursed the Saintness of the Holy Church.
Because the Hero’s growth was too suspicious, ’only two weeks and he is already a Bronze Knight.’ Clearly the Goddess of Light did this, and the reason he could see.

’He is too talented and can fight above his realm.’ Soren felt maybe because of this reason, as even the previous Heroes or other Hero summons this time, were at the Silver Realm already, but they had been given the resources of the whole empire.
’So how could he without any resources grow so fast.’ That’s why he didn’t believe this, but still he didn’t relate Luke with the Golden Assassination Death, because it was too absurd.
’Maybe a helper.’ and this is the reason, the organization decided to send him, a Mid-Golden Knight assassin along with four Early Golden Knight assassins.
The surrounding darkness which was spread earlier, suddenly started gathering above Luke head and soon a ring made of condensed Void energy formed.
The ring did not spread light, instead it was just a dark halo that pulsed with each heartbeat, casting a faint shadow over Luke’s face.
"A Crown of Void."
And with this Luke finally felt complete. ’Hmm... it’s good.’ So he clenched his fist, which created a small shockwave.
Then calculated that before his strength with a 1x stats multiplier, was a Peak Bronze Knight. But now he was just shy of crossing into Early Silver Knight.

While he was feeling his new strength and the surrounding people looked at him with different expressions, and the Ashenford armies looked at him with wary expressions. Therefore 1000 Bronze Knights, immediately drew their weapons and shields to fight back. If Luke suddenly attacked them.

Subsequently the system’s voice also came inside Luke’s mind. [Luke, Crown of Void, has become a complete part of your Nyx Titan Ascension. And its ability allows you to detect any beings within 50 meters. Unless they have the ability to hide from the Void itself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 122: They Mocked Luke’s Army Until the Machine Empire’s War Machines Appeared
paragraphs: A very special thanks to "Souls 101" "BluuuuTea" "Zanatox", and everyone else who has supported this novel and continued to show your love and encouragement. Your support means a lot and motivates me to keep writing.
I hope everyone continues to support this novel and enjoy the journey ahead. Thank you all for reading!
Luke became surprised, that this halo also gave him an additional passive ability, ’but who is saying no to free things.’ With that he looked toward everyone and saw their wary expressions.
But he didn’t care about that and replied to Sorin’s earlier claims, which were heard by everyone. "I don’t know, where your bastard young master and his uncle have gone."
"Because if they were in front of me, then I would make sure to make them feel what happens when someone touches what’s mine."
GASP!
Everyone was already feeling shocked by Luke’s earlier transformation and after hearing his current words they gasped at his sheer arrogance.
Sorin also came out of his earlier thoughts after hearing Luke’s arrogant reply, but didn’t become angry, instead he raised his brow. ’Playing politics... not accepting until the end.’
While Nyra and Sophia’s expressions turned a little worried, even though Luke had broken through, he was still an Early Bronze Knight in realm.
So angering the Golden Knight could be disastrous and if they targeted him, then he would definitely get injured even with the Golden Knight’s protection.
But Aurielle merely smiled, thinking, ’He really would do that.’
Beside her, Aurora nodded in agreement. ’Master is the best.’
As for Vaelira, her gaze remained fixed on Sorin the entire time.
She was watching him closely, ready to act. If he dared to attack her master, she would retaliate instantly without hesitation.
Though all the Blackstone Legions remained silent, standing still as they waited for their master’s command.
While most of them were still mocking Luke for his earlier provocative words, they suddenly heard his voice echo across the battlefield once again.

"And now that you have touched my territory, so all of you pay the price for it." With that Luke pointed his giant finger toward Alastair, whose face became disgusted, because that Golden Knight woman is a different thing, but now he was getting pointed at by someone of a lower realm than him, which angered him.
Because even if the Viscount of another territory comes into their territory, they have to give him respect as well.
Seeing that the situation was not changing at all, Sorin shook his head and said, "Seems like talking is useless."

A hint of regret appeared in his eyes. The person standing before him was not just a Baron—before this, he had been a Hero. If Sorin harmed him openly, there was a possibility that he would anger the Holy Light Church.

’But I have to follow Aldaric’s order.’ plus he was also a little suspicious regarding Luke being talentless and now Luke had already become an enemy of the Ashenford family, so he had to capture Luke at all cost, though without hurting him.
Having thought so, he gave a look toward the angry Alastair, who nodded to him.
The next moment, Alastair raised his hand high and roared,
"ARCHERS!"
His command echoed across the battlefield.

Instantly, nearly twenty-four thousand archers—from Body Temper Realm soldiers to seasoned Bronze Knights—stepped forward in perfect unison. Then they raised their bows toward the sky and nocked their arrows with practiced precision.
Creak... Creak... Creak...
Thousands upon thousands of bowstrings were drawn simultaneously, their taut groans merging into a single, overwhelming sound that blanketed the battlefield.

In mere moments, a forest of arrows pointed toward the sky, their gleaming arrowheads reflecting a chilling promise of death, which made the air itself tense, as if the entire battlefield was holding its breath, waiting for Alastair’s next command.
Faced with the overwhelming display of force, Luke remained completely unfazed.
Instead of making a drastic move, he simply raised one hand.
Aurielle, at his side, immediately understood the silent command.
She gave a slight nod before taking out ten iron spheres, each engraved with intricate, glowing runes that pulsed with runic light.
Without the slightest hesitation, she hurled them in different directions across the battlefield.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The ten rune-covered iron spheres streaked through the air, before landing at random locations around the battlefield.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Then it happened, which even stunned the Ashenford Knights.
The moment the iron spheres struck the ground, glowing runes flared brilliantly.
Rumble...!
The spheres began to unfold.
Layers of enchanted metal expanded outward with a series of loud clanks, transforming the palm-sized objects into massive steel fortresses, each standing nearly ten meters tall and ten meters wide.
But the transformation wasn’t over.
Clank! Clank! Clank!

From both sides of each fortress, eight enormous mechanical legs extended one after another. Every leg measured nearly fourteen meters in length, piercing deep into the earth before lifting the colossal structures high above the battlefield like gigantic metallic beasts.
BOOM!
The ground trembled as all ten mechanical fortresses settled into position.
"T-This...!"
The onlookers cried out in astonishment, their eyes nearly popping out of their sockets.
They recognized the design immediately.

It perfectly matched the famous war machines of the Machine Empire—inventions spoken of only in stories and military records. Some had merely heard the tales, while a fortunate few had once witnessed such marvels from afar.

Yet none of them had ever imagined they would see ten of these colossal mechanical fortresses standing before them, radiating an overwhelming aura of technology and ancient craftsmanship. The sight alone was enough to leave the entire battlefield speechless.
But there was one problem.
The Machine Empire almost never sold its war machines to outsiders. Each creation was considered a national property, and even powerful kingdoms struggled to obtain a single one.
So why were they here? Soon confusion spread across the battlefield.
’Are they genuine...?’ ’Or are they merely replicas?’ That same question surfaced in everyone’s mind.
No one could tell whether these towering mechanical fortresses were authentic creations of the Machine Empire or flawless imitations. Yet one thing was certain—
Whether real or copied, the terrifying pressure they radiated was undeniably real.
While the onlookers were enjoying the spectacle, fifty Bronze Archer Knights from the Blackstone Legions suddenly leapt forward and mounted the Warwalker fortresses.
Following them, one hundred Marinthains also moved into position. They divided themselves into groups of ten before climbing onto each fortress.
The same happened with the high-ranking officers as well. Luke, Aurielle, Osric, Vaelira, and Aurora all moved toward the final Warwalker fortress and mounted it together.
Sadly, each fortress could only accommodate around eighty people while maintaining a reasonable level of comfort. Any more than that would make the space cramped and suffocating.
Because of this, the remaining knights and their warhorses took shelter behind each Warwalker fortress, using them as cover.

Alastair observed the Warwalker fortress, but couldn’t identify its tier. ’Enchanted? Refined? Or even higher?’ because even though its whole body was Black-Iron color, but occasional bronze runes could be seen on its surface.
’Whatever.’ He shook his head and ordered.
"FIRE!"

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Luke’s Five-Second Trap!
paragraphs: All 24 thousand archers released their arrows, and for a moment the sun hid behind them.
Everyone held their breath and waited. If the fortress could survive the arrows or not.

"My Lord, incoming attacks possess no serious threat to the fortress." One knight from the side said to Luke and also told him, that they don’t need to deploy stationary mode or Aether Shield for this.
Luke nodded, even though some of the arrows were released by Bronze Knights, but they were not their Aether attacks, so the fortress should be fine.
As the rain of arrows descended, the mechanical fortresses reacted instantly.
Rumble...!

Each fortress tilted backward in perfect synchronization, raising its massive frontal wall to face the incoming barrage. Forged from reinforced, enchanted steel, the thick armor became an impenetrable shield standing between the arrows and those behind it.
The next instant—
CLANG! CLINK! TING! KLANG!
A deafening storm of metallic impacts erupted across the battlefield.

Tens of thousands of arrows slammed into the enchanted steel, only to shatter, ricochet away, or fall harmlessly to the ground. Sparks burst with every collision, while the relentless barrage echoed like a thousand blacksmiths hammering their anvils at once.
Yet despite enduring the overwhelming volley, the colossal fortresses didn’t budge even an inch. They stood like immovable mountains, their enchanted walls effortlessly weathering the rain of arrows.
Seeing this everyone became astonished, but Alastair’s face fell, because they had failed the first attack completely and now the enemy’s attack would come.
And Luke did the same thing, "Ready the cannon." though this time only the people inside the fortress heard this.
"Yes, my Lord!" Every operator acknowledged in unison.
Clank! Clank! Clank!
The next instant, hidden compartments on each fortress opened with a series of metallic clicks.
Ten dark-gray Aether Cannons, each fitted with a 2.5-meter-long barrel, slowly emerged from every fortress. Their muzzles gleamed with engraved runes as gears locked them into firing position.
In total...
One hundred Aether Cannons turned in perfect synchronization. Their barrels slowly rose before locking onto a single target.
The Ashenford archers.

An eerie silence settled over the battlefield as the black muzzles stared directly at the enemy ranks, their glowing runes humming with restrained destructive power. Even before a single shot was fired, the archers felt an instinctive chill crawl down their spines, as though those unfamiliar weapons were far deadlier than any ballista or siege engine they had ever faced.
The moment Alastair saw the rows of unfamiliar cannons locking onto his archers, his expression hardened.
Raising his sword, he bellowed,
"Shields up! Protect the archers!"
"Yes, Commander!"
Without a moment’s hesitation, thousands of shield-bearing soldiers rushed forward, forming layer upon layer of defensive lines in front of the archers.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Tower shields slammed into the ground one after another, creating a solid wall of steel.
Bronze Knights and seasoned veterans positioned themselves at the front, while the remaining guards reinforced the formation from behind, overlapping their shields until almost no gaps remained.
In just a few breaths, a massive defensive barrier stood between the mysterious cannons and the Ashenford archers.
Yet despite the seemingly impregnable formation, an unsettling silence lingered across the battlefield.
No one knew what those strange Aether Cannons were capable of. And that uncertainty alone made even the most battle-hardened soldiers tighten their grip on their shields.
Although the Small Aether Cannons had an effective range of five hundred meters, their maximum range reached one kilometer.
The enemy was well within range. So Luke gave a slight nod.
Instantly, the barrels of all one hundred Aether Cannons emitted a faint azure glow.
One after another, the engraved runes ignited, bathing the weapons in runic light.
Hummm...

A low, ominous hum spread across the battlefield as streams of Aether gathered at each muzzle, condensing into brilliant spheres of blue-white energy. The unstable orbs pulsed violently, causing the surrounding air to ripple and distort.
The shield knights standing at the front felt an overwhelming sense of dread from those cannons.
Every instinct screamed at them to run. Yet not one of them retreated.
Instead, they planted their feet firmly into the ground and tightened their grip on their shields, preparing to withstand whatever was coming.
Then Luke’s calm but commanding voice rang out.
"Fire."
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOOOM!!!
A hundred Aether Cannons discharged at once.
Thunderous explosions shook the battlefield as hundreds of streaks of blue-white light tore through the air like blazing comets, hurtling toward the enemy formations.
A split second later—
BOOOOM!!
The condensed spheres of Aether crashed into the shield wall, erupting into blinding explosions that swallowed the front line in dazzling flashes of light.
Every direct hit unleashed terrifying destructive force.

Five Iron Knights were violently thrown backward with each impact, while the knight standing at the very center of the blast was instantly blown apart, his armor and shield shattered into countless fragments before his body vanished within the explosion.
And the ground where they stood only a scorched crater remained.
The same scene happened everywhere, which was followed by hundreds of pained and dying screams.
The onlookers faces became pale seeing this and they remembered, why the Machine Empire was known as the real beast in warfare.
Alastair’s expression was no better. From the previous impact, only the Bronze Knights had managed to remain unharmed, and that was solely because of their Aether.
Without it, even they would have suffered injuries from the force of the collision.
’Thousands of casualties, while the enemy has suffered none.’

As he counted the losses, Alastair’s mood sank even further. He turned his gaze toward Sorin, who stood there watching everything calmly, as if the deaths of thousands had not affected him in the slightest.
Sorin felt Alastair’s gaze and turned toward him, there he was gritting his teeth, but was not saying anything.
Witnessing the devastation, Sorin remained surprisingly composed and said "I will tak—" But before he could finish his sentence...
Fwoosh! Fwoosh! Fwoosh!
A second volley descended from the heavens.
But it contained hundreds of arrows which rained toward the battlefield, blotting out the sky.
’This is bad!’ Sorin’s expression changed instantly.
He hadn’t expected Luke to coordinate his archers with the cannon barrage.
So without hesitation, he roared, "Silver Knights, bring those arrows down! Bronze Knights, intercept the rest!"
"Yes, Commander!"
A ripple of panic spread through the Ashenford army.
Their formations had only just been shattered by the Aether Cannons, and before they could recover, another deadly attack was already upon them.
Fortunately, Sorin’s decisive command restored order.

The Silver Knights leaped into action, unleashing waves of sword energy and spear strikes to destroy the incoming arrows, while the Bronze Knights surged upward to intercept those that slipped through.
Within moments, discipline returned to the battlefield as every soldier resumed their position with practiced military precision.
Meanwhile...
Titan Luke watched everything unfold with a calm smile.
He quietly listened to the countdown coming from inside the mechanical fortresses.
"...Three."
The volley of arrows had never been intended to inflict serious damage. It was merely a smokescreen.
A distraction to keep the enemy occupied.
Because Luke’s true attack had always been the Aether Cannons... And they required only five seconds to recharge.
"...Zero."
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOOOM!!!
The battlefield shook as the Aether Cannons unleashed a second devastating volley.
This time, however, no one in the Ashenford army smiled. Instead their faces were drained of all color.
’Again...!’
In their haste to intercept the rain of arrows, the Silver and Bronze Knights had focused entirely on the sky.
None of them noticed the cannon barrels glowing once more.
By the time they realized what was happening... It was already too late.
Luke had deliberately ordered the cannons to target the sections of the battlefield left undefended by the high-ranking knights.
BOOOOOOM!!
Resulting explosions tore through the Ashenford ranks one after another.
"Aaaagh!! Save me!"
"I... I don’t want to die!!"
Desperate cries echoed across the battlefield as soldiers were engulfed by the blasts.

Thousands of Body Temper Realm soldiers and Iron Knights were caught in the bombardment. Some were even hurled through the air, others were buried beneath the shockwaves, while those at the center of the explosions vanished in an instant.
Order collapsed.
The already shaken formations fell into even greater disarray, and fear spread like wildfire through the Ashenford army.
With every explosion, their morale crumbled further.
In stark contrast, the Blackstone forces erupted into deafening cheers.
"Long live the Lord!"
"Victory to Blackstone!"

Their voices thundered across the battlefield as hope surged through every soldier’s heart. Watching the once-overwhelming Ashenford army falter under the relentless cannon fire, their confidence soared, and their fighting spirit blazed brighter than ever before.
Nyra and Sophia also felt relief after seeing Luke was doing fine.
Many people can say, this is cruel. But Luke didn’t care, for him only one thing mattered, ’Never touch what’s mine.’
The system saw everything yet remained silent, because this was part of Luke’s growth and he didn’t want to interfere.
While Nyx, Myrkhal and Caelith, who were inside the real Luke, couldn’t see anything regarding clone Luke.
During this time, Luke was controlling the clone. Just then, he heard his mage’s voice.
"Master, we will reach the Viscount’s territory in half an hour."
Hearing this, Luke simply nodded without breaking his concentration.
’He is smart and possesses high-level technology.’
Sorin analyzed the situation carefully before raising his hand.
The moment he did, all the onlookers—and even those on Luke’s side—turned their attention toward him.
Behind Sorin, five hundred Arcane-grade magic cannons suddenly appeared.
They were a full tier above Refined-grade, and their overwhelming presence instantly changed the atmosphere of the battlefield.
"THIS!"
A few onlookers gasped, not because of the Arcane-grade magic cannons, but instead because of the numbers.
"Doesn’t the Viscount have only 1,000 Arcane-grade of these in his territory?"
"And now he has brought half of them here already. Seems like Viscount Aldric is really serious this time."
All of them discussed, how he took loans and even reduced the cost of knights training to purchase those cannons.
But when they compared them to Luke’s Warwalker fortresses they shook their heads.
"Those Small Aether Cannons seem to contain the punch of a Peak Iron Knight."
"But those magical cannons, even after being Arcane-grade, can only fire Peak Iron Knight-level attacks."
"Which is why Machine Empire tech was flourishing so much."
They discussed with regret, because many among them wanted Blackstone to lose.
But what can they do, cannons wear down fast, which was why one tier higher was needed for lower-tier attacks or used same level attacks at the risk of getting scraped the cannons.

’He is smart and possesses high-level technology.’
Sorin analyzed the situation carefully before raising his hand.
The moment he did, all the onlookers—and even those on Luke’s side—turned their attention toward him.
Behind Sorin, five hundred Arcane-grade magic cannons suddenly appeared.
They were a full tier above Refined-grade, and their overwhelming presence instantly changed the atmosphere of the battlefield.
"THIS!"
A few onlookers gasped, not because of the Arcane-grade magic cannons, but instead because of the numbers.
"Doesn’t the Viscount have only 1,000 Arcane-grade of these in his territory?"
"And now he has brought half of them here already.
Seems like Viscount Aldric is really serious this time."
All of them discussed, how he took loans and even reduced the cost of knights training to purchase those cannons.
But when they compared them to Luke’s Warwalker fortresses they shook their heads.
"Those Small Aether Cannons seem to contain the punch of a Peak Iron Knight."
"But those magical cannons, even after being Arcane-grade, can only fire Peak Iron Knight-level attacks."
"Which is why Machine Empire tech was flourishing so much."
They discussed with regret, because many among them wanted Blackstone to lose.
But what can they do, cannons wear down fast, which was why one tier higher was needed for lower-tier attacks or used same level attacks at the risk of getting scraped the cannons.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: The Fortress Reveals Its Final Weapon!
paragraphs: "Charge the cannon!"
"Guards shield up!"
Sorin gave one order after another to every guard present on the battlefield.
"Yes Commander!!!"
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!

Bronze knights, along with silver knights, planted one foot forward and raised their shields, while the second rank raised their shields overhead to form a protective sheel, so if arrows come again, they would be ready. Resulting in formation of a small steel defensive line, which even Silver knight couldn’t pierce.
In the warwalker fortress, Osric stepped closer to Luke. "My lord, those magic cannons could charge in 15s and each of them have peak Iron knight attack power without overcharging them."
After saying that, he paused and added. "But they can also use attack of Bronze knight, though this could damage the magic cannon immediately."
Luke’s interest piqued on this info, because he was not worried about Iron knight attacks, which his fortress was more than capable of resisting. But-
"Bronze knight..."
Thinking this, he ordered every fortress, "Aim the Ballista towers and Small Aether Cannons."

"Yes My Lord!" with that, soon forty ballista towers, four from each fortress and with the height of 8 meters tall with 2.5m long bolts mounted on them, aimed toward enemy magic cannons positions, along with 100 cannons following suit.
Seeing this, many Ashenford soldiers instantly backed away with fear, while many guards near the magic cannons even had their hands shaking on the shields.
The surrounding Bronze and Silver knights shook their heads on their behavior.
While Sorin narrowed his eyes, because Luke just now had locked his army’s 40 magic cannon positions, so he immediately ordered everyone to increase the guards toward those locations.
"Hey that ballista tower is looking so huge." One onlooker said to his partner, who nodded while saying.
"Its attack power would be definitely higher than peak Iron knight."
The surrounding groups nodded, but Blackstone haters’ faces became ugly and thought confusedly, ’Is this really a mechanical creation? because lower tier creations are not so much loaded.’
"My lord, our cannons and ballista towers couldn’t breach their bronze and silver knights’ formation." One operator said to Luke.
Luke didn’t reply, instead he observed Ashenford armies. And found that in many places Body temper and Iron knight soldiers were left without protection.

’I have to reduce their numbers, so if the frontal combat occurs then our army should not have disadvantage.’ thinking this Luke quickly made the strategy and ordered the operator to start channeling *AETHER DEVASTATION BEAM CANNON*
Upon hearing this, the operator’s eyes became wide, because this weapon would consume 50% of Fortress energy immediately and the channeling time was also as large as *30S*.
"My Lord... if we fire all three of them, then the fortress’s remaining energy will fall below thirty percent."
The operator’s concerned voice came beside him.
But Luke didn’t hesitate. He just gave a single nod.
"Do it."
"Understood!"
The very next moment...
The Central Aether Core within each fortress began to pulse.
Thump...
Thump...
Thump...
With every heartbeat-like pulse, the brilliance of the core intensified, flooding the interior of the fortress with an azure radiance.
Then—
VRRRRRRMMMMMMMM...
A deep mechanical hum rolled across the battlefield. It wasn’t loud at first.
Yet it carried an indescribable pressure, as though an ancient beast had begun drawing its first breath after centuries of slumber.
Every head instinctively turned toward the ten towering mechanical fortresses.
Even the soldiers preparing magic cannons gradually slowed and looked toward the fortress.
There, all the ten fortresses were trembling from the sheer mass of energy.
Each pulse of the core sent a visible vibration through their colossal steel bodies.
Thump...
VRMMMM...
Thump...
Thick Aether conduits embedded throughout the fortress suddenly illuminated.
Brilliant streams of blue-white energy surged through them like rivers of liquid light, racing upward from the central core toward the roof.
Every conduit became brighter than the last. And every pulse carried more power to achieve its mission.
Soon, the entire fortress resembled the circulatory system of a giant mechanical titan, with pure Aether flowing through every vein.
’What the hell is he doing!’ Sorin’s expression turned to worry and the same was happening with every Ashenford soldier.
Then...
Something atop the fortress began to move.
CLANK!!
CLANK!!
KRRRRRKKK...
Massive enchanted locks disengaged one after another.
The armored roof slowly unfolded, revealing a weapon that had remained hidden until now.
A massive cannon slowly rose from the center.
It was unlike the smaller Aether Cannons mounted along the walls.
This weapon dwarfed them completely.
Nearly six meters long, the enormous cylindrical barrel dominated the entire rooftop, its body almost three meters wide and over two and a half meters tall.
The muzzle alone measured 1.2 meters across—large enough for a fully armored knight to stand inside.
Thick focusing rings encircled the barrel at regular intervals, each one forged from reinforced enchanted steel and engraved with intricate Aether channels.
Thousands... of glowing blue runes covered its surface from base to muzzle.
And now they awakened one after another with each pulse of energy.
Tick...
Tick...
Tick...
Within moments, the entire cannon blazed with dazzling blue light.
Soon, fine arcs of blue lightning suddenly burst across the cannon’s surface.
Crackle!
Crack!
Zzzzt!!
They danced wildly between the focusing rings before disappearing into the glowing runes.
Every second...
The pressure doubled.
The surrounding aether became so dense that even ordinary knights found it difficult to breathe.
Their instincts screamed.
Something catastrophic was about to be unleashed.
Silence engulfed the battlefield.
No one moved. No one dared to speak.
Thousands of eyes remained fixed upon the rooftop of those mechanical fortresses.
Faces gradually turned pale.
"T-That’s... another cannon?"
"No... that’s impossible..."
"How can something that strong exist on this rank??"
Even seasoned Bronze Knights subconsciously stepped backward.
While silver Knights narrowed their eyes warily.
Their instincts warned them...
If that weapon fired... It would not merely kill. It would erase everything in its path.
But Luke silently watched the charging sequence, the azure flames within his eyes reflecting the enormous weapon as its power continued to climb.
Above every fortress, the colossal cannon remained locked on its target, humming louder with each passing heartbeat...
"Increase the shield! Use your aether! Protect the magic cannons at all costs!" Sorin gave another order, while looking warily toward the large cannon.
Because he could feel, its attack power had definitely reached half-silver stage. So his silver knights could also become injured.
WARNING: CORE OVERLOAD!
WARNING: CORE OVERLOAD!
WARNING: CORE OVERLOAD!...

"My lord, the core is overloading! We have to fire fast." Luke heard the operator’s panicked voice through the communication array of the fortress, so he ordered to first fire the small aether cannons and ballista towers.
"Understood Sir!!!"
Everyone said in unison, and the next moment the whole battlefield again became blind as those cannons fired.
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOOOM!!!
"HOLD THE LINE!!!"
The Ashenford armies shouted and increased their grip on their shields. Soon, explosions occurred, but each magic cannon position was fine and only a few casualties could be seen.
"We survived!!!"
The soldiers, after surviving the blast, laughed and cheered happily, while onlookers looked toward the dust cloud and became confused.
"That it???"
"Shouldn’t that explosion be higher and more catastrophic??"

As they misunderstood the attacks and were now discussing their power, they heard a large mechanical gear turning sound, which brought another dread to them, and every face turned back again toward the fortress.
There, those large cannons were aiming far into the distance, where large clusters of Body Temper and Iron knight soldiers were present, but no high-level knights were present.
’This is bad!’
Everyone felt they had been fooled, and the same was true for Sorin as well, because after the cannons’ attacks, those fortresses raised their front part high, which hid those big cannons.
So without another thought, he roared at the top of his lungs.
"Silver Knights! Bronze Knights!"
His voice thundered across the battlefield.
"Hurry! Save them!"
The elite knights exploded into motion.
Silver Knights shot through the sky like streaks of silver light, while Bronze Knights leaped forward with everything they had, desperately rushing toward the sections targeted by the cannons.
Below them, thousands of soldiers abandoned their formations and tried to flee.
Panic spread like wildfire.
"Run!"
"Get out of the way!"
"Move! Move!"
Men shoved one another aside in their desperate attempt to escape the line of fire.
But...
It was already too late.
Titan Luke’s azure eyes remained utterly emotionless as he looked upon the battlefield.
Then, his cold voice echoed like the judgment of a god.
"Fire."
BOOOOOOOM!!!
BOOOOOOOM!!!
BOOOOOOOM!!!
...BOOOOOOOM!!!
The Massive Aether Devastation Beam Cannons unleashed their fury.
Blinding pillars of blue-white light erupted from the six-meter barrels, so brilliant that every soldiers instinctively shut their eyes.
The beams crossed the battlefield in an instant.
There was no projectile.
No travel time.
One moment the cannons fired...
The next, the battlefield was engulfed in catastropic destruction.
SHHHHHHHHHHHH—!!
The continuous beams carved through everything before them.
Included steel which melted like wax beneath a furnace.
Some Bronze knights come at the way and tried to stopped the beam but their bronze Knight-grade armor or aether didn’t crack. It simply ceased to exist next instant.
"What!!!"
The surrounding onlookers seeing this run away immediately, because they were afraid... afraid that beam would also come toward their direction.
The beam continued and every soldier caught within the five-meter-wide beams vanished before they could even scream, their bodies reduced to ashes by the unimaginable thermal energy.
The Silver Knights who rushed to intercept were struck by the outer edges of the beams and were violently blasted away, their armor glowing red-hot as they coughed blood midair.
Wherever the beams passed... The ground itself was melted.
Massive trenches stretched across the battlefield, their interiors glowing crimson as molten stone bubbled beneath the surface.
The air filled with ash. While on some places firestorms erupted.
Dust and smoke billowed hundreds of meters into the sky.
For two full seconds...
The battlefield belonged to nothing except the deafening roar of the Aether Devastation Beams.
Then...
The light disappeared.
Silence followed.
An eerie, suffocating silence.
Where thriving battle formations had stood only moments earlier...
There remained nothing except smoldering trenches, rivers of molten rock, and countless patches of scorched earth.
The surviving soldiers stared blankly at the devastation before them.
Their weapons slipped from nerveless fingers.
Their minds refused to accept what they had just witnessed.
It was no longer a weapon of war.
It was Devastation itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 500 Cannons... Zero Damage
paragraphs: Luke saw all the destruction with a normal face, while Aurielle became slightly worried about Luke. ’This much bloodshed is not good for him.’
But she didn’t disturb him, as he was commanding the army now.
In the distance, Sorin’s face became ugly, and the composed mask he was wearing got cracked fully.
"Damn it!" he cursed Luke, because there he was standing calmly after nearly killing tens of thousands of his men.
"Tell the status." Luke asked the operator, who nodded and presented the data of the magical array.
"My lord, the main cannon is on cooldown for 2 minutes, while only 25% fortress energy is left."
Luke nodded and ordered them to use the reserve Aether Water which they had collected from the Mana Well.
Yeah, this huge fortress consumed Aether Crystals for each attack, but Luke doesn’t have them.
So he filled the fortress with Aether Water, which he had plenty of in his Time Chamber.
Surprisingly, it works pretty well. ’Maybe the reason its Refined tier, which is equal to the Iron Knight stage or F-rank.’
"My lord, the energy reserves of all fortresses have been filled."
"And awaiting your next command."
Hearing this, Luke smiled, because he could guess what Sorin would do. So he gave his next command.
"Retract the main cannon and activate the Aether Shield."
"Understood, My Lord."
The Aether Core, which had got slightly cooled down, started spinning again, but this time its spinning speed was slower than before.
Luke also ordered them to bring all the fortresses together.
So ten Warwalker Fortresses moved close to each other and, with a loud BAM sound, got stuck together.
The onlookers saw what Luke had done, which amazed them again.
Because now those ten fortress walls were combined and looking like a 100-meter-long steel wall with a height of 10 meters, while their steel spider legs stood supporting them.
After this, they turned toward Sorin and understood, ’Luke wants to shield his army from the magic cannons.’
"Just hope Sorin uses high-output mode and blasts them with Bronze-level attacks, or else that fortress will not have any impact."

So everyone discussed with heated arguments about Luke’s idea, whether it was going to work or not, while Nyra became worried about Sir Luke but couldn’t do anything. And the same was with Sophia as well.

"Cannons are ready?" with slightly angered voice Sorin asked, on which each operator nodded. Fortunately, not a single cannon got damaged in the previous attacks. So now they had a full 500 attacks to fire.
Then, with fury in his eyes, he roared. "FIRE!!!"
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!!... BOOOOM!!!
Hundreds of cannon firing sounds filled the whole battlefield, and due to this, many among the onlookers even covered their ears.
"NOW!"

Seeing this, Luke also shouted, and instantly all fortresses deployed their spherical Aether Shields simultaneously, which were 0.5 meters thick and consisted of many Aether layers for additional protection.
While the remaining Blackstone soldiers immediately moved backward and took full cover behind the Warwalker Fortresses, and some even got below them.
Because the whole shield was 14 meters in diameter, which was enough for everyone.
BOOM!
The first magic cannon attack made contact with the Aether Shield, but the result was nothing, only a slight ripple.
BOOM!
BOOM!
After that, it was followed by more and more attacks.
"My lord, the attacks have reached Early Bronze Knight, while some are Mid-Bronze Knight." The operator told the status to Luke, who didn’t reply, just kept observing the incoming bombardment.
WARNING: SHIELD DAMAGED!
After a few hundred attacks, the alarm rang inside each fortress, as small cracks appeared on the shield.
Seeing this, a smile appeared on Sorin’s face, and the Ashenford soldiers also became happy. So with increased morale, they kept increasing the firing rate.

"My lord, 20% fortress energy has been lost!" The operator’s slightly panicked voice came, on which Luke ordered them to bring all the reserve Aether Water and also increased the power of the Aether Core.
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!!... BOOOOM!!!
The bombardment didn’t stop for a few minutes, and the shield continuously regenerated with the help of Aether Water.
Even though nothing happened to the fortress and those behind it, the area in front had been scorched by the continuous attacks, while dust and smoke spread along the fortress wall.
Finally, the bombardment stopped, and everyone, including the Ashenford army, looked toward the Blackstone Legion.
Waiting for the dust to clear, so they could know the result of their attack power.
But when the dust cleared, everyone’s eyes became wide. "HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE!!!" And the smiles the Ashenford soldiers had also vanished instantly.
Sorin’s face was also no better; he was even gritting his teeth in anger.
Because in the distance, not a scratch could be seen on the fortress wall, and hell, even the Aether Shield didn’t get destroyed.
After all, he had overcharged the Arcane-grade cannons to fire Bronze-level attacks, but now the enemy was fine, and almost all cannons got heavily damaged.
Luke nodded in satisfaction. ’System gifts are always top tier.’ With that, he gave a small smile toward Sorin, who was still gritting his teeth.
However, the next moment, Sorin pupils dilated and a bad premonition rose in his heart when he saw the smile on Luke’s face.
The next instant, behind Luke, suddenly 9 more Giant Lukes along with armor appeared, on which the smile on Luke’s face widened, and Sorin’s heart also beat faster.
Then it happened, those...nine Titan Lukes suddenly vanished, and the next second he heard pained screams from 9 different locations.
"Ahhh!" "Ughh!" ... "No!!"

Nine Titan Lukes teleported and appeared behind the Silver Knights before beheading them instantly, because each used their third ability, Physical Severance, to break through their armor, followed by each of them packing the Arcane-grade magic cannons inside their Spatial Rings before teleporting again.
’What!!!’
Along with Sorin, Alastair, and the onlookers present, everyone felt their minds go blank.
Because they did hear about Luke using teleportation when he fought earlier in the tournament arranged by the Count.
But everyone forgot about that, thinking it was just a rumor. ’Seems like it wasn’t!’

Alastair was holding back already and didn’t want to start a Golden Knight battle yet, but seeing more and more Silver Knights dying along with the cannons disappearing, he lost his patience and with one shout charged toward Clone Luke.
"How dare you!"
Everyone heard Alastair’s angry voice, but the next moment, instead of seeing a bloodbath, they saw Alastair completely got rooted in his place, and his expression also turned to fear.
’What happened??’ this question echoed in everyone’s mind.

"Just hope Sorin uses high-output mode and blasts them with Bronze-level attacks, or else that fortress will not have any impact."
So everyone discussed with heated arguments about Luke’s idea, whether it was going to work or not, while Nyra became worried about Sir Luke but couldn’t do anything.
And the same was with Sophia as well.
"Cannons are ready?" with slightly angered voice Sorin asked, on which each operator nodded.
Fortunately, not a single cannon got damaged in the previous attacks.
So now they had a full 500 attacks to fire.
Then, with fury in his eyes, he roared.
"FIRE!!!"
BOOM!!
BOOM!!
BOOM!!
BOOM!!...
BOOOOM!!!
Hundreds of cannon firing sounds filled the whole battlefield, and due to this, many among the onlookers even covered their ears.
"NOW!"

Seeing this, Luke also shouted, and instantly all fortresses deployed their spherical Aether Shields simultaneously, which were 0.5 meters thick and consisted of many Aether layers for additional protection.
While the remaining Blackstone soldiers immediately moved backward and took full cover behind the Warwalker Fortresses, and some even got below them.
Because the whole shield was 14 meters in diameter, which was enough for everyone.
BOOM!
The first magic cannon attack made contact with the Aether Shield, but the result was nothing, only a slight ripple.
BOOM!
BOOM!
After that, it was followed by more and more attacks.
"My lord, the attacks have reached Early Bronze Knight, while some are Mid-Bronze Knight." The operator told the status to Luke, who didn’t reply, just kept observing the incoming bombardment.
WARNING: SHIELD DAMAGED!
After a few hundred attacks, the alarm rang inside each fortress, as small cracks appeared on the shield.
Seeing this, a smile appeared on Sorin’s face, and the Ashenford soldiers also became happy.
So with increased morale, they kept increasing the firing rate.

"My lord, 20% fortress energy has been lost!" The operator’s slightly panicked voice came, on which Luke ordered them to bring all the reserve Aether Water and also increased the power of the Aether Core.
BOOM!!
BOOM!!
BOOM!!
BOOM!!...
BOOOOM!!!
The bombardment didn’t stop for a few minutes, and the shield continuously regenerated with the help of Aether Water.
Even though nothing happened to the fortress and those behind it, the area in front had been scorched by the continuous attacks, while dust and smoke spread along the fortress wall.
Finally, the bombardment stopped, and everyone, including the Ashenford army, looked toward the Blackstone Legion.
Waiting for the dust to clear, so they could know the result of their attack power.
But when the dust cleared, everyone’s eyes became wide.
"HOW IS THIS POSSIBLE!!!" And the smiles the Ashenford soldiers had also vanished instantly.
Sorin’s face was also no better; he was even gritting his teeth in anger.
Because in the distance, not a scratch could be seen on the fortress wall, and hell, even the Aether Shield didn’t get destroyed.
After all, he had overcharged the Arcane-grade cannons to fire Bronze-level attacks, but now the enemy was fine, and almost all cannons got heavily damaged.
Luke nodded in satisfaction. ’System gifts are always top tier.’ With that, he gave a small smile toward Sorin, who was still gritting his teeth.
However, the next moment, Sorin pupils dilated and a bad premonition rose in his heart when he saw the smile on Luke’s face.
The next instant, behind Luke, suddenly 9 more Giant Lukes along with armor appeared, on which the smile on Luke’s face widened, and Sorin’s heart also beat faster.
Then it happened, those...nine Titan Lukes suddenly vanished, and the next second he heard pained screams from 9 different locations.
"Ahhh!" "Ughh!" ...

Nine Titan Lukes teleported and appeared behind the Silver Knights before beheading them instantly, because each used their third ability, Physical Severance, to break through their armor, followed by each of them packing the Arcane-grade magic cannons inside their Spatial Rings before teleporting again.
’What!!!’
Along with Sorin, Alastair, and the onlookers present, everyone felt their minds go blank.
Because they did hear about Luke using teleportation when he fought earlier in the tournament arranged by the Count.
But everyone forgot about that, thinking it was just a rumor. ’Seems like it wasn’t!’

Alastair was holding back already and didn’t want to start a Golden Knight battle yet, but seeing more and more Silver Knights dying along with the cannons disappearing, he lost his patience and with one shout charged toward Clone Luke.
"How dare you!"
Everyone heard Alastair’s angry voice, but the next moment, instead of seeing a bloodbath, they saw Alastair completely got rooted in his place, and his expression also turned to fear.
’What happened??’ this question echoed in everyone’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: The Hunt for the Viscount Begins
paragraphs: Earlier...
Vaelira’s whole focus was on Sorin all the time, but when she saw Alastair, another Golden Knight, moved, she changed her aim and instantly used her Origin Ultimate Skill.
"Celestial Descent: Final Hunt." With that, she released the arrow, which disappeared the next moment.

At that moment, Alastair took one step and got frozen. ’I am locked by someone!’ His pupils became wide with wariness and also a little fear, because he could feel that whoever had locked onto him also had the strength to wound him.
So he looked around and tried to find who, but to no avail.

While Alastair couldn’t find the attacker, Sorin did, as he looked straight toward Luke’s side, and there a blue-masked woman, whose cultivation seemed to be at the Peak Silver Knight stage, had her whole body glowing with a huge amount of Aether, while her bow was pointing toward the sky.
’High-ranking Origin Skill!’ Those words instantly came into his mind, and his eyes became completely wide.

’How!’ And this question rang in his mind. ’Are we being targeted?? Was all of this nothing but a conspiracy??’ Sorin immediately felt someone was interfering and providing big help to Luke. Or else where did he get an Early Golden Knight and now a high-ranking Origin Skill user.

"I have to finish this soon." He said with emergency and next moment charged toward Luke’s fortress, because the 9 Lukes had disappeared the moment Alastair moved, though they still got 100 magic cannons with them.

"Bastard!" Thinking about the magic cannons, Sorin’s face became even more angry, and another curse escaped his mouth. With that, he gave a hateful look toward Luke, but the next instant a glowing sword suddenly appeared in front of him. ’Dam-!’
BOOOM!

Aurora saw both Golden Knights had moved, so she instantly threw her sword at the incoming Sorin, who got blasted backward by the attack, and along the way, many Body Temper and Iron Knights also got killed.
BAMMM!
Sorin’s body crashed heavily into the ground, which destroyed the surrounding ground and boulders.
Aurora didn’t stop after attacking. Instead, she immediately charged toward him with full power, which nearly tilted the whole Warwalker Fortress backward.

Luke sighed at her action and felt his main body calling, "Seems like time is up." With that, he looked toward Aurielle, who had summoned her Regalia Queen Armor along with her purple sword, and said,

"Aurielle, take care of yourself and everyone." On which she nodded, and along with Vaelira, 100 Peak Silver Marinthians charged straight toward the location where Vaelira’s Final Hunt arrow had thrown the Alastair.
Seeing this, he thought with a little worried expression, ’I will try to come back fast.’ With that, he gave one last order to all the fortresses.
"Activate the Stationary Mode and prepare for defense!" His voice reached every Blackstone Legion soldier and knight, on which each of them shouted,
"YES MY LORD!"
But the faces of the spies and other traitors turned pale. Still, they didn’t dare to go against the command.

Soon, all ten fortresses separated from their joined formation and made some distance before each of them lowered their body, following that their spider mechanical legs pierced the ground to anchor the fortresses.
The next moment, every fortress expanded, and the previous 10-meter width extended to 20 meters, while all fortress walls became more steel-layered to bear the upcoming onslaught.
With that, he removed his Titan form and entered the center compartment, so no one could confirm if he was present or not.
The nobles, merchants, and adventurers’ faces changed from awe to horror, then again to awe.
Because everything happened so fast that they didn’t know what to say.
First, Alastair, a Golden Knight, moved to stop a Bronze Knight, which would bring shame to every Golden Knight if they found out.
Then he got frozen, and Sorin’s outburst came, which resulted in him getting thrown back like a dog.
Which baffled them, and a thought came into their minds. ’It must have hurt badly.’ Because the sword literally collided with his face.
Even that was not enough, when suddenly 100 Peak Silver Knight auras flared from Baron Luke’s side. Even though they belonged to Marinthians, it was still freaking crazy!!!
"It seems my father is a fake Baron, because he doesn’t have a single Peak Silver Knight, while Baron Luke, a new lord, has hundreds," one young nobleman said with a little downcast expression.
And the same was happening with many people.

"Interesting." Though everyone was not upset about this situation, because after seeing the big game-changing move, many merchants felt, ’Seems like we can continue to use the roads freely as we were doing before.’
While some adventurers became interested in the Blackstone Legion army and were thinking of becoming part of them.
"Master, we have arrived at Windmarch Reach’s main city." Luke heard Elena’s voice and desummoned his clones.
Following that, he stood up from the chair and moved toward the large glass in front.
Down there, he could see the bustling scene of people walking across the roads, while carriages and carts transported goods or passengers.
Elena turned toward her master and followed his gaze. After a moment, she prayed, ’I can only hope Master will not bring his wrath to these innocent people.’
After that, Elena said the words which she had been holding back from the start. "Master, is it really necessary for you to take this risk??"
Her voice, filled with concern, reached Luke’s ears, on which he paused and turned toward Elena.
There he noticed that the other mages were also looking toward him with worry on their faces.
On this, a small smile appeared on his face, and he replied calmly.
"Why??"
"Are you worried about me??
Upon hearing this, each of them became confused as to why their master was asking this. Because it was simple,
"Yes! because you are our master!!!"
All of them said at the same time, and Luke nodded at this, then added. "yet you still don’t have a even little bit of faith in your master."
Hearing this, their faces became pale, and all of them shook their heads in denial.
"Hahaha." Seeing this, Luke laughed, because he was just teasing them.
Then he reassured them, "Don’t worry about the Viscount, as I am way stronger than him." With that, he stepped forward and took the center seat, which was reserved for the commander.
At those words, their minds finally relaxed. Afterward, they also focused on the magic array in front of them.
While Luke shifted his focus toward the system panel. Because the Arcane Sky Tower, which they were riding now,
Was an S-rank, which is Royal/Sacred tier, one tier above Relic. Means, ’kingdom-level treasure,’ and that’s why he didn’t want to bring this out earlier.
But for fast travel with stealth features, this was best.
[ARCANE SKY TOWER — S-RANK]
[CORE FEATURES UNLOCKED]
1. Advanced Camouflage
2. Aerial Reconnaissance
3. Mobile Command Center
4. Autonomous Flight
5. Spell Storage Vault (Primary Feature) {NEW}
Yeah, the Arcane Sky Tower has many features locked, and currently only 5 floors out of 50 floors have been unlocked.

"System, you really can’t give me anything fully unlocked." Luke cursed the system, because the Regalia Queen Armor the system gave Aurielle was fully unlocked. But only when it came to him, the system did things like this.
[Cough! Cough! Luke, you can’t slander me like this!] The system paused after saying this and observed Luke’s face, which didn’t change at all and was still same, ’I don’t believe you.’
