chapters.title: Chapter 127: The Battle Against a Mid-Golden Knight
paragraphs: Seeing this, the system’s slightly wronged voice came. [This is an S-rank treasure, below Saint tier. Just think about, how much Aether it would consume, how much spirituality is needed for controlling this.]
[If I have not locked this, then do you think that your mages, who are Apprentice and Circle Mages, can be able to even control this??]
After hearing this, Luke also felt the system does have a point. Still, it’s annoying him that his rewards were locked, so he asked. "Then how could I unlock further features."
Upon hearing this, the System’s happy voice returned and it replied. [Simple! give the artifact Aether as much as you can.]
[The new feature is also unlocked after it absorbs Aether from the Time Chamber.]
Luke nodded. ’That’s why previously Spell Storage was not there.’ So he ignored the System’s further words, because he had activated his Sage Mode and it was saying.
[Luke, there is also another method, make some high-ranking real queen fall in love with you and she will give you tons of Aether Crystals, so with the help of that, you can unlock your tower.]
His eyes twitched at this and he shook his head, while recalling the functions of Spell Storage, which were totally broken.
5. Spell Storage Vault (Primary Feature)
| Attribute | Details |
| Type | Spell Storage and Instant Release |
| Capacity | 100 Spells |
| Storage Method | Mages or the user can store pre-cast spells into the vault |
| Release Method | Instantaneous — no charging required |
| Storage Time | Spells remain stored until used |
| Refill Requirement | Must be refilled manually after use |
| Location | Floor 5th |
"Yeah, totally broken." Because the Spell Storage can store the spells of even the King realm, which was just below Saint tier, the highest realm in Valtharion known.
But sadly, he couldn’t find any King realm, so he used his Thunderfall technique to fill all 100 spots with them.
And now each of them contained Early Golden Knight attacks. So just thinking about 100 Golden Knight attacks coming continuously made Luke feel great.
While the other features were the same as their names sounded, which was not worth discussing.
"Prepare the bombardment!" After that Luke said to Elena, who nodded and clicked on the magical array.
Down below on roads, everything was normal until they heard the sound of lightning, on which they craned their necks high, and a primal fear appeared in each eye.
A fear which only nature could bring. "Thunder!!!"
Seeing the sky suddenly become bright from thunder, which threatens to come down next moment, created panic among the masses.
"It’s God’s wrath!!!
Many people said the same thing, while some said different things, but each voice contained only urgency.
The thunder, which was brewing in the sky for a few seconds, finally came down with a CRACK sound.
CRAAACK!!!
The sound echoed everywhere, bringing another wave of dread, but many people felt relieved after seeing the thunder was not heading toward them.
But the same was not true for the Main Gate.
BOOOOOOM!!!
The Main Gate was blasted apart by a thick lightning bolt, and all the soldiers and knights present were instantly vaporized.
"Ughhh!!"
Many pained cries also came from people near the gate, who were now scattered among the ground with their bloodied bodies.
"Save me, please!"
One person who got burned by the aftermath, cried with pleading voice toward the running crowds, but none listen.
Seeing this, he broke down, and tears started flooding from his eyes. and the same was happening with many people.
On this day, Windmarch Reach felt Heaven’s wrath for the first time, and this would be known to everyone in the future.
The running people felt relieved after seeing they got spared. But this relief didn’t last long.
"No... no... there’s another one!!!"
One person with a broken voice said while pointing toward the sky, which was shining again.
Hearing this, the surrounding people also looked and felt their souls leave their bodies.
So with dread filled eyes, they started praying to the gods for their forgiveness, untill a loud angry sound came from the center Lord Estate.
"You! Dare!"
On this, everyone present turned their faces, and hope filled their eyes, after seeing their lord had come.
"Lord, Please Save us!!!"
Each of them cried heavily toward Viscount Aldaric, but he didn’t listen.
His whole focus was toward the bright sky. There was the sun but no dark clouds. ’Then from where did this come?’
Because lightning of this level is equal to a small force of nature, which needed nature’s help or else it was difficult to perform.
But sadly, no answer came, only the intensity of blue light in the sky increased, followed by two Thunderfalls which again aimed toward the Main Gate.
Their aim... was to shatter the gate of the Viscount territory to pieces.
"Hmphh!!" Seeing this, Aldaric got annoyed, and with one push of his legs, which destroyed the building roof he was on, he launched straight toward the gate.
"COME!" He shouted, on which Luke’s reply also came.
KRRRRAAAAASH!
KRRRRAAAAASH!
Two Thunderfalls instantly came down.

Upon this, Aldaric didn’t panic, as he could feel. ’Early Golden attacks.’ That’s what those Thunderfalls contained, so he leaped toward them with quick speed and deflected one lightning bolt toward the far location, which made another boom sound, but this time the Main Gate didn’t get damaged.
In the air, Aldaric used his Aether to turn toward the second lightning bolt, which was already too close to him.
So he took the attack head-on.
BOOOOOOM!!!
Another explosion sound came, which worried all the people present about their lord, and soon they got their answer.
When Aldaric’s unscathed body was shown still standing in the air on his Aether, before he came down.
"Lord is fine!!"
"We will be saved!"
Seeing this everyone cheered with hope filled voice, and the initial fear from the Heaven’s wrath also got reduced in an instant.

Hearing everyone’s praises, a big satisfied smile appeared on Aldaric’s face. With that, he looked toward above, from where the attacks were coming, and shouted with an arrogant voice. "Rats, I am still here, so stop with your measly testing."
Aldaric knew, when his army left, many of his enemies would directly or indirectly attack his territory, which was why he didn’t leave.
’Now it seems I made the right decision.’ So with a mocking smile, he kept looking above.
Luke from the above saw all these and even heard with the help of tower, so said coldly "Smile while you can, Aldaric, because soon you will die." and ordered mages to increase the attacking speed.
"Understood, my lord!" All mages nodded and made some changes in the magical arrays.
CRACKLE!!!
Next moment four lightning bolts tore through the sky, and their aim was still the same, "Main Gate"
Seeing this Aldaric didn’t leap this time. Instead, he brought out his hammer and made the swing motion.
The next instant, his Aether flared, coating his whole weapon with grayish Aether, but it didn’t stop there and extended.
Extended to 10 feet before stopping.
Soon he was holding a 10-foot-long grayish pillar made entirely of his Aether.
"Golden Knight!"
Seeing Viscount Aldaric’s aura, which was extended to 10 feet long, many adventurers became jealous.
Because only after reaching Golden Knight could one extend their Aether fully outside and make it solid.
On which 10-foot-long Aether is a sign of the Early Golden Knight stage.

Aldaric didn’t react to the jealous gazes. Instead, he calculated the timing of the thunder impact and swung his 10-foot-long hammer toward it, which the next instant flared and became a 20-foot-long Aether pillar.
"Mid-Golden Knight!!!"

Their aim... was to shatter the gate of the Viscount territory to pieces.
"Hmphh!!" Seeing this, Aldaric got annoyed, and with one push of his legs, which destroyed the building roof he was on, he launched straight toward the gate.
"COME!" He shouted, on which Luke’s reply also came.
KRRRRAAAAASH!
KRRRRAAAAASH!
Two Thunderfalls instantly came down.

Upon this, Aldaric didn’t panic, as he could feel. ’Early Golden attacks.’ That’s what those Thunderfalls contained, so he leaped toward them with quick speed and deflected one lightning bolt toward the far location, which made another boom sound, but this time the Main Gate didn’t get damaged.
In the air, Aldaric used his Aether to turn toward the second lightning bolt, which was already too close to him.
So he took the attack head-on.
BOOOOOOM!!!
Another explosion sound came, which worried all the people present about their lord, and soon they got their answer.
When Aldaric’s unscathed body was shown still standing in the air on his Aether, before he came down.
"Lord is fine!!"
"We will be saved!"
Seeing this everyone cheered with hope filled voice, and the initial fear from the Heaven’s wrath also got reduced in an instant.
Hearing everyone’s praises, a big satisfied smile appeared on Aldaric’s face.
With that, he looked toward above, from where the attacks were coming, and shouted with an arrogant voice.
"Rats, I am still here, so stop with your measly testing."
Aldaric knew, when his army left, many of his enemies would directly or indirectly attack his territory, which was why he didn’t leave.
’Now it seems I made the right decision.’ So with a mocking smile, he kept looking above.
Luke from the above saw all these and even heard with the help of tower, so said coldly "Smile while you can, Aldaric, because soon you will die." and ordered mages to increase the attacking speed.
"Understood, my lord!" All mages nodded and made some changes in the magical arrays.
CRACKLE!!!
Next moment four lightning bolts tore through the sky, and their aim was still the same, "Main Gate"
Seeing this Aldaric didn’t leap this time.
Instead, he brought out his hammer and made the swing motion.
The next instant, his Aether flared, coating his whole weapon with grayish Aether, but it didn’t stop there and extended.
Extended to 10 feet before stopping.
Soon he was holding a 10-foot-long grayish pillar made entirely of his Aether.
"Golden Knight!"
Seeing Viscount Aldaric’s aura, which was extended to 10 feet long, many adventurers became jealous.
Because only after reaching Golden Knight could one extend their Aether fully outside and make it solid.
On which 10-foot-long Aether is a sign of the Early Golden Knight stage.
Aldaric didn’t react to the jealous gazes.
Instead, he calculated the timing of the thunder impact and swung his 10-foot-long hammer toward it, which the next instant flared and became a 20-foot-long Aether pillar.
"Mid-Golden Knight!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Viscount Strongest Technique Wasn’t Enough!
paragraphs: Seeing this, from merchant to Adventure everyone exclaimed with the surprised expression and immediately backed away, to avoid getting in his attacks.
BOOM!
Aldaric’s large aether hammer, which shared the property of the stone element, collided with four lightning bolts, on which the first two it easily survived, but the third brought some cracks on it.
While the fourth did the most damage, as it destroyed the 10-foot-long part.
Upon this, Aldaric’s eyes became wary, ’four attacks? earlier two?’ and he calculated this in his mind.

On which he found out, that what was attacking his territory... ’an artifact.’ But this confused him even more, and he craned his neck high toward the sky, but still didn’t see the sign of any airship or the aura of a person who was carrying the artifact.
Luke, from 10,000m high, could see clear confusion on Aldaric’s face.
On which he shook his head, because first, the Arcane Sky Tower was very high in the sky, and second, it came with a Stealth feature, which no one below Saint tier could see.
So Aldaric’s confusion was very valid, though he didn’t give him an answer but instead gave him the next wave of lightning, which finally brought out some of his aether and stamina.
Another crackling sound came, which was followed by 8 thunderfalls, that freaked out the surrounding people and each ran away from Aldaric.
"Seems like I have to use some strength." Seeing this, Aldaric muttered with a little wary expression.
Even though he could easily dodge them with his speed, then the surrounding buildings would be destroyed and people would also die.
So he took a deep breath then exhaled, with a serious expression.
The crowd who had escaped far, shifted their attention back to Aldaric.
Who was preparing his next move, on this the citizens prayed, while adventurers and merchants looked at him with curiosity. ’will he use that?’ And soon they got their answer.

Aldaric brought his right hand back toward his waist and made a striking action toward the sky. Results his torso also tilted slightly along with his legs condensed to hold the force of the upcoming move.

’C-rank Stone Bear Ascension Series: Second Technique’ He thought the name as a huge amount of grayish aether discharged from his core and soon a huge 10-foot-tall stone bear hand with closed paw structure formed above him.
"This!!!"
Upon this, everyone exclaimed with wide mouths and recalled Viscount Aldaric’s famous Ascension Series, which brought many victories to his arsenal.
So the moment it formed, Aldaric swung his right hand upward with full strength.
"Stone Bear Paw!"
As the shout echoed, it suddenly became 20 feet long, because he supplied even more aether to this.
Following that, the massive stone hand also released upward with full strength.
The result, the stone ground beneath Aldaric shattered with the rebound force alone, moreover almost every nearby building wall also got cracked.

Above, the stone bear paw collided with the first few lightning bolts, which it easily dispersed each of them, until the last lightning hit its body, resulting the attack being completely nullified, but some parts of the large hand still got destroyed.
Seeing this, Aldaric smiled and didn’t think much about the last hit, and the same was everyone, as they also cheered.

Soon another wave came, which consisted of 16 lightning bolts. On this, even Aldaric got a little worried and thought, ’Should I use a defensive move or not?’ Because defensive moves used more aether, but their results were also the best when it came to defense.
Though after a moment, he shook his head and still decided to use the same attack, but with more aether.
"Stone Bear Paw."
This time a 30m-long stone hand formed, though its hand was opened this time and its claws could be fully seen.
"GO!"
He shouted and threw it toward the upcoming lightning attacks. In the start everything was fine as it resisted 10 lightning bolts easily, on which a small smile formed on Aldaric face.
But the next moment, his expression changed, because the 11th lightning destroyed a small part of the stone bear paw and chunks of stone dropped to the ground.

’this!’ He became a little worried, but the next attack didn’t wait and it also collided with the bear paw, resulting in one sharp stone nail getting destroyed and the whole body also bore some small cracks from this.
With each hit, more and more damage could be seen and Aldaric’s face also became more and more worried.

Even though the crowd couldn’t see above what’s going on like Aldaric, but some people did notice his facial expression and understood. ’Things are not good.’ So all those who observed this, immediately made more distance from Aldaric; from the crowd as well.
When the 15th lightning struck, it took out all the paw nails, even one finger was also missing and more cracks could be clearly seen on the stone hand.
Though, Aldaric still hoped, that it would also resist the last attack, which was on the same level as earlier lightning attacks were.
But Luke thought differently and a smile appeared on his face. Seeing Luke smiling, Elena and the other mages also nodded, because the data, mage tower had given.
They could already see, that the stone hand was already cracked to the point of destruction, it was just its outer appearance was holding back by the technique.
And the next moment it happened, as the last 16th lightning struck. The stone hand shattered immediately and Aldaric’s face also changed.
Because the next moment, the lightning bolt after piercing through struck directly him.
BOOOM!
The thunder strike sound echoed, and the place where Aldaric was standing, instantly got destroyed and a small crater also formed in that place.
Panic again erupted among the crowd, as they backed away from the impact zone, though no damage or shockwave followed near them.

Because its power was already reduced and everyone were also already standing at the far distance. So when they found this, each of them calmed down and observed the small crater location, where Aldaric was present.
In the crater, Aldaric’s body didn’t get harmed at all, only a scratch could be seen on his face, but that’s it. So he was looking toward the sky, with a little tired and annoyed expression.
’Who are these rats?’ because while he was getting attacked and defending, he was constantly locating them.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Viscount Finally Unleashed His Origin Skill!
paragraphs: As no one had enough money to summon so many Golden Knights, or else they could come at him openly to kill.
But if it was an artifact, then it was even more absurd, because he never heard of a low-tier artifact which could throw Early Golden Knight attacks like water.

While he was thinking this, he remains in a lying position and his face was facing the sky, but the next moment a bad premonition rose in his heart and the sky again became bright , but with a freaking 32 lightning bolts and 37 lightning bolts.

In the start, the magic tower was getting ready, which was why Luke couldn’t throw down all attacks together. Plus this was the first time mages were using Spell Store, so they were also not much familiar with its mechanics, which resulted in this long to understand it partially.
"But now it’s done." Luke nodded at all mages, because now they could release attacks in the batch of 30+, which was still crazy.
"I hope you like my gift, Viscount Aldaric." Luke muttered with a playful smile and looked at the magical array screen, which was showing Aldaric’s pale face.
Aldaric, for the first time, felt that he couldn’t take all those attacks head-on with his Ascension Series.
Even if he used a defensive series, then he could max only block around 20, but 32 + 37.
"Hell no!"
The surrounding people also felt something was wrong, because the sky was shining so bright, which seemed like it was going to come down itself the next moment.
So when all of them heard Aldaric shout, they immediately understood something bad was about to happen.
Aldaric rose from the crater and shouted at the sky with an angry face, "If you think this would be enough to bring me down, then you are totally wrong."
With that, the next moment, everyone again heard Aldaric’s loud voice but this filled with confidence, which finally brought hope to them.
’C-rank Origin Skill’
"Volcano Bear Transformation!"
The next instant Aldaric’s body began to tremble. And cracks spread across his skin, which were fissures of molten orange light, as if lava was flowing just beneath his flesh.
His bones shifted. His muscles swelled. His spine elongated.
His height also changed, becoming double. Then triple. Five feet. Ten feet. Fifteen. Twenty. Twenty-five. And finally thirty feet tall.

His clothes tore apart as his body expanded beyond human proportions. His skin darkened, hardening into thick obsidian-like plates. Fur erupted across his body—dark brown and gray, streaked with veins of glowing orange.
"ROARRRR!"
The first roar tore from his throat, it came out as a mixture of human and bear. The sound shook the ground and echoed across the cities.
Which shoved every normal person to the ground with fear and even many soldiers and knights became afraid.
Luke also became surprised, even though he had heard about Viscount’s transformation Origin Skill from Aurielle’s mouth, but seeing it with his own eyes was a really different experience.
While Luke was praising the transformation, down below Aldaric’s body transformation stopped, but not the next part, as it name says Volcano Bear, so it happened.

A small volcano slowly rose from his back. When rock and magma pushed through his skin, forming a craggy peak. Smoke curled from its summit. Orange cracks spread across its surface like veins of molten fire. The volcano was alive—pulsing, breathing, connected to his heartbeat.
His eyes also shifted to a burning gold-red. Following that, his teeth lengthened into fangs the length of shortswords. His hands became massive paws with claws of volcanic stone.
Then everyone present saw a 30-foot-tall Bear, with the volcano on his back, which added another 10 feet to its height.
A living mountain. A walking volcano. A bear that had become the earth itself. And this thought came into their minds.
"Golden-rank Origin Skill is sure different." One adventurer muttered with an envious tone, while others nodded at his words.
Because a person who had an S-rank Origin Skill, but was a Bronze Knight, would not have much transformation, when it came to a Golden Knight who had a C-rank transformation.
As each stage, Origin skill also showed the changes it carried, which was also one of the reasons Origin Skill was feared and respected at the same time.
Aldaric, felt strength rush through his body, enough to lift the small mountains and then looked above, where all the lightning was also prepared and was now coming straight to him.

Though... this time he was not feeling much threat compared to earlier, because his bear transformation also increased his strength by 10 times of his normal body and the same was with his defense, which became 10 times, resulted in him reaching the peak of Middle Golden Knight.

On this he always felt proud of his transformation, but if he knew that Luke’s Titan form, even with a 1x stats multiplier, allowed him to reach the peak of Normal Knight, how much jealous he would be.

As Luke’s strength increased according to the Titan, but if he compared it to other Titans, then his stats would only be at the 2nd stage of that Titan, as Normal species bodies were weak, so each realm brought little change compared to other higher-level species, like dragons and others.
Aldaric after a moment calmed down and used his defensive move, as he was not arrogant enough to think he could tank 67 Early Golden Knight attacks without a scratch.
"Magma Hide!"
The next moment his body tensed and the orange fissures around his body grew brighter, with that the obsidian plates hardened and became denser.
His fur also changed, which now became crystallized, even though magma veins could still be seen running across his skin, which brought steam continuously from his body.
"COME!
He shouted toward the sky and it also replied.
KRRRRAAAAAK!!!
KRRRRAAAAAK!!!
KRRRRAAAAAK!!!

Everyone present felt dread, the moment so many lightning bolts tore through the sky and aimed straight at Aldaric. Even though they were almost half a kilometer far from Aldaric, they still felt the lightning’s heat, so they made even more distance, while the previous people who moved back already felt relieved.
Then it began.
One bolt.
Then another.
Then another.
Lightning after lightning descended from the heavens, each strike following the last without pause.
Before anyone could catch their breath, all sixty-seven bolts had torn across the sky, turning the sky into a raging sea of thunder and blinding light.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!... BOOM!!!

Aldaric’s bear-transformed body didn’t move, even after getting struck by tens of lightning bolts, but the ground around him was not safe, as it was cracked apart more and more with each second and was also melting because of the high temperatures.
Though he didn’t care about all that, instead raised his stone bear hand to shield his eyes, while getting struck by continuous lightning.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!... BOOM!!!
For a moment, the whole city only heard the wrath of the heavens, even some nearby territories felt this aftermath.
So when they looked toward Windmarch Reach territory, each of them also felt the dread and one thought came into everyone’s mind. ’Who has angered the heavens!!!’

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Luke Finally Stepped Onto the Battlefield
paragraphs: In the Stormviel County, the Count Magnus was reading the reports which came from the battle between Blackstone Highlands and the Ashenford family and got surprised, but suddenly he paused, then turned his face toward the Windmarch territory direction.
His expression turned to wonder, but the next moment he became confused.
The butler standing beside him, saw his lord’s different expression, also the direction he was looking. So he asked with an inquiring voice.
"My lord, do you need something?"
Hearing this, Magnus came out from his thoughts and shook his head before muttering. "I felt thunder was trying to destroy something, but the sky was too quiet for that."
Which confused him, as without the sky’s help, the thunder of that scale usually couldn’t form.
The butler also heard his lord’s confused muttering, and became baffled, but he didn’t ask for any further details.
Windmarch Reach...
Aldaric’s bear body with magma hides was fine for the initial 30 lightning attacks, but after that, it started cracking and getting destroyed at some parts.
Feeling this, Aldaric didn’t panic, because those were only his outer skins and fur. So he let them be.
"Do you think Lord Luke will be alright?"
The same question was being discussed everywhere as countless eyes remained fixed on Aldaric’s position.
By now, it had become like a gigantic lightning beacon, with countless bolts converging upon it. It looked as though it was directly connected to the heavens themselves.
On this, a few elders of the Ashenford family, who were at the Peak of Silver Knight, muttered with confidence.
"I don’t know about other Mid-Golden Knights, but Aldaric can easily resist even hundreds of Early Golden Knight attacks, with his Origin Skill."
Feeling the confidence in their elders voices, many of the younger generation also got relaxed and kept looking toward Aldaric’s direction, to know the result of this confrontation.
Finally, the thunder ceased, and everyone craned their necks to see what had happened.
Within moments, the dust and smoke cleared, revealing a scene that stunned everyone.
There stood Aldaric in his Bear Transformation, with a towering volcano behind him.
His entire body was intact. Apart from a few occasional scorch marks, not a single wound could be seen.
"Insane!!!" Someone among the crowd exclaimed, and the others followed suit.
Aldaric moved his body slightly and confirmed that everything was fine. Satisfied, he dismissed his Magma Hide before spitting onto the ground.
"PTOO!"
With that, he gave a provocative look toward the sky, but this time not a single lightning bolt was seen, which brought another sneer from his mouth.
"Seems like that’s what all you’ve got." And this comment escaped his mouth.
Luke from above saw all this and shook his head. Because all those attacks contained enough aether which Early Golden Knight attacks contained, ’but it lacks the aether quality.’
So Aldaric remained unscathed after using the Origin Skill, which was kinda what he could expect.
"Seems like it’s my time." He said to himself; but all ten mages expressions again became worried.
Even though earlier, Luke had reassured them, but after seeing Aldaric survive those lightning attacks, they became worried again.
Luke sensed the worried atmosphere, but instead of saying anything, he walked toward the exit.
The mages held their breaths as they watched their master approach the tower’s exit, silently praying that he would return safely.
When he reached it, the exit gate opened, and a fierce wind slammed into his face.
"Time for scuba diving."
With that, he leaped down without the slightest hesitation.
If it had been before, he might have been a little worried about facing a Mid-Golden Knight. But now... that concern no longer existed.
Because after training in the time chamber, he had learned some new ways and tricks regarding his third titan. Which had increased his confidence regarding the upcoming fight.
Inside Luke, all three titans saw his confidence, on which none of them commented, while Caelith just shook her head.
"He is still not strong enough or skilled to control those techniques." She muttered with a normal voice.
Nyx also nodded, while Myrkhal was meditating.

After jumping, Luke transformed into the Faceless Titan. He then used Form Transformation to assume Voltrax’s form before activating Form Assimilation, causing a pair of Sylvarion’s wings to emerge from his back.
With that, Luke dived down while using his wings and body to change the direction.
Down there, Aldaric felt something was moving above, so when he focussed more, he found out.
"Some kind of winged man?" but this confused him, ’why would winged people races come here?’ Still, he thought about capturing that person, to find the truth about recent attacks.
Luke also felt Aldaric’s gaze, so he turned his body toward the far forest side and flew straight right there.
Aldaric observed the winged person’s actions carefully, so when he noticed that it was going toward a far location, he understood immediately.
"It wants to bring me outside." For that, he became a little conflicted, but after finding that no more lightning attacks were coming, he got somewhat relaxed and decided.

’If I can capture him and obtain that artifact, it’ll all be worth it.’ The moment he thought of the artifact capable of unleashing so many attacks of that magnitude, a trace of greed flickered in his eyes.
Then he shouted toward everyone, "Lock all the gates and increase the security!" on which the elders became confused, because they didn’t see the winged person.
So they had no idea that Aldaric was heading outside.
The very next moment, however, they realized it, and worry filled their hearts. Even so, not a single one of them dared to raise their voice.
BOOM!
With a single push, his massive bear body shot toward the direction Luke had headed earlier.

The ground beneath him shattered from the force of his leap, while the resulting shockwave completely destroyed the surrounding buildings, which had already been riddled with cracks from the earlier lightning strikes.
Within few moments Aldaric reached the dense forest location, which had 100-foot-tall trees, each filled with green leaves.
He looked around to find the winged man, but to no avail. ’Where did it go?’

And finally, after 1 minute of searching, he found someone, though not the winged man.
Upon spotting the new figure, he paused and carefully observed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: The Cosmic System Descended
paragraphs: ’Fourteen feet tall... long golden hair flowing with starlight woven through it... but he’s definitely a man.’

Aldaric instantly confirmed it, also noticed that the man was wearing a gold-white armour, which was engraved with some kind of runes. After that, he looked at his eyes, which were burning with two starlights.
’Weird man.’ This thought came into his mind, before looking around, but finding none.
So he gave a curious look to the giant man and asked. "Where is your winged partner?"
Yes, Aldaric immediately concluded that this person belonged to the same group as the earlier attacker.
Even so, he showed no fear toward the mysterious man.
"You think you are smart, but I can clearly feel your realm. Early Bronze Knight." He shouted again to get some response from the person, but the man didn’t speak, just looked at him.
After a few moments, Luke shook his head, because he really thought that he had learned how to control his aether. So not anybody could spy on him, ’but I am still not good enough.’
Currently, the aura Luke’s body was emitting belonged to the Peak Silver Knight level.
It wasn’t his actual realm. Rather, the sheer amount of Aether within his body had increased to the point where it could be compared to that of a Peak Silver Knight.
Still, even after that, Aldaric was able to see his quality and accurately find out his realm, which was surprising.
"Well, I don’t have enough time, so let’s get done with this fight." Luke said with a bored voice, which surprised Aldaric.
’Does he really think that with mere Peak Silver Knight raw power, he can defeat me? Defeat a Mid-Golden Knight?’
Thinking this, Aldaric’s expression darkened with anger.
He had just been bombarded by hidden rats, and now another one had appeared, spouting such foolish words right to his face.
But the next moment, his anger completely disappeared, instead it turned into bafflement.
"Cosmos Manifestation." Luke’s heavy but calm voice, mixed with a little feminine tone, was heard by Aldaric and the next instant, above them, in the sky, a cosmic system materialized out of nowhere.
At the center of the system was a colossal rocky sphere, nearly 200 meters in diameter.
Surrounding it in a circular orbit were 10 elemental moons, each around 50 meters across, revolving at fixed distances from one another.
At the outermost edge, a hundred asteroids infused with different elemental attributes also rotated around the entire system, completing the celestial formation.
"This!"
For the first time in his life, Aldaric had witnessed something like this.

What astonished him the most was that this entire phenomenon had been summoned by an Early Bronze Knight. Although Luke’s Aether had temporarily reached the level of a Peak Silver Knight, his actual realm remained that of an Early Bronze Knight.
But still, this was insane and almost seemed impossible... unless, ’he has a high-rank artifact.’ Thinking this, his eyes changed, and greed appeared in them.
Because if he defeated him, then he was going to get two different powerful artifacts, after dealing with the winged man as well.
While he was thinking this with a blissful expression, a sudden strong gravitational force came from above, which nearly stopped his 30-foot-tall bear body.
’What the hell?’ Confusion flashed across his face as he quickly looked around.

Only then did he realize that the entire area had transformed into a high-gravity zone. Every tree within a one-kilometer radius had either cracked or bent under the immense pressure, their trunks forced flat against the ground.

Then his face turned to horror as he felt his strength was getting suppressed from the Peak of Mid-Golden Knight to the Peak of Early Golden Knight. And that was when he was using his Origin Skill. If not, then it would become Early Golden Knight.
So Aldaric turned his pale face toward the front. There the long-haired man was standing calmly, with a small smile on his face.
Luke became impressed after seeing the gravity suppression effects of his cosmic system.
Then a gentle voice came into his mind. "Luke, concentrate, and remember not to bring more energy or your body will burst apart."
Luke nodded after hearing Caelith’s voice, as he had done it before, so he could do it again.
And what was he going to do??
That was using his Cosmic Heart to generate more energy.
Why??
Because Caelith was the Cosmic Heart Titan, not a planet or star titan. So she had a heart, which contained endless energy.
And since Luke had transformed into that form, theoretically he could also use that; surprisingly, he was even doing that.
Because normally, at the first stage of Bronze Knight, he couldn’t sustain the Cosmic Heart Titan form for more than 1 minute or he would run out of stamina and many more reasons.
But now his heart was constantly pumping with aether, stamina, and healing energy. So he could sustain this form for a very, very long time.
’Sadly no.’ Luke shook his head, then recalled the cracks his body was getting when he used it for a long time, in the time chamber.

Yeah, Luke’s body was not a real titan body, so it couldn’t sustain the Cosmic Heart. Even though he was getting healed, it was like removing the water from a sinking ship, in the middle of the ocean, with the help of a bucket.
The rate at which his body was healing. It was destroying way faster with each passing moment.
So what was he about to do right now?? He was going to generate the whole system back again in his body.

The reason, of course, was for more strength. Because without using those cosmic system combined strengths, Luke’s attack power would be around Half-Golden Knight, which he knew for sure. It wasn’t even close to harming Aldaric.
With that, he concentrated...
Concentrated on his heart and increased the amount of energy it was releasing.
...So the moment he felt the amount increase. He started creating those asteroids, moons, and the planet back, one by one.
Aldaric, after getting a little calm down, observed that the person again stopped showing any reaction and was concentrating on something.

’Is it those floating bodies??’ He thought confusedly, ’So I need to disturb his concentration.’ On this thought, Aldaric’s smile returned to his face and he charged straight toward Luke, with slower speed than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: A Mid-Golden Knight Was Overpowered
paragraphs: Aldaric didn’t know, how right he was. Because if Luke could summon those cosmic systems outside and recreate them, so he could do it again?? Right??
But no. First, he didn’t have enough spirituality, which is a different power system and could be increased with each realm.
So currently, he could only control one cosmic system outside and the same for inside.
Luke sensed Aldaric’s massive body charging straight toward him, but he was already prepared.
Within him, all one hundred asteroids, ten moons, and the central planet had already been formed.
Now, every one of them was fully activated.
"Die!" Aldaric roared as he threw a full-powered punch with all his might.
In response, Luke remained calm. He simply raised his palm and extended it toward the thirty-foot-tall giant bear.
Seeing this, Aldaric sneered at Luke’s futile attempt and increased his punch force.
BOOOOOM!
The clash between the two Knights shook the battlefield.
BOOOOOOM!!!
The moment Aldaric attack collided with Luke palm, a devastating shockwave erupted outward, shaking everything within a hundred-meter radius.
The ground beneath their feet collapsed instantly, forming a massive crater as countless cracks raced across the earth like spiderwebs.
Trees were uprooted without resistance, while boulders, shattered debris, and countless chunks of earth were blasted high into the sky by the sheer force of the impact alone.
At the center of the destruction, the two Knights remained locked in their clash.
Everywhere, dust clouds also rose, which blurred the outcome, but inside, Aldaric’s face became ugly.
As he felt his giant bear paw was being held by an Early Bronze Knight. ’How???’ and only this question rang in his mind.
But Luke didn’t answer.
Instead, he responded with a punch.
A simple, straightforward punch aimed directly at Aldaric’s face.
BAM!!!
The deafening impact echoed across the battlefield.

Aldaric’s colossal bear-like body was blasted backward with terrifying force, as though struck by a charging mountain. His massive frame tore through the air for nearly two hundred meters before crashing into the ground.
BOOOOOOM!!!

The impact carved out another enormous crater, sending rocks, dirt, and shattered debris flying in every direction. Dust billowed hundreds of feet into the air, while cracks spread rapidly across the surrounding earth.
The sheer force of a single punch left Aldaric in disbelief.
Though Luke wasn’t surprised by his strength.
He had already tested and verified, that if he used his asteroid combined strength, then he could use Half-Golden Knight attacks freely.
Of course, strength, not aether.
While if he used 10 moons, then he would be able to use Early Golden Knight attacks, and for the planet he could use the middle of Early Golden Knight.
But if he used the whole cosmic system, then his strength power would reach the Peak of Early Golden Knight.
Nyx and Caelith watched everything with normal expressions. Then Caelith nodded, after seeing that Luke could concentrate on both systems somewhat.
"He still needs to practice to use more features of this system." She muttered with a normal voice, on which Nyx didn’t say anything, but got lost in his own thoughts.
Hearing no response from Nyx, Caelith shook her head and focused outside.
After feeling his strength, Luke, with a single push, crossed the distance between them and appeared in front of Aldaric.
And unleashed a flurry of punches on him.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The ground cracked beneath them with each punch, along with Aldaric’s bear body also going deeper into the ground.
BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!! BOOM!!
The relentless barrage of punches continued.
One devastating blow after another crashed into Aldaric’s body without giving him the slightest chance to recover.
Minutes passed beneath the unending storm of fists.
Then...
Luke drew back his arm.
Gathering every ounce of force into a single strike, and unleashed one final, devastating punch.
BOOOOOOOM!!!
The impact was catastrophic.
The ground beneath Aldaric was utterly obliterated, collapsing into a gigantic crater as a visible ring of force erupted outward from the point of impact.
WHOOOOOSH!!
The shockwave swept across the battlefield like a violent hurricane.
Dust, shattered boulders, and the broken remains of trees that had survived the earlier destruction were all hurled away by the overwhelming blast.

At the same time, enormous spiderweb-like cracks raced across the earth in every direction, splitting the battlefield apart as though the land itself could no longer withstand the terrifying force behind Luke’s punch.
A low groan escaped Aldaric’s lips.
Blood trickled from his nose, staining his face.
Yet...
A grin slowly spread across his lips.
PTUI!
He spat a mouthful of blood onto the ground before lifting his head to look at Luke, his eyes filled with provocation.
"You’ve suppressed my strength..." he mocked with a cold laugh.
"But you couldn’t suppress my body’s defense."
He pounded his broad chest with one massive fist.
"It’s still at the level of a Peak Mid-Golden Knight."
His smile widened into a confident smirk.
"Your punches hurt..."
"...but they aren’t enough to bring me down."
With those words, Aldaric slowly pushed himself up using both hands.
His colossal body rose inch by inch, radiating an unyielding presence.
As he stood to his full height, the dust and shattered debris clinging to his massive frame slid off one after another, falling heavily onto the ground.
Thud... Thud...
Despite the punishment he had endured, he still stood tall like an unbreakable mountain.
Luke, however, didn’t retreat.
He remained exactly where he was.
His expression never changed.
His emotionless gaze stayed fixed on Aldaric from beginning to end, calmly following the giant bear’s every movement until the towering figure was once again standing before him.
Those azure eyes remained as tranquil as a frozen lake, revealing neither surprise nor concern—as though the outcome had already been decided in his mind.
Because of the earlier actions, he suddenly lost concentration, so that’s why he was listening to his bullshit, while trying to steady the rotation of the above celestial bodies.
"Haaa... much better." Aldaric muttered like earlier he didn’t get beaten, but got a massage instead.
Though the whole 50m ground area said different things, which was now filled with destroyed rocks and was uneven because of the earlier destruction.

With that, he looked straight at Luke’s eyes and said again with mockery. "I don’t know, how your punch carries Peak Early Golden Knight power, but if you are depending upon that. Then forget about this."
And the next instant, his fist glowed with volcanic light and his loud voice reached Luke’s ears.
"Volcanic Fist!"

At the same time, enormous spiderweb-like cracks raced across the earth in every direction, splitting the battlefield apart as though the land itself could no longer withstand the terrifying force behind Luke’s punch.
A low groan escaped Aldaric’s lips.
Blood trickled from his nose, staining his face.
Yet...
A grin slowly spread across his lips.
PTUI!
He spat a mouthful of blood onto the ground before lifting his head to look at Luke, his eyes filled with provocation.
"You’ve suppressed my strength..." he mocked with a cold laugh.
"But you couldn’t suppress my body’s defense."
He pounded his broad chest with one massive fist.
"It’s still at the level of a Peak Mid-Golden Knight."
His smile widened into a confident smirk.
"Your punches hurt..."
"...but they aren’t enough to bring me down."
With those words, Aldaric slowly pushed himself up using both hands.
His colossal body rose inch by inch, radiating an unyielding presence.
As he stood to his full height, the dust and shattered debris clinging to his massive frame slid off one after another, falling heavily onto the ground.
Thud...
Thud...
Despite the punishment he had endured, he still stood tall like an unbreakable mountain.
Luke, however, didn’t retreat.
He remained exactly where he was.
His expression never changed.
His emotionless gaze stayed fixed on Aldaric from beginning to end, calmly following the giant bear’s every movement until the towering figure was once again standing before him.
Those azure eyes remained as tranquil as a frozen lake, revealing neither surprise nor concern—as though the outcome had already been decided in his mind.
Because of the earlier actions, he suddenly lost concentration, so that’s why he was listening to his bullshit, while trying to steady the rotation of the above celestial bodies.
"Haaa... much better." Aldaric muttered like earlier he didn’t get beaten, but got a massage instead.
Though the whole 50m ground area said different things, which was now filled with destroyed rocks and was uneven because of the earlier destruction.
With that, he looked straight at Luke’s eyes and said again with mockery.
"I don’t know, how your punch carries Peak Early Golden Knight power, but if you are depending upon that.
Then forget about this."
And the next instant, his fist glowed with volcanic light and his loud voice reached Luke’s ears.
"Volcanic Fist!"

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Two Moons Crashed Into Aldaric
paragraphs: With a furious roar, Aldaric’s blazing fist shot straight toward Luke’s chest.
’Fast!’
Luke’s eyes narrowed.
The attack arrived in an instant, carrying terrifying speed that completely defied the fact that Aldaric’s strength had supposedly been suppressed.
There was no time to evade.
So Luke immediately raised both arms, crossing them in front of his chest to receive the blow.
At the same time, he shifted the ten moons within his body, distributing five into each arm to reinforce them against the incoming impact.
Even though his entire body was protected by Elythos, he wasn’t willing to take unnecessary risks.
THUD!!!
The blazing fist slammed into Luke’s crossed arms with overwhelming force.
The impact launched him across the battlefield like a cannonball, his feet carving two deep trenches into the earth as he was hurled hundreds of meters backward.
Yet one astonishing sight drew Aldaric’s attention.
The vast cosmic manifestation hanging high above the battlefield moved with Luke.
The planets, moons, and celestial bodies shifted across the sky as though Luke remained the center of their universe.
No matter how far he was blasted away, the entire miniature cosmos continued to revolve around him.
That was because Luke’s Cosmic Manifestation could only exist within a diameter of roughly one thousand meters, and wherever Luke went...
The cosmos followed.
’Damn it... that hurts.’ Luke cursed inwardly while still flying through the air.
Without wasting a single moment, he raised one hand toward the sky.
The next instant...
Whoooom!
One hundred celestial asteroids materialized above the battlefield, with ranges from 5-10m.
Each one hovered high in the sky, radiating dense cosmic energy.
With a wave of his hand, Luke sent them hurtling toward Aldaric.
WHOOSH! WHOOSH! WHOOSH!
One hundred streaks of light descended from the sky, falling one after another like a relentless meteor shower.
’What?!’
Aldaric’s pupils shrank.
The sudden appearance of so many objects in the sky caught him completely off guard.
For a brief moment, he thought Luke had summoned another barrage of massive boulders capable of flattening the battlefield.
But after taking a closer look...
He realized they weren’t enormous rocks at all.
They were comparatively small celestial bodies.
The tension in his expression eased slightly.
’They’re not those giant boulders...’

"Grrrrr..." Still a low annoyed growl escaped Aldaric’s bear body, after seeing those projectiles speed was increased because of the celestial bodies gravity, so rather than dodging, he summoned his Magma Hides again.
"Magma Hides!"
The next instant, his body became dense and his fur became crystallized.
CRACK! CRACK! CRACK!...CRACK!!!
Stone-cracking sounds echoed across the whole battlefield as they collided with Aldaric’s huge body. Though his body wasn’t bearing any wounds from this.
"ROARRR!"
"Now you are angering me!" Feeling annoyed and angry, Aldaric roared and immediately used his movement skill, which could bridge the distance between him and Luke.
"Eruption Rush!"
The moment those words left Aldaric’s mouth, the volcano on his back erupted with dazzling crimson light.
BOOOOM!!
A violent surge of volcanic energy burst from within, causing molten magma to overflow from the countless cracks covering its surface.
The next instant, Aldaric’s colossal body shot forward.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
Every step shattered the ground beneath his feet as explosive bursts of volcanic force propelled him ahead at terrifying speed.
Molten magma sprayed from his limbs with each movement, scattering blazing droplets across the battlefield and igniting everything they touched.
Behind him, a thick trail of black smoke billowed from the volcano on his back, stretching across the sky like the wake of an erupting mountain.
His entire body became a blazing comet of fire and molten rock, charging straight toward Luke with unstoppable momentum.
Seeing Aldaric closing the distance fast, Luke’s face changed to worry and he instantly used his Titan Armour ability.
’COSMIC CONSTRUCT’
As this ability allowed him to construct any structures from the materials inside his cosmic system.
So he made thick walls of ice, wind, stone, metal, and even chains, forming in front of and beside Aldaric’s charging body to slow him down.
SMASH! SMASH! SMASH!
SNAP! SNAP! SNAP!
But Aldaric, in his Eruption Rush, broke each wall one by one and even snapped the chains easily.
"What a bull..." Luke cursed under his breath.
Seeing Aldaric charging at him with unstoppable momentum, he knew there was no time left to dodge.
So with a thought, he summoned two 50m moons above his head.
Each measured nearly fifty meters in diameter.
One was forged entirely of dense metal, its surface gleaming with a cold metallic sheen.
The other was a moon of ice, radiating a bone-chilling frost that froze the surrounding air.
"Here—take this, bastard!"
Luke roared as he swung both hands downward.
The two colossal moons plummeted toward Aldaric with overwhelming force.
WHOOOOOSH!!
Aldaric’s expression changed instantly.
His charge came to an abrupt halt the moment the gigantic celestial bodies suddenly materialized before him.
But he was moving far too fast.
Even with all his strength, he couldn’t stop in time.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
His massive body slammed head-on into the descending moons.
An earth-shattering explosion echoed across the battlefield.
CRACK!
CRACK!!
Countless fractures spread across both celestial moons.
In the very next instant...
SHATTER!!!
The Metal Moon and the Ice Moon exploded into innumerable fragments, unleashing a colossal shockwave that erupted in every direction.
The blast flattened the surrounding terrain, hurling shattered rock, ice shards, and metallic fragments high into the sky.
Seeing the destructive shockwave racing toward him, Luke reacted immediately.
With a wave of his hand, a thick elongated wall rose from the earth in front of him.
He then planted both feet firmly into the ground, anchoring himself as the barrier absorbed the incoming force.
BOOOOOOM!!
The shockwave slammed into the wall with overwhelming power, causing the massive structure to tremble violently while dust and debris exploded into the air.

’I should have gone far, before using this.’ he thought, while hiding behind the shaking wall, which had generated some cracks on it. Which he was constantly filling with his Cosmic Construct ability.
But then Caelith’s little worried voice came. "Luke, your body is coming to its limit, finish this fight fast."
With that, he also noticed his body’s cracks were leaking starlight, and even with constant healing they were increasing.

’This is bad.’ Luke became worried about this, because he noticed that in Titan form his pain resistance had reached a very high level, but when he would return back to his normal body, then the pain would come with interest, which worried him the most.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: "You Are Luke Voidheart!"
paragraphs: ’Seems like there is no more any choice.’ Luke decided to use that move, though before he could do that, Aldaric’s another angry voice came, but this time he seemed really pissed off.
After getting struck by the two moons, Aldaric’s body was bleeding from several places.
Many shards of ice and metal were still embedded inside his body, which brought pain with each movement.
’I will kill him!’ Aldaric, with bloodshot eyes and a bleeding bear face, looked toward the elongated wall and summoned his ultimate Origin Skill.
"C-RANK ORIGIN SKILL VOLCANO BEAR: ULTIMATE ABILITY!"

Aldaric’s loud voice echoed, which chilled Luke’s whole body and his Titan instinct started screaming at him. Even Nyx and Caelith, seeing the situation, got worried and told Luke to move away from the location.
Luke nodded and, with a hurried face, tried to make distance from the giant bear.
But the next moment, his eyes turned to horror and his face became pale. ’I can’t move.’
So with horror-filled eyes, he moved them and looked sideways. There, Aldaric’s volcano mouth was fully opened, along with the whole 100m area getting filled with red magma aether.
’This!’ His expression turned worse, because a ball of red magma was starting to gather at Aldaric’s mouth, which was coming from his volcano.
’I have to move.’ Luke repeated those words, and tried to use the strength of the whole cosmic system, but couldn’t move his body at all.
"Luke, this is Aura Lock!" Then Nyx’s voice came inside his mind, and he said. "He is using his aether to surround your body, which is often done by higher realm beings when they use their ultimate."

Inside, Nyx shook his head and added. "Though, if you were a higher realm, or had my armour, you could escape from this situation, but sadly he is using his Origin Skill ultimate ability, which seems to increase his control over aether to the Early Late-stage Golden Knight for a moment."
On this, Luke’s face became even paler and he tried to return back into his normal form, but found his aether was locked and was not returning to his core.
’Damn it.’ But the moment he cursed, Aldaric also released his ultimate.
"VOLCANO’S BREATH!!!"
A colossal beam of molten lava and volcanic energy erupted from his jaws.
Seeing this, he let out a sigh and calmed down. The horror he had felt earlier also faded away.
After all, his actions had been meant to force Aldaric to reveal all of his trump cards, such as the explosive magic scrolls Rowan had carried during their previous encounter.

While Luke was thinking all this, the beam tore across the battlefield, carving a trench through the earth. It struck the wall where Luke was with the intention not of killing him, but of annihilation.

Fortunately, at the last moment, the three rings which were on his fingers flared with intense light, and all three of them covered Luke’s body completely with a golden barrier, which attached closely to his body, rather than a spherical shape.
"Nice save, Queen’s Ward." He smiled inside the barrier, while looking at the incoming lava beam.
Still, he complained about the need for 3 rings for his single body. On this, the system’s speechless voice came.
[Luke, that’s an Arcane grade, which is Bronze Knight level. So it’s already crazy that it could withstand Golden Knight level attacks. That’s why don’t be greedy.]
Hearing the system’s reply, Luke smiled sheepishly, and tried to calm down the system, who was about to start his sage mode. After that, he focused on the destruction.
Then the ground beneath Luke shattered with a catastrophic explosion. Resulting in the surrounding rocks melting into lava, while ash and smoke rose like a second sun from its place.
And where Luke had stood—only a crater of molten rock remained.
’Wow... that’s some insane destructive power.’ He tried to look beyond the crater, but to no avail.
His gaze then shifted to his fingers, where the three rings had been completely destroyed, leaving no chance of repair. ’I’ll miss you, Queen’s Ward.’
Outside...
"Huff... Huff..."
Aldaric’s breathing turned ragged as his massive chest rose and fell heavily.
The volcano on his back had dimmed considerably, its once-blazing glow now reduced to a faint crimson ember.
The attack had consumed nearly everything he had.
"I... don’t have any energy left."
His exhausted voice rumbled from within the giant bear’s body.
Every muscle ached.
Even standing had become difficult.
Slowly, he lifted his gaze toward the enormous crater left behind by the final collision.
Dust still filled the air, concealing everything within.
A faint smile appeared on his weary face.
In his mind...
The battle was already over.
Luke couldn’t have survived an attack of that magnitude.
So, without waiting for the dust to settle, Aldaric silently accepted that his opponent had already been reduced to nothing beneath the devastating impact.
But he failed to notice one thing in his accomplishment, which was the gravity.
The celestial bodies were still rotating in the sky, showing the clear sign that the controller was fully alive. Though the next second, he found out after hearing a carefree voice.
"Yo! That was something."
Luke’s casual voice suddenly echoed from within the dust-filled crater.
Aldaric’s exhausted smile froze.
The next instant—
WHOOSH!!
A figure shot out of the crater like a cannonball before descending onto the battlefield.
THUD!!
Luke landed firmly on the ground, sending a small cloud of dust rippling outward.
He casually rolled one shoulder before dusting off the dirt clinging to his armor.
Aside from a few scratches and a slightly disheveled appearance, he looked remarkably unharmed.
A faint grin rested on his face as he looked directly at Aldaric.
"That attack almost got me."
His relaxed tone contrasted sharply with the devastation surrounding them.
Meanwhile, Aldaric could only stare with widened eyes.
The disbelief on his face was impossible to hide.
"Y-You’re still alive...?!"
Even that was not all. ’He is not even injured.’ which made him somewhat afraid of him now.
Luke nodded after seeing Aldaric’s frozen expression, then he muttered something in a low voice. "I have to return to my wife, so let’s finish this now."

But Aldaric belonged to the Golden Knight realm, so he heard every word clearly, which brought another shock to him. ’Wife? Return?’ So he thought about everything happening from the start and thought about how his army had gone to deal with Blackstone Highlands.
"You are Luke Voidheart, the Hero." So with a loud voice and a wide-eyed expression, he shouted.
Luke smiled and shook his head. "Took you long enough."

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Cosmic Lock & Cosmic Punch
paragraphs: On this before Aldaric could reply or react to his voice, something happened, which brought extreme horror to his whole giant body.
The celestial bodies revolving high above the battlefield suddenly changed their paths.
Whoooom...
One after another, they swept behind Luke in perfect synchronization.
They aligned themselves into a single, perfectly straight line.
At the very front floated the smallest celestial bodies—the asteroids.
Behind them came larger fragments.
Then the massive moons.
And at the very end...
The colossal planet silently took its place.
It was as though an entire solar system had been arranged into a single devastating formation.
Aldaric’s pupils shrank violently.
Every hair on his body stood on end.
An overwhelming sense of danger exploded within his instincts.
Without hesitation, he tried to retreat.
To get as far away from Luke as possible.
But...
He was already too late.
Luke slowly raised one hand.
His calm, emotionless voice echoed throughout the battlefield.
"Cosmic Lock."
HUMMMMMMM...
The aligned celestial bodies shone simultaneously.
Instead of releasing their gravitational force in every direction...
They compressed it.
Focused it.
Condensed the gravitational pull of every celestial body into a single, perfectly straight line.
And that line pointed directly at Aldaric.
The space between Luke and Aldaric visibly distorted.
The air twisted.
The ground cracked before collapsing inward.
Boulders and loose debris were crushed flat as the overwhelming gravitational force converged on a single target.
’I... can’t move!’
Aldaric’s eyes widened in horror.
It wasn’t merely that his body had become heavy.
It was as though an entire planet had descended upon him.
Every muscle screamed.
Every bone groaned beneath the unimaginable pressure.
No matter how desperately he struggled, his body refused to move even a single inch.
Worse still...
He couldn’t even circulate the Aether within his body.
His Aether Core itself seemed to have been pinned down by the overwhelming gravity, leaving him completely powerless.
For the first time since the battle had begun...
True fear appeared in Aldaric’s eyes.
"I don’t have the things which you high-level knights use to bind your opponent." Luke said with a helpless sigh, but Aldaric couldn’t react to his sarcastic remark.
"But this one is also fine." With that, Luke took one step, then another, until he was one step away from Aldaric’s giant bear body.
There Luke could see a huge amount of hatred in those eyes, along with a huge amount of horror.
On that, Luke nodded with satisfaction, as the gravity those bodies emitted was enough to hold even a Peak Golden Knight, and Aldaric was just a Mid-Golden Knight.
Then he recalled the days, where inside the Time Chamber, how many times he almost got killed.
"Luke, as you know. I am the Cosmic Heart Titan, so I can create any type of matter or energy. Life, death, etc..."
Caelith’s small floating body settled down on Luke’s shoulder, while continuing.
"But when the fight occurred during our time, I was left behind by my peers." On that, her voice got a little low, but after a moment she shook her head and continued.
"So after millennia of practice, I developed my own technique. My own fighting method."
"...which is the cosmic system." She paused there, reminiscing about those old days.
"With this I could use the strength of the whole universe, at my peak."
"And from that I created even more methods, to utilize the cosmic system’s power."
After this, she looked straight at Luke’s face and said. "Two of them are Cosmic Lock and the other is Cosmic Impact."
"With the Cosmic Lock, you could use the insane amount of gravity at a single point to hold back anything, mass, matter, energy, even time at one level."
Luke got completely surprised after hearing the last part, but she added something, "Of course, there is more than gravity involved at higher levels, which we are not talking about here."
With that, she continued. "The other one is Cosmic Impact, which is still too much for you, so we will go on a smaller level, which is Cosmic Punch.
Luke nodded and did as she said. So he tried this technique again and again, and many times his arm got pulverized completely.

Fortunately, his Titan body of Caelith allowed him almost instant regeneration because of the huge amount of healing energy the Cosmic Heart was pumping, so he was able to practice this technique more and more, until...
...he didn’t succeed.
"Damn it!" Luke cursed as he lay down on the ground. Seeing this, both Nyx and Caelith shook their heads, while Myrkhal was moving around somewhere.
"Luke, you don’t have a real Titan body, which is why you couldn’t bear even your own planet’s force."
Hearing their words didn’t make him feel any better, but he didn’t give up. "I will master it." So he tried again and again until he found one method, which could help him perform this technique.
Present time...
Luke came out of his thoughts and moved all his inner moons to his right hand, while moving his asteroids into both legs. And then let the planet remain in his chest.
"I never thought about this counter method." Caelith shook her head at Luke’s new creative way to counter the force. Because she never got the need for this.
As Luke was using the moons combined strength to make his attacking arm strong enough to bear the recoil force. While asteriods to hold his legs. And planet for center stability.
’I hope it will work, like earlier in the time chamber.’ Luke thought nervously and took a deep breath to calm himself.
Alarm rang in Aldaric’s mind after seeing Luke’s weird actions. Then came his calm voice.
"Cosmic Punch."
With that, Luke’s punch blurred for a moment and the next moment, there was a big hole in the giant bear’s body, along with his heart missing.
’How!’ Aldaric’s thought process slowed down, as he couldn’t understand how Luke could breach his Peak Mid-Golden Knight defense.
Though the answer didn’t come. Instead came the deafening sound of the earth shattering.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Luke’s punch force, after making a hole in Aldaric’s body, reached the ground.
The result?? The earth shook like an earthquake had come.
BOOM! — The first ring exploded outward.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! — The second ring followed.
CRACK! CRACK! CRACK! — The third ring split the ground.
KRAAAAAAAAASH! — The fourth ring destroyed everything.
With them at the center, all this destruction happened, then came the rain of debris.
THUD! THUD! THUD!
Silence...
...Complete silence remained in the surrounding vicinity and with that, a kilometer of ground was gone...
Only a wide crater remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Disaster Struck Blackstone
paragraphs: "That’s your end, Viscount Aldaric Ashenford." Luke muttered after seeing the light in his eyes dimming with each passing second and bent down to pick up his spatial ring.
"Your spatial ring should contain something valuable." With those indifferent words, Luke turned around and walked away.
The very next moment...
Every celestial body suspended high above the battlefield completed its descent.
Asteroids.
Celestial fragments.
Moons.
Even the colossal planet.
They all reached the ground almost simultaneously.
Then—
They self-destructed.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
A cataclysmic explosion erupted across the battlefield.
The detonation was several times greater than anything witnessed earlier, swallowing the entire region in an endless sea of blinding light.
A colossal shockwave burst outward, flattening forests, uprooting surrounding mountains of earth, and sending billions of tons of dust and debris soaring into the sky.
The ground shook violently for dozens of kilometers as though the land itself had been struck by a falling star.
Far beyond Windmarch Reach, the tremor was faintly felt by the surrounding territories.
People instinctively stopped what they were doing and looked toward the distant horizon once again.
Then...
Their eyes nearly popped out of their sockets.
"WHAT?!"
A gigantic mushroom cloud was rising into the sky.
Black smoke mixed with blazing fire, climbing higher and higher until it towered over the surrounding mountains.
The terrifying sight sent chills down everyone’s spine.
"First Heaven’s Wrath..."
"...and now this?!"
The surrounding lords, merchants, adventurers, and countless civilians stared in disbelief.
They quickly pieced together the recent events.
Such terrifying disturbances was originating from one place.
Windmarch Reach.
Silence fell as the same conclusion emerged in everyone’s mind.
"Viscount Aldaric’s territory... has been attacked."
A cold shiver ran down their backs.
Because anyone capable of creating devastation on this scale...
Could not possibly be an ordinary expert.
"Someone stronger than a Mid-Golden Knight..."
That terrifying thought echoed in the minds of everyone who witnessed the distant mushroom cloud.
Even Count Magnus, who had removed the thought of checking those thunder earlier, felt the big explosion even from thousands of kilometers away.
’This... a Peak Golden Knight?’ The thought flashed through his mind, but he quickly shook his head.
Within his territory, he didn’t paid attention to beings below the Platinum Knight realm.
Luke had caused that final explosion intentionally.
It wasn’t merely to finish the battlefield.
The cataclysmic detonation erased everything within the impact zone—battle traces, Aether fluctuations, footprints, corpses, and even the unique remnants of his abilities.
Nothing recognizable remained.
Anyone arriving later would only find a devastated wasteland, making it impossible to determine what had truly transpired there.
"Soon my armies will take care of Windmarch Reach." he muttered while looking toward the panicked citizens of Windmarch, who had also freaked out after seeing the huge mushroom cloud.
"With this, I have reduced my enemies by one." Luke sighed tiredly and called Elena with the help of the Tidewhisper Conch.
Soon a beam of light appeared above him and Luke vanished from his position, leaving not a single clue.
That a talentless hero had killed a Mid-Golden Knight in this place.
After returning to the Magic Tower, Luke slumped onto a large sofa before finally dismissing his Titan form.
His towering physique rapidly shrank, returning to his normal human body.
For a brief moment...
Everything was quiet.
Then the backlash struck.
"Ughhh... damn it..." Luke’s face twisted in pain as a low groan escaped his lips.
It felt as though every bone in his body had developed countless cracks, while his muscles spasmed violently, tearing apart under the immense strain they had endured during the battle.
Veins bulged across his arms, and cold sweat instantly drenched his forehead.
Even lifting a finger sent waves of agonizing pain coursing through his entire body.
The overwhelming power he had forced himself to wield had exacted a brutal price.
"Master!!!"
Seeing his condition, all ten mages cried out in alarm.
Panic flashed across their faces as they hurried toward him.
Some immediately supported his body, afraid he would collapse from the sofa, while others hurriedly circulated their mana, preparing healing and diagnostic spells to assess his injuries.
The peaceful atmosphere inside the Magic Tower vanished in an instant, replaced by tension as everyone realized the terrifying backlash Luke was suffering.
Elena even cast all her magic skills on him.
"Healing Wounds"
"Fatigue Recovery"
"Stabilizing Mana"
"Mana Recovery"
She repeatedly cast every healing spell she knew, one after another, without the slightest hesitation.
She didn’t care how much mana she consumed.
To a mage, mana was their lifeblood—a different manifestation of Aether—and exhausting it completely could leave them unconscious or even endanger their lives.
Yet none of that mattered to her.
Her only concern was her master.
Soft green and golden lights continuously enveloped his body as healing magic washed over him again and again, gradually repairing the damaged muscles and easing the strain on his fractured bones.
Minutes later...
Luke’s condition finally stabilized, though not completely.
His breathing became steadier, and the violent spasms throughout his body gradually subsided.

Although the pain hadn’t disappeared completely, it had lessened enough for him to endure without gritting his teeth with every breath. The relentless barrage of healing spells had finally brought the backlash under control.
"I am fine-" As he was about to complete his words, the Tidewhisper Conch beside him glowed and then the panicked voice of Kai came from the other side.
"Master! Five Golden Knights had suddenly appeared on the battlefield and were now attacking us."
"One of them is even a Mid-Golden Knight!"
’What!’ Luke’s pupils dilated, because he did expect variables to come, but not Golden Knights, and not even more a freaking Mid-Golden Knight.
’Aurielle and others...’ Then fear appeared in his eyes and he immediately asked Kai about this.

"Master, Lady Aurora alone held back those Golden Knights, but she got injured heavily. Fortunately, Lady Aurielle and Lady Vaelira arrived on time, and now they are holding back those Golden Knights."
Luke’s worry lessened somewhat, finding they were alive, but then came the anger when he heard Aurora was injured.
"Master!"
Seeing Luke’s face become angry, the mages got worried and called out.
At this, Luke also came out of his anger and took a deep breath to calm down.
And thought about, how to deal with them, because he knew, even with her armour, Aurielle couldn’t hold back real Golden Knights for long.
’I need to heal back.’ So he ordered everyone. "Use the Recall Function to teleport directly to the territory."
Hearing this, all the mages nodded and took their positions before starting the Recall Function.
The Recall Function belonged to the S-rank Arcane Sky Tower, through which it could teleport back to the anchor location without caring about any restriction below Saint tier.
’But the cooldown.’ Luke’s expression fell, but he didn’t care about the one-month cooldown.
"Sequence started. In 10s, the Sky Tower will return to its anchor location." Elena said, and soon the countdown started.
"10...9...8... 2...1...0!" The moment the countdown reached zero, the whole tower glowed from the outside and, with a WHOOSH sound, it vanished from there.
