chapters.title: Chapter 137: Five Golden Knights Infiltrated the Fortress
paragraphs: 10 minutes earlier...
"ATTACK!!!"
"KILL THEM!!!"
"DEFEND!!!"
The war cries of thousands of soldiers and knights echoed relentlessly across the battlefield, blending with the constant clash of steel.
CLANG!
SLASH!
BOOM!
Every collision was followed by bloodshed...
Or worse.
Death.
At the front lines, the knights of both armies fought a fierce and brutal battle, neither side willing to yield an inch of ground.
Meanwhile, the Ashenford archers and Aether Cannons maintained a relentless barrage, repeatedly targeting the towering iron fortresses.
Yet the results were far from satisfactory.

Most of the incoming attacks were absorbed by the fortresses deployed defensive shields. Any strike that managed to penetrate the barrier was met by layers of reinforced, enchanted steel, which endured the impacts with little more than a shower of sparks.
CLANG! CLINK! KLANG!
"Keep the formation!"
Osric’s commanding voice rang across the battlefield.

Under his orders, the Blackstone Legions advanced with disciplined precision, using the fortresses as moving cover. They struck at the enemy from behind the protective walls while exposing themselves to only a handful of counterattacks.
With every passing minute, the advantage gradually shifted toward Blackstone, as the iron fortresses continued to dominate the battlefield like unbreakable walls of steel.
The onlookers became surprised after seeing this, and some people even got amazed. "The blackstone strategy sure working good."
One noble descendant commented, on which other nodded, because while Ashenford have lost many high-level powerhouse of Bronze and Silver knights.
Blackstone still retains, most of them. And now each of them becoming helpful.
"Another barrage," one merchant from Ashenford territory, sighed after seeing thousands of arrows released by Bronze knights, which gave them thousands kills among Ashenford armies.
While onlookers were discussing the heated battle among them, Aurora and Sorin had already exchanged many blows, which results both getting injured.
’This turtle.’ Sorin cursed Aurora. As cuts covered his entire body, and blood poured relentlessly from each wound. Yet despite his heavily injured Golden Knight body, he paid no attention to them.
Aurora had also suffered numerous cuts, but unlike Sorin’s, hers bled only slightly.
Her turtle-type body possessed exceptional defensive capabilities, greatly reducing the severity of her injuries.
And due to that, he have hit her many times, but the results, she trades injury with injury.
"Huff..." Aurora, breathing was little rough, due to the intense fight.
But Suddenly she paused ’huh?’ and her face changed slightly to worried, then return back to normal, as earlier action didn’t happen.
Though Sorin was an veteran early golden knight, easily able to notice this. Still he couldn’t able to find the reason of her changed expression.
’Master has left.’ Aurora thought as she steadied her breathing.
Though the very next moment, both she and Sorin abruptly turned their heads toward the Warwalker fortress,
...Or the fortress, which had Luke on it.
Soren and other four golden knights, Scar, Fang, Talon, and Rook. Look toward ongoing intense battle with calm gaze, then turn their eyes toward far battlefield.
The battlefield which belongs to Golden knights, where Aurora and Sorin was clashing and each of their attacks results in catastrophic damage.
’They are really early golden knight?’ this thought, immediately comes into Soren mind, after seeing those moves.

Because even he who was once an early golden knight, didn’t have this much strength. Still he shook his head to remove those unnecessary thoughts, and saw that both of them were injured and also had spent quite a bit of aether and stamina.

"This is a perfect moment, Sir." Beside, other golden knights also said this, on which he nodded and soon each of them fixed their masks, then clothes, before turning their gaze toward the Warwalker fortress, which was heavily guarded by 1,000 Bronze knights.
"Remember, kill the hero fast and escape!"
"And no unnecessary battle!"
"Remember, no unnecessary battle at all!."
Soren repeated his last words twice to ensure they heard properly, while giving each of them a deep glare, because he knows that some members, often don’t follow the commands.
Upon hearing this, all four of them nodded casually.
Then each of them uttered a word and the next moment they vanished...or at least that’s what any normal person would see.
"Ghost Step..."
Across the battlefield, the five Golden Knights moved at such astonishing speed that none of the knights present could follow their movements with the naked eye.
Their figures flickered like phantoms, appearing and disappearing across the battlefield.
Even the sounds of their footsteps were almost completely erased by Ghost Step, a C-rank Ascension Series, leaving behind nothing but faint ripples in the air.

Whenever a soldier or knight happened to stand in their path, they simply shifted their footing with uncanny precision, effortlessly sidestepping every obstacle without losing a fraction of their momentum.
To everyone else, it was as though five ghosts were gliding through the battlefield, impossible to catch and even harder to perceive.
So within moments, they reached the main fortress.
The location, where hero was present, without anyone noticing.
But now comes another problems, which was 10m tall fortress wall and the energy shield, on this they didn’t slow even a bit, instead raised their speed while bringing out their black daggers.

’Ghost Blade Strike.’ With one swift motion, the blade became invisible, and the next instant, a small hole appeared on the energy shield, which confused the surrounding Bronze archer knights, but the next moment it got filled by fortress energy, so they didn’t think about much and instead focused on the upcoming enemies.
The assassin Golden Knights didn’t slow down even after passing through the energy shield.

When the fortress wall rose before them, they neither leaped nor collided with it. Instead, they ran straight up the vertical wall and crossed over it as effortlessly as if they were walking on level ground.
After landing inside the fortress, they gave each other this command just by looking ’Find the target.’ and separated to check each corner for the hero.
After searching for a while, they couldn’t able to find Luke, which confused them, and they gave each other a look, which was clearly asking, ’Did you find him?’
On this, others made a slight shake. Seeing this, Soren gave each of them a look. ’Plan B.’
Though, he didn’t want to do that, but for completing their mission, this was necessary.
So next moment it happened.
BOOM!!!
The fortress wall exploded outward.
Reinforced steel plates and shattered debris were hurled in every direction as four Early Golden Knight auras erupted without the slightest restraint.
"Ughhh!!"
Agonized cries echoed through the fortress.
The explosion claimed the lives of several Bronze Knight archers on the spot, while many more were thrown backward, suffering grievous injuries from the shockwave and flying debris.
"Enemies!"
The warning rang out across the fortress.
Nearby knights immediately became alert, unsheathing their weapons and rushing toward the breached wall.

Meanwhile, the surviving Bronze Knight archers quickly retreated to safer positions. Even as they withdrew, many refused to abandon their comrades, carrying the wounded to the rear while others covered their retreat with arrows.
Amidst the billowing smoke and dust, four figures slowly emerged from the shattered breach.
"This!!!"
The onlookers who were enjoying the show, with snacks in their hands, got baffled by the sudden turn of events.
’huh?? does this was also on the script??’ and this thought, came into everyone’s mind.

Nyra, who had been delighted to see the Blackstone Legions gaining the upper hand and worried while watching Aurora battle Sorin, was completely stunned by the sudden appearance of four Golden Knights.
And she was not alone on this, because even other noble descendants, merchants, and strong adventurers, also had the same expression.
"Sis." So Nyra worriedly turned toward Octavia, pleading for help, hoping that she would intervene.
Because the place they had attacked belonged to Luke’s location, which worried her alot.
But Octavia shook her head and said, "I can’t involve myself with this, Nyra. And regarding Luke, If his life is in danger, then I would save him, don’t worry."
Hearing Octavia’s words, didn’t lessen Nyra’s worries at all, so she pleaded again.
On this, Octavia sighed and told her. "Nyra, if you are being worried about Luke, then don’t be."
Upon hearing this, Nyra gave her a speechless look, but before she could say anything, Octavia added another sentence.

"Because it seems he had already anticipated the possibility of a third-party intervention. That’s why he chose to leave the fortress. Otherwise, the attackers wouldn’t have singled him out while attacking everyone else inside."
At this, Nyra felt she was right, and her worry lessened a bit, then a thought came into her mind. ’Sir Luke where are you?’
Sadly, Luke couldn’t hear Nyra’s thoughts, because at this time, he was busy throwing huge moons at a mad giant bear.

So thanks everyone!!!

"ATTACK!!!"
"KILL THEM!!!"
"DEFEND!!!"
The war cries of thousands of soldiers and knights echoed relentlessly across the battlefield, blending with the constant clash of steel.
CLANG!
SLASH!
BOOM!
Every collision was followed by bloodshed...
Or worse.
Death.
At the front lines, the knights of both armies fought a fierce and brutal battle, neither side willing to yield an inch of ground.
Meanwhile, the Ashenford archers and Aether Cannons maintained a relentless barrage, repeatedly targeting the towering iron fortresses.
Yet the results were far from satisfactory.
Most of the incoming attacks were absorbed by the fortresses deployed defensive shields.
Any strike that managed to penetrate the barrier was met by layers of reinforced, enchanted steel, which endured the impacts with little more than a shower of sparks.
CLANG!
CLINK!
KLANG!
"Keep the formation!"
Osric’s commanding voice rang across the battlefield.
Under his orders, the Blackstone Legions advanced with disciplined precision, using the fortresses as moving cover.
They struck at the enemy from behind the protective walls while exposing themselves to only a handful of counterattacks.
With every passing minute, the advantage gradually shifted toward Blackstone, as the iron fortresses continued to dominate the battlefield like unbreakable walls of steel.
The onlookers became surprised after seeing this, and some people even got amazed.
"The blackstone strategy sure working good."
One noble descendant commented, on which other nodded, because while Ashenford have lost many high-level powerhouse of Bronze and Silver knights.
Blackstone still retains, most of them.
And now each of them becoming helpful.

’This turtle.’ Sorin cursed Aurora.

Her turtle-type body possessed exceptional defensive capabilities, greatly reducing the severity of her injuries.

Soren and other four golden knights, Scar, Fang, Talon, and Rook.
Look toward ongoing intense battle with calm gaze, then turn their eyes toward far battlefield.

"And no unnecessary battle!"
"Remember, no unnecessary battle at all!."

Their figures flickered like phantoms, appearing and disappearing across the battlefield.

To everyone else, it was as though five ghosts were gliding through the battlefield, impossible to catch and even harder to perceive.

The location, where hero was present, without anyone noticing.

Though, he didn’t want to do that, but for completing their mission, this was necessary.

BOOM!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Judgment State — A silver sword against an inferno
paragraphs: Seeing the destruction and massacre inside the fortress, Aurora’s face changed to worry, because master had told her to protect everyone and now the knights were dying right in front of her eyes.
’I have to use my full power.’ so she decided with urgency and immediately used her ultimate ability.
’A-rank Origin Skill: Argent Covenant Authority.’
"Ultimate form: Judgment State"
Her voice came a little low, and next moment hundreds of silver chains appeared around her body, which were connected to many people present on the battlefield.

But next instant all of them instantly became transparent as all the oaths she had formed with everyone, temporarily suspended, and her hair also changed to golden color, while a silver judgement seal appeared above her silver sword.
Sorin, noticed Aurora’s transformation and immediately got wary, but seeing her attention wasn’t on him, but on the fortress, which had Luke.
He got relaxed and felt a chance. ’I can take her down now.’ So with that he also used his ultimate ability.
’B-rank Origin Skill: Inferno Forge.’
"Ultimate ability"
Aurora’s whole focus was on the fortress, so when Sorin muttered those words in a low voice, she didn’t hear anything at all. And Sorin took the benefit of this.
He took a single step forward.
Sizzle...
The ground beneath his foot instantly melted, turning into glowing molten rock under the unbearable heat radiating from his body.
Slowly, he raised both hands.
At the same time, an enormous amount of Aether converged toward his chest.
The armor covering his torso rapidly heated until it glowed a brilliant crimson, while waves of scorching heat distorted the surrounding air.
Hiss...
Thick steam rose continuously from his entire body, as though he had become a living volcano ready to erupt.
"Inferno Cannon."
The instant those words left his mouth—
BOOOOOOOM!!!
A colossal beam of molten fire erupted from his chest.
Nearly five meters wide, the blazing torrent roared across the battlefield like an erupting volcano unleashed in a single direction.
The intense heat melted the earth beneath its path, leaving behind a trail of glowing magma and scorched terrain.
In the blink of an eye, the devastating beam crossed the hundred-meter distance separating them, charging straight toward Aurora with only one purpose...
To erase her existence.
The sudden surge of scorching heat didn’t go unnoticed.
Onlookers across the battlefield instinctively turned toward the source of the terrifying aura.
"Whoa... he finally used it!
Many exclaimed in astonishment, as they immediately recognized the attack.
It was Sorin’s ultimate ability—a technique renowned for possessing enough destructive power to severely wound even an Early Mid-Golden Knight.
"She’s finished."
"There’s no way she can survive that."
So almost everyone reached the same conclusion. In their eyes, Aurora’s death was already inevitable.
They silently waited for the blazing beam to consume her.
Aurora, whose whole focus was on the fortress, suddenly felt a sense of danger from her side.
At that she immediately turned her head.
’This...!’ Her silver eyes widened.
A gigantic beam of molten fire was already tearing across the battlefield, rushing straight toward her from Sorin’s position.
In a hurry, she thought about dodging, but instantly realized...
She couldn’t dodge.
Because directly behind her stood the Warwalker Fortresses.
If she stepped aside, the devastating beam would strike them instead.
Countless soldiers inside would perish.
So there was only one option.
At that Aurora tightened her grip on her silver sword.
Slowly...
She raised it above her head.
The sight left everyone speechless.
"Is... is she trying to block it?!"
To everyone watching, it looked utterly absurd.
Trying to stop a five-meter-wide inferno with nothing but a single sword, without even using any skills?
It was madness.
What they didn’t know was that Aurora’s Judgment greatly enhanced all of her physical attributes.
At its peak, it elevated her raw combat power to the level of a Peak Early Golden Knight.
"Haaah!!"
So with a powerful shout, Aurora swung her sword downward.
SHHHHHK!!
A dazzling silver slash collided head-on with the Inferno Cannon.
For a heartbeat...
Time itself seemed to stop.
Then...
BOOOOOOOM!!!
The impossible happened.
The massive beam split cleanly down the center.
The molten torrent parted into two streams, rushing harmlessly past Aurora on both sides before exploding into the distance.
Without slowing her advance, Aurora continued charging forward, her sword still raised.
"What?!"
Sorin’s eyes widened in utter disbelief.
He had never imagined someone could cut through his ultimate technique.
Refusing to accept it, he poured even more Aether into the Inferno Cannon.
The beam swelled in intensity, its flames burning hotter than before as he desperately tried to force Aurora backward.
This time...
Her advance finally slowed.
Yet despite the overwhelming torrent of molten fire crashing against her blade...
She still didn’t retreat a single step.
Instead, she increased her speed, her form blurring into a silver streak. A sharp SHING! cut through the air as her sword traced two perfect, humming arcs.
In one breath, the blade cut deep. It crunched through bone and sinew, severing both hands.
As they flew apart, spraying blood. But before the blood even hit the ground, she swung again and slashed his chest, which results a huge cut burned through his armor and flesh.

"U-Ugh!" A choked, gurgling cry, half-scream and half-grunt, was ripped from Sorin’s throat as the shockwave of pain hit him. The metallic scent of his own blood flooded his senses. His eyes, wide with agony, locked onto Aurora with a hatred so pure it was almost tangible, while his vision swam in a haze of red.
THUD! then his body hit the ground with a thud impact. And his severed hands landed with softer motion on the dirt ground.

Aurora, already in motion, didn’t even spare him a glance. The spray of his blood hadn’t even finished splattering against the dirt floor before she was gone, a tempest of fury hurling herself toward the four golden knights.
A collective sharp gasp swept through the stunned onlookers, followed by a wave of frantic whispers.
"Did you see that?" one muttered, his voice trembling. "I never thought... I never thought Sorin’s ultimate ability would fail. That attack had never failed to kill an Early Golden Knight before."
Another spectator stood pale-faced, staring at the blood pooling on the ground as he slowly shook his head in disbelief.
The battlefield fell into an eerie silence, broken only by the crisp footsteps of Aurora as she advanced.
"Yeah." Another one nodded, and everyone’s minds followed the same thoughts, ’The baron Luke sure contains some insane knights among his legions.’
Sophia smiled seeing this and turned to her brother, "Brother, I have told you, that Sir Luke’s golden knight is very strong."
Damien, who was also stunned after seeing Aurora move, came out of his thoughts after hearing Sophia’s words, and with a shocking face, he nodded.
Then looked toward Aurora, who was now going to face four early golden knights.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Her Master’s Gift — When a ring becomes a fortress
paragraphs: BOOM!
Another explosion came from inside the fortress, as those golden knights kept attacking and killing everyone in the vicinity.
Even though Osric was commanding archers to shoot at them, but with their bronze knight realm power, they couldn’t able to damage their body at all.
’Why is he not coming out??’ Soren looked toward the ongoing destruction and thought worriedly.
Then at this moment, the golden knights, the ashenford armies, the blackstone legions felt the tremor coming from the other golden knight battlefield, at which even they paused and turned to look.
’What the hell!’ All four early golden knights, got freaked out after seeing the massive beam and even more, when Aurora cut it down that easily.
Because they could clearly sense that if the beam had struck them, none of them would have survived.
And now, the very person who had effortlessly suppressed that devastating attack was charging toward them.
Soren also saw the situation and shook his head, because the hero didn’t come out, instead came the other monster from his legion.
And seeing the expressions on his four member faces, he realized that he had no choice but to enter the battlefield himself now.
Otherwise, they would lose their nerve and flee.
’I hope that seeing her on the verge of death, the Hero will finally come out.’ With that thought, Sorin released the full aura of a Mid-Golden Knight.

Aurora, who had been charging straight toward them, abruptly came to a halt. Her expression changed the instant she felt the overwhelming pressure, and the same reaction spread across everyone present on the battlefield.

The reason was simple. Early Golden Knights were still considered acceptable combatants in large-scale wars. However, those above that level rarely entered battles involving lower realms, as the difference in strength between a Mid-Golden Knight and a newly advanced Golden Knight was simply too vast.
Even Ocatvia got surprised by the sudden appearance of mid-golden, because all the time even she didn’t feel his presence at all, which now worried her.

’Who is this third party? which has even sent a mid-golden knight?’ While Ocatvia was thinking this, Nyra gave her a worried look, but Octavia didn’t respond to this, because if that knight attacked them, then she had to protect Nyra first.
After the earlier abrupt halt, Aurora resumed her charge.
But the moment she approached the fortress, all four Early Golden Knights moved simultaneously.
Seeing that Soren was on his way to rejoin them, they immediately launched a coordinated assault.
"Phantom Barrage!"
The four shouted in unison.
The next instant, they surrounded Aurora from all directions, unleashing a relentless storm of rapid dagger strikes.
SHING! SHING! SHING! SHING!
Their daggers flashed like streaks of silver, each movement leaving behind ghostly afterimages that made it nearly impossible to distinguish the real attack from the fake one.
CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
Aurora swung her silver sword again and again, barely managing to keep up with the overwhelming barrage.
Despite the tremendous boost to her physical abilities, she could only deflect roughly half of the incoming strikes.
The remaining attacks slipped past her defense.
Slash!
Slash!
Slash!
One cut after another appeared across her body.
Blood gradually stained her silver armor as the wounds continued to increase with every passing second.
She attempted to counterattack several times, her sword carrying enough power to seriously wound any one of them.
However, the four assassins specialized in speed.
The instant Aurora’s blade descended, they had already vanished, leaving behind only fading afterimages.
Most of her attacks struck nothing but illusions.
Meanwhile, the real attackers continued circling around her like hungry wolves, waiting for the smallest opening before launching another relentless wave of dagger strikes.
’I have to defeat them quickly.’
Aurora thought as she noticed Soren rapidly closing the distance.
The Mid-Golden Knight had finally arrived.
The next instant, he attacked.
"Ghost Blade Strike."
Black Aether enveloped Soren’s dagger, making the blade nearly invisible against the surroundings.
With that, his figure disappeared.
Then...
He appeared directly behind Aurora. Along with comes the strike, which was swift.
And silent.
Almost impossible to evade.
Because by the time an opponent noticed the dagger...
It had already pierced their body.
The invisible blade shot toward Aurora’s back with terrifying precision.
Or at least...
That was what was supposed to happen.
Whoom!
When a brilliant golden spherical barrier suddenly materialized around Aurora.
CLANG!!
The invisible dagger slammed into the barrier instead, producing a deafening metallic clang that echoed across the battlefield.
"What?!"
Everyone’s expressions changed in an instant.
"A high-level protective artifact!"
Many exclaimed in disbelief.
A defensive barrier capable of stopping a Mid-Golden Knight’s technique was something they had rarely, if ever, witnessed.
Unlike the stunned onlookers, Soren’s expression immediately darkened.
The same was true for the other four Early Golden Knights.
However, none of them hesitated.
"Keep attacking!"
They launched another relentless barrage.
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
Five Golden Knights continuously struck the golden barrier from every direction.
Daggers flashed.
Black Aether erupted.
Shockwaves rippled across the battlefield.
Their only objective was simple—
Destroy the barrier before Aurora could make her next move.
Aurora finally gained a brief moment to breathe, protected by the "Queen’s Ward Ring" her Master had given her.
The golden barrier isolated her from the relentless barrage, buying her a few precious seconds.
But instead of feeling relieved, her expression grew increasingly solemn.
’This barrier won’t hold much longer.’
She could clearly feel the enormous strain on the artifact as five Golden Knights continuously assaulted it from every direction.
Without wasting the opportunity, Aurora immediately launched her own counterattacks.
The Queen’s Ward protected its user from outside attacks but didn’t hinder attacks launched from within.
SHIIING!
Her silver sword flashed toward the nearest golden knight.
’Damn it!’
Seeing the incoming strike, the four Early Golden Knights immediately retreated using their Ghost Step, while Sorin intercepted the slash himself.
CLANG!
His black dagger collided with Aurora’s silver sword.
The tremendous force transmitted through the blade made Sorin’s entire arm tremble, and a sharp pain shot through his hand.
His expression changed slightly.
’Her strength...’
’It’s almost at the Mid-Golden Knight level.’
Even with his superior realm, receiving her attacks head-on was far from comfortable.
CRACK!
A crisp sound suddenly echoed.
Tiny cracks began spreading across the surface of the golden barrier.
Seeing this, Soren and the four assassins revealed excited smiles.
"It won’t last much longer!"

Soren also saw the situation and shook his head, because the hero didn’t come out, instead came the other monster from his legion.
And seeing the expressions on his four member faces, he realized that he had no choice but to enter the battlefield himself now.
Otherwise, they would lose their nerve and flee.
’I hope that seeing her on the verge of death, the Hero will finally come out.’ With that thought, Sorin released the full aura of a Mid-Golden Knight.
Aurora, who had been charging straight toward them, abruptly came to a halt.
Her expression changed the instant she felt the overwhelming pressure, and the same reaction spread across everyone present on the battlefield.
The reason was simple.
Early Golden Knights were still considered acceptable combatants in large-scale wars.
However, those above that level rarely entered battles involving lower realms, as the difference in strength between a Mid-Golden Knight and a newly advanced Golden Knight was simply too vast.
Even Ocatvia got surprised by the sudden appearance of mid-golden, because all the time even she didn’t feel his presence at all, which now worried her.

’Who is this third party? which has even sent a mid-golden knight?’ While Ocatvia was thinking this, Nyra gave her a worried look, but Octavia didn’t respond to this, because if that knight attacked them, then she had to protect Nyra first.
After the earlier abrupt halt, Aurora resumed her charge.
But the moment she approached the fortress, all four Early Golden Knights moved simultaneously.
Seeing that Soren was on his way to rejoin them, they immediately launched a coordinated assault.
"Phantom Barrage!"
The four shouted in unison.
The next instant, they surrounded Aurora from all directions, unleashing a relentless storm of rapid dagger strikes.
SHING!
SHING!
SHING!
SHING!
Their daggers flashed like streaks of silver, each movement leaving behind ghostly afterimages that made it nearly impossible to distinguish the real attack from the fake one.
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
Aurora swung her silver sword again and again, barely managing to keep up with the overwhelming barrage.
Despite the tremendous boost to her physical abilities, she could only deflect roughly half of the incoming strikes.
The remaining attacks slipped past her defense.
Slash!
Slash!
Slash!
One cut after another appeared across her body.
Blood gradually stained her silver armor as the wounds continued to increase with every passing second.
She attempted to counterattack several times, her sword carrying enough power to seriously wound any one of them.
However, the four assassins specialized in speed.
The instant Aurora’s blade descended, they had already vanished, leaving behind only fading afterimages.
Most of her attacks struck nothing but illusions.
Meanwhile, the real attackers continued circling around her like hungry wolves, waiting for the smallest opening before launching another relentless wave of dagger strikes.
’I have to defeat them quickly.’
Aurora thought as she noticed Soren rapidly closing the distance.
The Mid-Golden Knight had finally arrived.
The next instant, he attacked.
"Ghost Blade Strike."
Black Aether enveloped Soren’s dagger, making the blade nearly invisible against the surroundings.
With that, his figure disappeared.
Then...
He appeared directly behind Aurora.
Along with comes the strike, which was swift.
And silent.
Almost impossible to evade.
Because by the time an opponent noticed the dagger...
It had already pierced their body.
The invisible blade shot toward Aurora’s back with terrifying precision.
Or at least...
That was what was supposed to happen.
Whoom!
When a brilliant golden spherical barrier suddenly materialized around Aurora.
CLANG!!
The invisible dagger slammed into the barrier instead, producing a deafening metallic clang that echoed across the battlefield.
"What?!"
Everyone’s expressions changed in an instant.
"A high-level protective artifact!"
Many exclaimed in disbelief.
A defensive barrier capable of stopping a Mid-Golden Knight’s technique was something they had rarely, if ever, witnessed.
Unlike the stunned onlookers, Soren’s expression immediately darkened.
The same was true for the other four Early Golden Knights.
However, none of them hesitated.
"Keep attacking!"
They launched another relentless barrage.
CLANG!
CLANG!
CLANG!
Five Golden Knights continuously struck the golden barrier from every direction.
Daggers flashed.
Black Aether erupted.
Shockwaves rippled across the battlefield.
Their only objective was simple—
Destroy the barrier before Aurora could make her next move.
Aurora finally gained a brief moment to breathe, protected by the "Queen’s Ward Ring" her Master had given her.
The golden barrier isolated her from the relentless barrage, buying her a few precious seconds.
But instead of feeling relieved, her expression grew increasingly solemn.
’This barrier won’t hold much longer.’
She could clearly feel the enormous strain on the artifact as five Golden Knights continuously assaulted it from every direction.
Without wasting the opportunity, Aurora immediately launched her own counterattacks.
The Queen’s Ward protected its user from outside attacks but didn’t hinder attacks launched from within.
SHIIING!
Her silver sword flashed toward the nearest golden knight.
’Damn it!’
Seeing the incoming strike, the four Early Golden Knights immediately retreated using their Ghost Step, while Sorin intercepted the slash himself.
CLANG!
His black dagger collided with Aurora’s silver sword.
The tremendous force transmitted through the blade made Sorin’s entire arm tremble, and a sharp pain shot through his hand.
His expression changed slightly.
’Her strength...’
’It’s almost at the Mid-Golden Knight level.’
Even with his superior realm, receiving her attacks head-on was far from comfortable.
CRACK!
A crisp sound suddenly echoed.
Tiny cracks began spreading across the surface of the golden barrier.
Seeing this, Soren and the four assassins revealed excited smiles.
"It won’t last much longer!"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Master Will Be Very Angry
paragraphs: Their attacks became even more frantic.
Meanwhile, Aurora’s expression turned increasingly grim.
Until now...
she hadn’t managed to kill even a single Golden Knight.
At most, she had severed one of the golden knight’s hands.

And after witnessing the golden knight’s fate, the remaining Golden Knights had become far more cautious, refusing to confront her head-on and constantly relying on speed and afterimages to avoid her lethal sword.
The longer the battle dragged on...
The worse her situation became.

While they were constantly attacking Aurora, the surrounding archers fired at them continuously, but they ignored their attacks completely. Even the warwalker fortress cannons or ballista attacks couldn’t work on the golden knights.

As the blackstone legions kept attacking the golden knights, the Ashenford armies didn’t let them do what they pleased, and kept trying to stop them, because the person seemed to be an enemy of the Blackstone Highlands, which made them friends of the Ashenford armies.
Even though Sorin Ironclad, their commander, was down and unconscious, they still didn’t back down, and after seeing external help, they increased their attacks even more.
Aurielle and Vaelira also sensed the presence of the Golden Knights at the center battlefield, and both of them grew worried.
Fortunately, they had already defeated Alastair Ashenford, who now lay unconscious on the ground.
Moreover, neither of them had suffered any casualties or serious injuries.
Then both of them, along with all the peak tide keeper Marinthians, immediately moved toward the golden knights.
Aurora’s Queen’s Ward wasn’t faring well.
Countless cracks had already spread across the golden barrier, making it seem as though it would shatter at any moment.
Seeing this, Soren immediately seized the opportunity.
"Ghost Blade Strike."
The moment those words left his mouth, black Aether enveloped his dagger, rendering the blade nearly invisible once again.
He disappeared.
Then—
SHATTER!!
The already weakened Queen’s Ward could no longer withstand the assault.
The golden barrier exploded into countless fragments of light, scattering across the battlefield.
But the attack didn’t stop there. It tore straight through the broken barrier and slammed into Aurora’s waist, carving a deep, piercing wound into her side.
Aurora let out a pained groan as a sharp pain spread through her waist.
Warm blood quickly stained her silver armor.
Even her enhanced physical defenses had been breached.
The wound was far deeper than she had expected.
Seeing her injured, the surrounding Golden Knights immediately intensified their assault.
SHING! SHING! SHING!
Their daggers rained down from every direction, forcing Aurora completely onto the defensive.
Every passing moment added another cut to her body, leaving her with less and less room to breathe.
’I need to do—’ Just as Aurora was about to think of a countermeasure, a black arrow silently appeared beside one of the Golden Knights and pierced straight through his eye.
"UGGGH!"
His years of enduring brutal torture proved useless this time, as a pained cry escaped his lips.
’What?!’
The remaining three assassins, along with Soren, were completely startled.
None of them had been able to see the incoming arrow, and that realization sent a chill of dread through their hearts.
’A golden knight?’ And this thought came into each of their minds, which was totally wrong.
When Vaelira and Aurielle were coming with fast speed, Vaelira already saw the situation was bad and fired an eclipse arrow to interrupt or even kill one enemy.
Though the enemy didn’t die because of his golden knight body, all of their attacks did stop on Aurora for a moment, which gave her enough time to breathe.
’Shadow Blade.’ Then Aurielle from the side threw her attacks at each of them all, which they easily deflected.

Even though her armour was giving her a huge aether and stats buff, sadly it was close to half-golden knight, and if she wanted to use early golden knight attacks, then for that she would have to charge her attacks with a huge amount of Aether, which would take too much time.
"Aurora, move back!" Aurielle shouted and immediately used her shadow step to come beside her.

Seeing this, Vaelira got worried. Even though Aurielle had the queen’s ward and her queen regalia armour, if all the golden knights attacked her, then she would not be able to sustain for long, which Aurora could do even with her injured body.
This thought was also shared by Aurora, so she didn’t move; instead, she used her Aegis barrier to cover herself and Aurielle in a spherical shield.
Seeing that Aurora hadn’t moved, Aurielle let out a quiet sigh. Even so, she activated her skill to blind the enemies.
"Night Dominion."
The next instant a sphere of darkness rapidly expanded outward, engulfing everything within a 200-meter radius.
The sudden descent of darkness caught the enemies off guard, startling them for a brief moment.
So they used their golden knight aura to remove it, but couldn’t do so.

’What the hell is this?’ Soren and the others became confused, because inside this field he couldn’t feel the aura of others and his senses were also suppressed to the extreme, which made him a little wary of this darkness.
’A high rank Origin Skill.’ This thought came into his mind, because even after a few moments later, he couldn’t find the locations of any beings, at which he sighed with annoyance.
Because other than the hero, every other important member had come, which annoyed him even more.
’Is he even here at all?’ So a small doubt started forming in his mind.
But after a moment he stopped those thoughts and thought about his new plan, because they couldn’t harm the princess of the Human Emperor, even though she was exiled.

’What should we do?’ This same question was repeating in each of their minds, and this gave enough time for Aurora and Aurielle to back away from the night dominion field, while those enemies were still stuck there, or chose to be, as they were thinking about their next move.
The onlookers, the Ashenford armies, even Osric, thought another big fight was about to happen, but suddenly everything became quiet when the Night Dominion spell was released.
Even the ongoing battle between soldiers stopped, as they turned to look toward the dark sphere, waiting for the result.
"Aurielle, you should go back," Aurora said.
In response, Aurielle simply shook her head.
Seeing this, Aurora spoke again.
"Don’t be stubborn. If something happens to you... Master will be very angry."
She paused for a brief moment before adding in a much quieter voice,
"...and sad also."

chapters.title: Chapter 141: The Arrival of the Cosmic Titan
paragraphs: Because she knew that she couldn’t face that mid-golden knight. So she would probably die here, which brought a thought to her mind.
’Will Master be sad... if I die here?’ This thought made Aurora’s expression turn slightly gloomy.
Not because she feared death.
But because, if she died here, she might never get able to see her master again...
...or enjoy the delicious food the maids always fed her.
The more she thought about it, the sadder her expression became, and Aurielle noticed every change.
’Idiot.’ Aurielle sighed inwardly.
She knew Luke well enough to know the answer.
And he would definitely not be happy after finding that something happened to Aurora.
Hell, she could already imagine Luke’s face if he heard that Aurora got injured, because he really cares about his close ones.
From a distance, Vaelira watched the entire exchange.
She simply shook her head at their behavior before thinking,
’If Master were here... everything would be fine.’
The same thought was shared by Aurora and Aurielle as well.
For Aurora, because Luke was her master, she believed him blindly, while Aurielle had already become more and more dependent on Luke after their first night, which she didn’t know why.
Though, if the system was here, he would definitely comment, [What a womanizer.]
And then it happened.
It was as if the heavens themselves had heard their prayers.
A deep, authoritative voice, carrying a faint hint of annoyance, descended from above and echoed across the entire battlefield.
"Many rats have entered my territory."
At those words, everyone instinctively craned their necks upward.
The next instant, they froze.
"O_O"
Every mouth fell wide open in utter shock.
High above the battlefield floated a fourteen-foot-tall man with long golden hair woven with shimmering starlight.
Above him revolved colossal celestial bodies—planets, moons, and asteroids—each radiating a different elemental attribute.
His starlit eyes gazed down upon everyone below...
Yes, gazed down.
Because at that moment, every being present instinctively felt that they were unworthy of meeting the eyes of someone who seemed almost beyond this world.
The moment Luke appeared, calm washed over the three women, and bright smiles spread across their faces.
"Luke!"
"Master!!"
"MY LORD!!!"

So the next moment, everyone present heard their happy voices from Aurielle, Aurora, Vaelira, and from the Blackstone legions, which clearly told that the giant who had just appeared was another form of Baron Luke, the Hero.
’THIS!!!’ At this, their thought process stopped for a second. ’Another giant form?’ which made each of them confused by the number of giant forms Baron Luke contained.
And this form was even way cooler and more awesome than the previous one.
Seeing Luke, Nyra’s and Sophia’s eyes were shined with happy expressions, while Octavia narrowed hers, because she felt a threat...
A high-level threat, which meant that Luke, an early bronze knight, had the strength to kill her.
Which was absurd and beyond her understanding, because only chosen ones or he... hero??
Suddenly her eyes became completely wide, and she looked again at the giant Luke, because Luke was a hero. ’But had he not been declared talentless?’
’Then how? How could he have that much strength, which only a real hero could contain.’
Her mind went blank for a moment, and she felt all of this was a conspiracy...
A Conspiracy from the Church of Holy Light, conspiracy from the Saintess herself.

’So we have been lied to all these times.’ The more she thought, the more absurd the whole situation became, so she shook her head and stopped thinking about all those, while turning to look at Nyra, who was innocently looking at Luke with a happy expression.
Without knowing that they had been made fools. And this same thought was shared by many noble descendants, merchants, and adventurers.
Meanwhile-
When Luke appeared, Aurielle lost control over her Night Dominion skill, which freed Soren and the other golden knights.

So the moment Soren saw Luke high above in the sky, he exclaimed in his mind, ’I knew it.’ Soren thought excitedly, because earlier he felt something was wrong with Luke and now this proved that Hero Luke was not talentless and all of the world was deceived by the Saintess and the Holy Church.
’...wait’
Then isn’t this bad news for him and the others??
Because right now... even he, a Mid-Golden Knight, could sense a fatal threat from the giant Luke.
It was absurd.
Yet there was no denying it.
’So doesn’t this mean we are fu**ed up!’ Soren’s eyes became completely wide, and he looked at Luke’s star-filled eyes, which were clearly looking at them with contained fury.
’Yeah... we are fu**ed up.’ His face became completely ugly, and the same thoughts were running in the other golden knights’ minds.
Earlier, when Luke got Kai’s message, he teleported inside the territory and entered the time chamber, rather than going to help Aurielle and the others.
Because he knew, that for fighting against a mid-golden knight, he needed his Cosmic Heart titan form, and for that he had to heal, which he did by entering the Healing Spring.
Fortunately, the time chamber had a 30x setting, which resulted in his hours of healing inside turning into a few minutes outside.
So after that he immediately appeared on the battlefield and saw Aurielle using her Night Dominion skill.
’Seems like I can’t hide the third titan form anymore.’ Luke sighed with a little annoyed expression, because this meant his strongest trump card would be exposed.
But then his gaze turned toward Aurora’s body, to her waist exactly, which clearly had a deep dagger wound, from which her red blood was still coming.
Even though she was smiling at him, he knew she must be in pain.
Thinking this, Luke’s expression turned ice-cold.
And he swept his gaze across the battlefield, where he saw the bodies of many of his fallen knights, making his anger burn even fiercer.
So with a cold face he turned toward Soren, whose face had become ugly, like just now he had fu**ed up.
’No one lives after harming my people.’
Luke narrowed his eyes and unleashed the immense gravitational force contained within his Cosmic System upon everyone on the battlefield...
Everyone except his own people.
"WHAT?!!"
The moment the overwhelming gravitational force spread across a one-kilometer radius, everyone’s faces turned deathly pale.
In the very next instant, they were slammed to the ground, pinned beneath the crushing pressure without the slightest chance of moving.
Only the Blackstone Legions, Octavia, Naira, Sophia, and those who were close to Luke and he knew them, remained unaffected.
Everyone else was forced to endure the terrifying gravity.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: That’s Our Master
paragraphs: Then again came Luke’s loud voice, but the words stunned each of them.
"*The Hidden Hand* assassination organization got so bold, that now you are even attacking me openly, after your previous failure attempt!"
’What!!!’
Hearing this, everyone’s face completely changed, and each of them turned to look toward the five golden knights, whose faces had become pale.

Because Luke had concentrated all the force of gravity on them, which was why the four golden knights couldn’t even stand up, while the mid-golden knight, even though standing, his eyes became completely wide after hearing Luke’s claims.
Upon this, they confirmed what Luke was telling was the truth, which baffled everyone.
Because attacking the Hero, who had the Holy Church backing, even though the hero was talentless, it was still insane.
As the entire assassination organization could face annihilation.
And that was even more true now.
Because Luke was never talentless.
If anything...
It all seemed to be part of a conspiracy orchestrated by the Holy Church itself.
That was also the reason Soren’s face turned completely pale.
Now, their entire organization would have to face the Holy Knights.
’We’re really f**ked this time.’ And that single thought kept repeating in his mind.
Luke saw everyone’s reaction and inside smiled with satisfaction.
Because, The Hidden Hand organization kept sending assassins one by one after him, and each time they were also becoming stronger.
Sadly he was not strong enough now and couldn’t deal with the organization himself, so he used the help of his title, by openly mentioning their name.
Meaning, even if the Holy Church didn’t attack them, this alone would be enough to fill them with fear.
Though Luke didn’t know, because of this action, the whole organization would be going to be annihilated.
So after a few moments later, he added something more, which would give his actions even more credibility.
"And the Ashenford Family will also bear my wrath for colluding with the Hidden Hand in multiple attempts to assassinate me!"

These words brought another shock to everyone, even Octavia narrowed her eyes. Because a noble couldn’t attack other nobles, even what they were doing now, which was based on some earlier allegation on Luke.
But attacking Baron Luke earlier was considered a bigger crime. And this same thought was also shared by many people.
On this, the faces of the Ashenford armies became ugly, as they didn’t know anything about the truth, because all of this was done by their Lord.
Still, it seemed that now they were going to face the wrath of Baron Luke for their master’s actions.
Sorin Ironclad, who was unconscious before due to heavy bleeding, also opened his eyes when the sudden gravity came upon him.
So he heard everything clearly from start to the end, but the last words spoken by Luke became the nightmare even for him.
’I am doomed.’ He closed his eyes with a resigned expression, because he knew.
Now Baron Luke had the full right to kill each of them, if those allegations proved right, which seemed to be right.
With that he turned toward Soren and others, because their sudden involvement seemed way too suspicious.
’I hope... Aldaric you will not get a death sentence.’ So with a tired expression, he closed his eyes and awaited for the final decision.
From above, Luke, who was floating with the gravitational force of Celestial bodies, observed everything, even the expression of Sorin Ironclad.
Because the moment Luke manifested his Cosmic System, he became the absolute ruler within its area.

At that moment, everything within the one-kilometer-diameter sphere was under his control. Nothing could escape his perception, and he could even use his armor’s construction ability anywhere within that range.
So he raised one hand high, at this the Ashenford armies and the golden knights faces turned to horror.
Though the onlookers didn’t feel the same fear as them, still even they felt goosebumps upon seeing this.
Because with a single motion of Luke’s hand, ten celestial moons materialized in the sky.
Each one measured fifty meters in diameter and revolved above the battlefield.
Every moon embodied a different element—fire, ice, metal, lightning, and earth, etc..
’How is he controlling all of them?’ Their expressions changed drastically.
Most of them had never witnessed a Peak Golden Knight battle in their lives.
That was why Luke’s overwhelming display of power felt completely unreal...
As if it belonged to a being beyond this world.
Which was even more absurd with his early bronze knight cultivation.
Meanwhile-
Aurora and Vaelira looked at Luke with fervent eyes while a large smile formed on both of their faces, and only one thought came into their minds.
’That’s our master.’
’The strongest!’
The same was happening with every Blackstone Legion member, who looked toward their lord with fervent eyes, and a few even started beating their chest armor loudly.
CLANG! CLANG!
Which was followed by even more, and soon every single knight of Blackstone Highlands were beating their chest armor loudly.
CLANG!... CLANG!... CLANG!... CLANG!.. CLANG!.CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
Osric’s eyes became moist seeing this, and the memory of the past war came into his mind, where enemies almost entered their home.
But at the cost of many lives, they were finally able to repel them at that time.
"Now we don’t need to sacrifice our lives meaninglessly anymore." With a smile, he looked high into the sky toward Luke.
"Because now... we have a truly powerful lord."
Aurielle was also happy seeing Luke had become so stronger that now even golden knights had to fear him.
Thinking this her face became a little sad.
Because Luke was becoming strong so fast.
that she was worried...
Worried, that one day maybe he would leave her for his other wives.
Since she knew that among them all wives, she was the weakest.
’If I were stronger...’ thinking this, Aurielle’s eyes became a little purple without her knowing, but this time, the color didn’t fade.
As it always happened in the beginning.
Luke was focusing on controlling celestial bodies, so he didn’t notice Aurielle’s expression.
If he knew that, then he would just kiss her and lock themselves, until she lost this stupid thought.
"Now die." Luke spoke calmly as he lowered his hand.
The next instant, all ten rotating moons shot forward.
WHOOOOOSH!
Like meteors, the massive bodies descended toward the Golden Knights with terrifying speed.
’Death!’

chapters.title: Chapter 143: The Annoyed Wife
paragraphs: That single word flashed through the minds of the four Early Golden Knights as they looked up at the approaching moons.
Even the Mid-Golden Knight’s expression became frantic.
His eyes turned bloodshot.
’I am not going to die here!’
With a desperate roar, he forcefully overclocked the Aether within his body.
Veins bulged across his muscles as he broke free from the overwhelming gravitational restraint.
Without wasting a single moment, he threw himself to the side.
BOOOOOOOM!!!
The ten moons crashed into the battlefield.
A deafening explosion swallowed the entire area, engulfing the four Early Golden Knights along with thousands of Ashenford soldiers caught within the blast radius.
Panic instantly spread throughout the Ashenford army.
Their morale completely collapsed.
Every surviving soldier desperately circulated their Aether, trying to free themselves from the crushing gravity so they could escape.
But...
"What?!"
"Why isn’t it disappearing?!"
"No... no... this can’t be happening!"
Fear rapidly spread across their faces.
No matter how much Aether they released...
The gravitational force refused to weaken.
None of them couldn’t even stand, as their bodies pinned helplessly to the ground.
Meanwhile...
The explosion generated a colossal shockwave that swept across the battlefield like a raging hurricane.
Many Ashenford soldiers were blown away or crushed by the aftermath.
The distant onlookers escaped only because they were far outside the blast radius.
As for the Blackstone Legions...
Luke protected them with his gravitational control, causing the destructive shockwave to split apart before reaching their formation.
’Huh... you survived.’ Luke looked toward the battlefield.
The Mid-Golden Knight had narrowly escaped the center of the explosion.
Although his body was covered in burns and injuries, he was still desperately fleeing.
’Well... it doesn’t matter.’ Luke shook his head.
With a single thought, the celestial bodies high above the battlefield shifted once more.
One after another...
They aligned themselves behind him.
"Cosmic Lock." Luke’s calm voice echoed across the battlefield.
The aligned celestial bodies immediately focused their gravitational force into a single straight line.
BOOM!
An overwhelming gravitational field descended upon Soren.
Everything caught within that line was instantly crushed.
The ground caved in.
Boulders shattered into dust.
Even the air seemed to distort beneath the unimaginable pressure.
’Danger!’ Every instinct inside Soren screamed at him.
But before he could react—
BOOM!
His entire body was slammed into the ground by an even greater gravitational force than before.
The earth beneath him cracked apart as he struggled in vain.
’What’s this?? how he can overpower me... an mid-golden knight?’
Earlier, Soren had sensed Luke’s dangerous aura.
But sensing it from afar...
And personally experiencing that overwhelming power...
Were two completely different things.
His disbelief only grew.
Not far away, Octavia and the other onlookers were equally stunned.
Then they heard Luke speak once more.
"Cosmic Punch."
The instant those words left his mouth...
The surrounding space seemed to tremble.
It was as if the sky themselves were collapsing beneath the weight of his punch.
Luke casually threw a punch into the empty air.
There was no visible energy.
No beam.
No shockwave.
Only an invisible force traveling through space.
In less than a heartbeat...
It reached Soren.
BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
A deafening explosion echoed across the battlefield.
Soren’s body exploded apart without offering the slightest resistance.
Not even a corpse remained.
The terrifying force continued downward.
When it struck the ground...
It was as though an ancient beast had awakened beneath the earth.
BOOOOOOM!!!
The battlefield erupted.
A massive circular shockwave burst outward as countless pillars of earth shot into the sky in every direction, resembling gigantic stone spikes erupting from beneath the surface.
Seeing the approaching destruction, Octavia and the others turned pale.
The expanding shockwave was rapidly heading toward them despite being nearly seven hundred meters away.
"Quick!"
So without hesitation, Octavia released her Aether.
An enormous shield rapidly formed before the group.
The center of the barrier became noticeably thicker and stronger, protecting both herself and Nyra.
Seeing this, countless onlookers hurried behind the barrier, desperately trying to escape the incoming catastrophe.
High above the battlefield, Luke watched everything with an amused smile.
Then he casually raised one hand.
The next instant...
The overwhelming gravitational force descended once more.
RUMBLE!!
The violently erupting ground on three sides of the battlefield was instantly flattened.
The side where the Blackstone Legions stood.
The side occupied by the Ashenford Army.
And the side where the onlookers had gathered.
As for the Ashenford soldiers...
Luke had no intention of letting them die.
From this moment onward, they were prisoners of war.
And prisoners...
Were valuable assets.
Seeing the earth itself being forced flat by an invisible power, another wave of shocked exclamations spread through the crowd.
Luke, however, paid them no attention.
With a single thought, every celestial body dissolved into streams of light before returning to his body.
His Cosmic Manifestation disappeared.
Then, slowly...
He floated back down toward his wife.
"Luke!"
The moment Luke landed and returned to his human form, Aurielle called out his name before throwing herself into his arms.
A genuine smile appeared on Luke’s face.
So just as he opened his arms to embrace her—
"Master!"
Another voice rang out.
The next instant, Aurora also leaped toward him.
Before Luke could react, Aurora wrapped her arms around him as well.
Seeing this, Aurielle’s expression immediately changed.
A hint of dissatisfaction appeared on her beautiful face as she glanced at Luke.
Luke, caught between the two, could only smile helplessly.
And Just as he was about to say something to Aurora...
He suddenly realized something.
Her body had gone completely limp.
Looking down, he found Aurora peacefully asleep in his embrace.
’It seems she overexerted herself.’
Luke shook his head with a helpless sigh.
The intense battle, the Judgment State, and the continuous fight against multiple Golden Knights had finally exhausted her completely.
Carefully lifting her into a princess carry, Luke walked toward Vaelira. "Take care of her."
Vaelira nodded gently and accepted the sleeping Aurora into her arms with great care.
"I’ll take care of her, Master." Vaelira replied with a gentle smile.
The lower half of her face was visible, as the mask she wore covered only the upper part, making her soft smile clearly noticeable.
Luke nodded at her, before walking toward Aurielle.
There she looked both exhausted and annoyed.
"Cough." He deliberately coughed after stopping in front of her.
"Hmph!" But Aurielle simply turned her face away, refusing to look at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: The P**vert Hero and His Wife
paragraphs: ’Have I really fallen for her completely?’ Luke couldn’t help smiling inwardly.
Because even her pouting, angry face looked unbelievably adorable to him.
So Luke made a wronged face and said, "Here a husband comes from a dangerous mission, but his wife is not even welcoming him."
Hearing Luke’s shameless words, Aurielle snorted.
Although... a part of what he said was true.
He had just returned safely from a dangerous battle.
But she was still angry.
And that was that.
"Heh, why would now Hero Luke need his wife? weren’t you enjoying your Aurora hug."
Luke only smiled after hearing her jealous words.
So just as Aurielle was about to turn her face away again...
He stepped forward.
And without saying another word, he wrapped his arms tightly around her.
"What—!" Aurielle’s eyes widened in surprise.
A faint blush instantly spread across her cheeks.
She hadn’t expected him to hug her so suddenly.
Then she realized something.
Everyone...
The soldiers, knights, mages, and even the onlookers...
Were all staring at them.
Which made her face grow even redder with embarrassment.
So in a barely audible voice, Aurielle whispered, "Luke... have some shame. Everyone is looking at us."
But Luke didn’t hear her words, instead he sniffed her body, her hair, which contained the smell of Lavender.
Surprisingly, even after such an intense battle, her fragrance remained unchanged.
The moment he inhaled that familiar scent, the tension weighing on his heart quietly faded away.
Feeling him nuzzle against her hair, Aurielle’s blush deepened.
Even the tips of her ears turned crimson.
"L-Luke..."
"You’ve become even more of a p**vert." She muttered so softly that only he could hear.
Her complaint only widened the smile on Luke’s face.
He leaned closer and gently placed a kiss on the side of her neck.
Aurielle’s body trembled slightly.
Then, in a voice only she could hear, he whispered,
"It’s you... who make me p**vert... my dear wife.
With that, Luke finally loosened his embrace.
He stepped back, smiled warmly...
And gave her a playful wink.
Aurielle didn’t even notice Luke’s playful wink.
As her face had already turned completely crimson, and she could feel heat spreading across her entire body.
While her mind had gone completely blank.
And only a single word echoed over and over again.
’P**vet! P**vet! P**vet! P**vet! P**vet! P**vet!’
Seeing her adorable reaction, Luke couldn’t help but chuckle.
He then shook his head with a helpless smile and took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
After all...
They were still standing in the middle of a battlefield, with countless eyes fixed upon them.
After calming himself, Luke surveyed the surroundings.
He found that every surviving Ashenford soldier had already thrown down their weapons.
None of them showed any intention of resisting.
Instead, they quietly allowed the Blackstone Legion to bind their hands with thick ropes.
After all...
If they still refused to surrender after witnessing the power of Cosmic Punch...
Then they would truly be fools.
The onlookers saw everything and became surprised, because they heard that all five princesses were forced to marry the Hero, who was declared talentless.
So the hero’s relations with his wives should not be so good, but the scenery in front of them was telling a different story.
Still, some of the onlookers wore smiles as they watched the heartwarming scene unfold.
However...
While a few male noble descendants, merchants, hell even adventurers, made ugly faces. ’Ahh! we have lost princess Aurielle, now she couldn’t be ours anymore.’
Their hearts filled with bitterness and regret.
The woman they had admired from afar...
The noble beauty countless men had dreamed of...
Now stood openly in another man’s embrace, her blushing face making it painfully clear that her heart already belonged to him.
Any lingering hopes they once held...
Were completely shattered.
The surrounding people noticed their ugly expressions and gave them strange looks.
Following their gazes, they quickly realized what those men were staring at.
A moment later, mocking voices rang out.
"Heh... as if any of you are even worthy of standing before Her Highness.
Hearing that, several noble descendants shot the crowd angry glares.
However, before they could say anything, someone spoke again.
"And stop looking at Her Highness like that."
"If Hero Luke notices..."
"...he might kill you on the spot."
The moment those words reached their ears, the nobles expressions froze.
Their faces instantly turned pale.
Almost instinctively, they lowered their heads and avoided looking toward Aurielle any longer.
After witnessing Luke’s overwhelming strength...
Not a single one of them doubted those words.
Luke didn’t know the ongoing drama among onlookers, instead he waved his hand and from the system inventory, the remaining 90 warwalker fortresses also appeared on the ground.
"WHAT THE F**K!"
Seeing this, many people got stunned again, while many even cursed.
Because just earlier, each of them had seen the insane fighting power of every single fortress.
As a result, the Ashenford armies got defeated just from 10 of these, but now Baron Luke has summoned 90 more.
"Crazy!!!"
"Thank god we have surrendered!"
While Ashenford soldiers blessed their stars for saving them from these monsters, while also cursing the blackstone for their dirty tactic.
Because if Blackstone Highlands had produced this many fortresses from the start, then why would they even dare to fight? They would surrender peacefully, and none of their brethren would have died.
’Blackstone people are scary.’ And this thought was echoing in their minds.
Therefore, some soldiers who were earlier in hope that their Lord Ashenford would save them, also lost hope and fully accepted the surrender.
While everyone was thinking and discussing this, they heard Luke’s loud voice.
"Everyone who is injured and couldn’t able to participate in battle."
"Return to the territory for treatment and rest, while those who can, mount the warwalker fortress, as we are attacking the invader base."
Hearing this, several noble descendants revealed surprised expressions.
Only now did they realize something.
From the very beginning, Luke had never once declared that he was attacking a noble territory.
Instead...
He had consistently described the enemy as "invaders".
Meaning, everything Blackstone had done so far was framed as defending against an invasion.
And now...
They were merely launching a counterattack against the invaders base.
Which was a clear war tactic for moral support, which presented them in a rightful light.
Luke saw everyone’s expression and just smiled in his heart.

Then she realized something.
Everyone...
The soldiers, knights, mages, and even the onlookers...
Were all staring at them.
Which made her face grow even redder with embarrassment.
So in a barely audible voice, Aurielle whispered, "Luke... have some shame.
Everyone is looking at us."
But Luke didn’t hear her words, instead he sniffed her body, her hair, which contained the smell of Lavender.
Surprisingly, even after such an intense battle, her fragrance remained unchanged.
The moment he inhaled that familiar scent, the tension weighing on his heart quietly faded away.
Feeling him nuzzle against her hair, Aurielle’s blush deepened.
Even the tips of her ears turned crimson.
"L-Luke..."
"You’ve become even more of a p**vert." She muttered so softly that only he could hear.
Her complaint only widened the smile on Luke’s face.
He leaned closer and gently placed a kiss on the side of her neck.
Aurielle’s body trembled slightly.
Then, in a voice only she could hear, he whispered,
"It’s you... who make me p**vert... my dear wife.
With that, Luke finally loosened his embrace.
He stepped back, smiled warmly...
And gave her a playful wink.
Aurielle didn’t even notice Luke’s playful wink.
As her face had already turned completely crimson, and she could feel heat spreading across her entire body.
While her mind had gone completely blank.
And only a single word echoed over and over again.
’P**vet!
P**vet!
P**vet!
P**vet!
P**vet!
P**vet!’
Seeing her adorable reaction, Luke couldn’t help but chuckle.
He then shook his head with a helpless smile and took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
After all...
They were still standing in the middle of a battlefield, with countless eyes fixed upon them.
After calming himself, Luke surveyed the surroundings.
He found that every surviving Ashenford soldier had already thrown down their weapons.
None of them showed any intention of resisting.
Instead, they quietly allowed the Blackstone Legion to bind their hands with thick ropes.
After all...
If they still refused to surrender after witnessing the power of Cosmic Punch...
Then they would truly be fools.
The onlookers saw everything and became surprised, because they heard that all five princesses were forced to marry the Hero, who was declared talentless.
So the hero’s relations with his wives should not be so good, but the scenery in front of them was telling a different story.
Still, some of the onlookers wore smiles as they watched the heartwarming scene unfold.
However...
While a few male noble descendants, merchants, hell even adventurers, made ugly faces. ’Ahh! we have lost princess Aurielle, now she couldn’t be ours anymore.’
Their hearts filled with bitterness and regret.
The woman they had admired from afar...
The noble beauty countless men had dreamed of...
Now stood openly in another man’s embrace, her blushing face making it painfully clear that her heart already belonged to him.
Any lingering hopes they once held...
Were completely shattered.
The surrounding people noticed their ugly expressions and gave them strange looks.
Following their gazes, they quickly realized what those men were staring at.
A moment later, mocking voices rang out.
"Heh... as if any of you are even worthy of standing before Her Highness.
Hearing that, several noble descendants shot the crowd angry glares.
However, before they could say anything, someone spoke again.
"And stop looking at Her Highness like that."
"If Hero Luke notices..."
"...he might kill you on the spot."
The moment those words reached their ears, the nobles expressions froze.
Their faces instantly turned pale.
Almost instinctively, they lowered their heads and avoided looking toward Aurielle any longer.
After witnessing Luke’s overwhelming strength...
Not a single one of them doubted those words.
Luke didn’t know the ongoing drama among onlookers, instead he waved his hand and from the system inventory, the remaining 90 warwalker fortresses also appeared on the ground.
"WHAT THE F**K!"
Seeing this, many people got stunned again, while many even cursed.
Because just earlier, each of them had seen the insane fighting power of every single fortress.
As a result, the Ashenford armies got defeated just from 10 of these, but now Baron Luke has summoned 90 more.
"Crazy!!!"
"Thank god we have surrendered!"
While Ashenford soldiers blessed their stars for saving them from these monsters, while also cursing the blackstone for their dirty tactic.
Because if Blackstone Highlands had produced this many fortresses from the start, then why would they even dare to fight?
They would surrender peacefully, and none of their brethren would have died.
’Blackstone people are scary.’ And this thought was echoing in their minds.
Therefore, some soldiers who were earlier in hope that their Lord Ashenford would save them, also lost hope and fully accepted the surrender.
While everyone was thinking and discussing this, they heard Luke’s loud voice.
"Everyone who is injured and couldn’t able to participate in battle."
"Return to the territory for treatment and rest, while those who can, mount the warwalker fortress, as we are attacking the invader base."
Hearing this, several noble descendants revealed surprised expressions.
Only now did they realize something.
From the very beginning, Luke had never once declared that he was attacking a noble territory.
Instead...
He had consistently described the enemy as "invaders".
Meaning, everything Blackstone had done so far was framed as defending against an invasion.
And now...
They were merely launching a counterattack against the invaders base.
Which was a clear war tactic for moral support, which presented them in a rightful light.
Luke saw everyone’s expression and just smiled in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: The Crimson-Eyed Scholar | The Pink-Haired Beauty
paragraphs: After that he gave a last look toward Osric, who understood the meaning and nodded.
"All Body Temper soldiers will not participate in the upcoming battle."
"Return to the territory at once."
Hearing Osric’s order, the surviving Body Temper soldiers breathed sighs of relief.
Since they had been stationed at the rear during the previous battle, most of them had survived.
Now, being ordered to withdraw instead of marching into another war filled them with gratitude.
Many couldn’t help but silently thank their commanders as they immediately turned and began the journey back to Blackstone Territory.
Even though some spies did feel a little uneasy, seeing Osric was leading them back, they shook their heads and followed him back.
Luke had done this because he intended to deal with every traitor who survived the war afterward.
"Luke." Aurielle, who had already cursed Luke thousands of times in her mind, came toward him with a worried expression.
Seeing her expression, Luke just smiled and said, "I will be back soon. So rest until then."
Aurielle nodded at his words.
However, the moment Luke added another sentence...
The blush that had only just faded from her face immediately returned.
"Because you won’t be getting any rest tonight."
Luke said with a playful smile before turning around and climbing onto one of the Warwalker Fortresses.
"W-What?!" Aurielle’s beautiful face instantly turned crimson.
Realizing what Luke had implied, she stood frozen in place, too embarrassed to say a single word.
Afterward, Luke turned his gaze toward the onlookers.
The moment his eyes swept across them, the crowd instinctively froze.
His gaze wasn’t hostile...
But it certainly wasn’t friendly either.
An invisible pressure settled over everyone, making even the nobles lower their heads.
Then...
Luke’s eyes landed on Sophia.
A faint smile appeared on his lips.
Seeing that smile, the surrounding nobles, merchants, and adventurers were stunned.
’Who is that woman...?’
’She actually earned Baron Luke’s recognition?’
’What is her relationship with him?’
Whispers immediately spread through the crowd.
Sophia also smiled back at Luke.
However, noticing hundreds of eyes suddenly focused on her, she felt slightly uncomfortable.
After a few moments, she gradually regained her composure.
Seeing this, Damien couldn’t help but rejoice inwardly.
’It seems Baron Luke doesn’t dislike Sophia.’
His merchant instincts immediately began working.
Countless opportunities for cooperation with Blackstone Territory flashed through his mind.
Luke then nodded and gave Nyra a gentle smile as well.
However...
The moment his gaze shifted toward Octavia...
A trace of displeasure flashed through his eyes.
If she had chosen to help the Blackstone Army during his absence...
Perhaps...
Aurora wouldn’t have suffered those injuries.
But a moment later, Luke quietly shook his head.
’I can’t depend on others.’
His hand slowly clenched into a fist.
’I have to become even stronger...’
’So that today’s incident...’
’Will never happen again.’
Nyra smiled when Luke looked at her, but then she noticed Luke’s face when his eyes turned to Octavia.
At that she became worried, because she also knew why Sir Luke was upset.
While Octavia shook her head without caring about his looks, because for her,
Her sister was the most important to her, which was why she had made that decision earlier. Which she didn’t have any regret.
"Let’s go Nyra, we have to go back home."
Octavia turned back, at which Nyra got stunned before she also shook her head and gave a last look to Luke, before following Octavia.
Many onlookers also chose to return, while some chose to follow the army in hope of seeing Luke’s battle with Viscount Aldaric.
Which they didn’t know, that he was already dead.
After settling everything, Luke personally led the army with all 99 remaining Warwalker Fortresses.
Fortunately, only one fortress had been damaged during the previous battle after being assaulted by the Golden Knights.
The other ninety-nine remained fully operational.
Following behind them were the "100 Peak Tide Keeper Realm Marinthains", along with the Bronze Knight archers and the rest of the Blackstone forces.
With the Warwalker Fortresses carrying the army at remarkable speed, what would normally have taken much longer was shortened considerably.
After traveling for nearly half a day...
Luke and his army finally arrived at "Windmarch Reach".
With that, the "99 Aether Devastation Beam Cannons" unleashed a simultaneous barrage, reducing the already damaged main gate to rubble.
BOOOOOOM!!!
The colossal gate exploded apart, clearing the way into Windmarch Reach.
Meanwhile, the "100 Peak Tide Keeper Realm Marinthains" charged through the breach, swiftly eliminating the remaining Silver Knights who attempted to resist.
Throughout the entire conquest, Luke never personally joined the battle.
Instead, he remained in command, directing the army from the rear while issuing orders with calm precision.
Without their Golden Knights and with their defenses already shattered, the city’s resistance quickly collapsed.
Just two hours later...
The Blackstone Army had taken complete control of Windmarch Reach’s main city.
As for the surrounding towns and smaller cities...
Those would require more time to fully occupy and bring under Blackstone’s rule.
While Luke’s conquest was going smoothly,
the tales of his deeds, which included killing a mid-golden knight with one punch, spread throughout the whole world in a single day.
Because after the hero summoning, most people were often ready or expected some achievements the hero would make.
Which had already occurred many times among the Ver Spring Month. Because the hero summoning didn’t occur at the same time.

Instead it began at the start of Ver Spring month, But Luke was summoned at the last date which was the 30th day of Ver Spring, 50,001 year of Dusk Era, and today counted as the first day of the new month, Flora.

But when they heard that the last summoned hero was talentless, everyone’s hopes shattered. Because according to the previous summoning, the last hero was always the strongest, which made Luke a failed Hero.

So when the news came that the same failed hero had reached an early bronze knight without any support, and came together with another news that he had also killed a mid-golden knight with a single punch,
Everyone became shocked, and all the guilds which spread news like the Echoes, the Whispers, The Word, the Gazeletter, the Crier, spread this information to every corner of the world immediately.
Didn’t matter the region, the races. Hell, even Demons received letters containing this information.
Because for them, the faster they spread this information, the more people would come to inquire for more information from them.
Which means more money...
Empyrean Academy...
Inside a luxurious room, lavishly decorated with pink flowers and brightly illuminated by elegant lamps,
A beautiful woman with silky pink hair sat gracefully at a study table, writing in a notebook with a quill.
Her beauty was nothing short of heavenly, as though even the gods had taken extra care in creating her.
Her crimson-red eyes remained fixed on the notebook before her, which was filled with intricate magic formulas, runic diagrams, and countless mystical symbols.
KNOCK.
A gentle knock echoed from the door.
However, she gave no response.
Her entire focus remained on deciphering the complex magic symbol before her.
Only when the person outside finally spoke did her concentration waver.
"Miss Selene Nightveil."
